`src/analysis/fork_registry.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/fork_registry.h"
#include "common/dbstore.h"

namespace idattd
{
    static const char FR_NODE[]  = "$ ida-ttd forks";
    static const uchar    FR_TAG     = 'F';
    static const uint32_t FR_MAGIC   = 0x4B524F46;  // 'FORK'
    static const uint32_t FR_VERSION = 1;
    static const uint32_t FR_MAX     = 10000;

    std::vector<ForkRecord> load_fork_records(bool *ok)
    {
        std::vector<ForkRecord> out;
        if ( ok != nullptr )
            *ok = true;
        PluginNode node(FR_NODE);
        std::vector<uchar> blob;
        // Fingerprint 0: the records span several recordings.
        if ( !node.exists() )
            return out;
        if ( !node.get(FR_TAG, FR_MAGIC, FR_VERSION, 0, &blob) )
        {
            // Absent is fine; present but unreadable is not.
            netnode nn(FR_NODE);
            if ( nn != BADNODE && nn.blobsize(0, FR_TAG) > 0 && ok != nullptr )
                *ok = false;
            return out;
        }
        BlobReader r(blob.data(), blob.size());
        uint32_t count = r.u32();
        if ( !r.ok() || count > FR_MAX )
        {
            if ( ok != nullptr )
                *ok = false;
            return out;
        }
        for ( uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
        {
            ForkRecord f;
            r.str(&f.path);
            r.str(&f.parent);
            r.str(&f.at);
            r.str(&f.changes);
            f.instructions = r.u64();
            f.time         = r.u64();
            if ( !r.ok() )
            {
                if ( ok != nullptr )
                    *ok = false;
                break;
            }
            out.push_back(std::move(f));
        }
        return out;
    }

    static void save_fork_records(const std::vector<ForkRecord> &v)
    {
        PluginNode node(FR_NODE);
        if ( v.empty() )
        {
            node.erase(FR_TAG);
            return;
        }
        // At most FR_MAX, as the reader refuses more and would then lose the
        // whole list. Records are appended (add_fork_record), so the oldest
        // are at the front and are the ones dropped.
        const size_t first = v.size() > FR_MAX ? v.size() - FR_MAX : 0;
        BlobWriter w;
        w.u32((uint32_t)(v.size() - first));
        for ( size_t i = first; i < v.size(); i++ )
        {
            const ForkRecord &f = v[i];
            w.str(f.path);
            w.str(f.parent);
            w.str(f.at);
            w.str(f.changes);
            w.u64(f.instructions);
            w.u64(f.time);
        }
        node.put(FR_TAG, FR_MAGIC, FR_VERSION, w, 0);
    }

    bool same_trace_path(const qstring &a, const qstring &b)
    {
        if ( a.length() != b.length() )
            return false;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < a.length(); i++ )
        {
            char x = a[i] == '/' ? '\\' : qtolower(a[i]);
            char y = b[i] == '/' ? '\\' : qtolower(b[i]);
            if ( x != y )
                return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static bool load_for_update(std::vector<ForkRecord> *v)
    {
        bool ok = true;
        *v = load_fork_records(&ok);
        if ( !ok )
            msg("[ida-ttd] the fork list in this database could not be read; leaving it as it is.\n");
        return ok;
    }

    void add_fork_record(const ForkRecord &r)
    {
        std::vector<ForkRecord> v;
        if ( !load_for_update(&v) )
            return;
        v.erase(std::remove_if(v.begin(), v.end(),
                               [&](const ForkRecord &f) { return same_trace_path(f.path, r.path); }),
                v.end());
        v.push_back(r);
        save_fork_records(v);
    }

    void remove_fork_record(const char *path)
    {
        qstring p(path != nullptr ? path : "");
        std::vector<ForkRecord> v;
        if ( !load_for_update(&v) )
            return;
        v.erase(std::remove_if(v.begin(), v.end(),
                               [&](const ForkRecord &f) { return same_trace_path(f.path, p); }),
                v.end());
        save_fork_records(v);
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/fork_registry.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // Forks recorded from this database's recordings, kept so the Fork manager
    // can draw a tree: each names its parent recording, possibly a fork.
    struct ForkRecord
    {
        qstring  path;          // the fork's own recording
        qstring  parent;        // the recording it was forked from
        qstring  at;            // the position it was forked at, as shown
        qstring  changes;       // what was changed there, in words
        uint64_t instructions = 0;
        uint64_t time = 0;      // when it was recorded (qtime64)
    };

    // The stored records. 'ok' (may be null) is false when a list exists but
    // could not be read in full; what could be read is returned.
    std::vector<ForkRecord> load_fork_records(bool *ok);
    // Add one, replacing a record of the same path (a fork recorded again over
    // the same file). Neither this nor remove_fork_record overwrites an
    // unreadable list.
    void add_fork_record(const ForkRecord &r);
    // Forget one; its file is not touched.
    void remove_fork_record(const char *path);

    // Paths compare as the same file regardless of case and slashes.
    bool same_trace_path(const qstring &a, const qstring &b);
}
```

`src/analysis/handles.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/handles.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include "analysis/batched_memory.h"
#include "analysis/syscalls.h"
#include "analysis/trace_store.h"
#include "debugger/trace_manager.h"

namespace idattd
{
    namespace
    {
        // A handle-making syscall's argument indexes (PHANDLE written back,
        // OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES, ACCESS_MASK; -1 for none) and object kind.
        struct Maker
        {
            const char *name;
            int         out;        // PHANDLE
            int         attrs;      // POBJECT_ATTRIBUTES
            int         access;     // ACCESS_MASK
            const char *type;
        };
        const Maker MAKERS[] =
        {
            { "NtCreateFile",               0, 2, 1, "File" },
            { "NtOpenFile",                 0, 2, 1, "File" },
            { "NtCreateNamedPipeFile",      0, 2, 1, "Pipe" },
            { "NtCreateMailslotFile",       0, 2, 1, "Mailslot" },
            { "NtCreateKey",                0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtCreateKeyTransacted",      0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtOpenKey",                  0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtOpenKeyEx",                0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtOpenKeyTransacted",        0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtOpenKeyTransactedEx",      0, 2, 1, "Key" },
            { "NtCreateSection",            0, 2, 1, "Section" },
            { "NtCreateSectionEx",          0, 2, 1, "Section" },
            { "NtOpenSection",              0, 2, 1, "Section" },
            { "NtCreateEvent",              0, 2, 1, "Event" },
            { "NtOpenEvent",                0, 2, 1, "Event" },
            { "NtCreateEventPair",          0, 2, 1, "EventPair" },
            { "NtCreateMutant",             0, 2, 1, "Mutant" },
            { "NtOpenMutant",               0, 2, 1, "Mutant" },
            { "NtCreateSemaphore",          0, 2, 1, "Semaphore" },
            { "NtOpenSemaphore",            0, 2, 1, "Semaphore" },
            { "NtCreateTimer",              0, 2, 1, "Timer" },
            { "NtCreateTimer2",             0, 2, 4, "Timer" },
            { "NtOpenTimer",                0, 2, 1, "Timer" },
            { "NtCreateIoCompletion",       0, 2, 1, "IoCompletion" },
            { "NtOpenIoCompletion",         0, 2, 1, "IoCompletion" },
            { "NtCreateKeyedEvent",         0, 2, 1, "KeyedEvent" },
            { "NtOpenKeyedEvent",           0, 2, 1, "KeyedEvent" },
            { "NtCreateDirectoryObject",    0, 2, 1, "Directory" },
            { "NtCreateDirectoryObjectEx",  0, 2, 1, "Directory" },
            { "NtOpenDirectoryObject",      0, 2, 1, "Directory" },
            { "NtCreateSymbolicLinkObject", 0, 2, 1, "SymbolicLink" },
            { "NtOpenSymbolicLinkObject",   0, 2, 1, "SymbolicLink" },
            { "NtCreateJobObject",          0, 2, 1, "Job" },
            { "NtOpenJobObject",            0, 2, 1, "Job" },
            { "NtCreateWorkerFactory",      0, 2, 1, "TpWorkerFactory" },
            { "NtCreateWaitCompletionPacket", 0, 2, 1, "WaitCompletionPacket" },
            { "NtCreateTransaction",        0, 2, 1, "Transaction" },
            { "NtOpenTransaction",          0, 2, 1, "Transaction" },
            { "NtCreateProcess",            0, 2, 1, "Process" },
            { "NtCreateProcessEx",          0, 2, 1, "Process" },
            { "NtOpenProcess",              0, 2, 1, "Process" },
            { "NtOpenThread",               0, 2, 1, "Thread" },
            { "NtCreateThread",             0, 2, 1, "Thread" },
            { "NtCreateThreadEx",           0, 2, 1, "Thread" },
            { "NtOpenProcessToken",         2, -1, 1, "Token" },
            { "NtOpenProcessTokenEx",       3, -1, 1, "Token" },
            { "NtOpenThreadToken",          3, -1, 1, "Token" },
            { "NtOpenThreadTokenEx",        4, -1, 1, "Token" },
            { "NtDuplicateToken",           5, 2, 1, "Token" },
            { "NtAlpcCreatePort",           0, 1, -1, "ALPC Port" },
            { "NtAlpcConnectPort",          0, -1, -1, "ALPC Port" },
            { "NtAlpcConnectPortEx",        0, 1, -1, "ALPC Port" },
            { "NtConnectPort",              0, -1, -1, "Port" },
            { "NtSecureConnectPort",        0, -1, -1, "Port" },
            { "NtCreatePort",               0, 1, -1, "Port" },
            { "NtCreateDebugObject",        0, 2, 1, "DebugObject" },
            { "NtCreatePartition",          1, 3, 2, "Partition" },
        };

        const Maker *maker_of(const qstring &name)
        {
            for ( const Maker &m : MAKERS )
                if ( name == m.name )
                    return &m;
            return nullptr;
        }

        // Reads at one position of the recording, in the program's sizes,
        // through a BatchedMemory reader (use()): a cursor seek per syscall
        // cost about 17 ms each on Microsoft TTD.
        class Reader
        {
        public:
            explicit Reader(bool wide) : m_wide(wide) {}
            void use(GuestRead read) { m_read = std::move(read); }
            size_t ptr_size() const { return m_wide ? 8 : 4; }

            bool read(uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t n)
            {
                if ( addr == 0 || !m_read )
                    return false;
                return m_read(addr, buf, n) == n;
            }

            uint64_t ptr(uint64_t addr)
            {
                uint64_t v = 0;
                if ( !read(addr, &v, ptr_size()) )
                    return 0;
                return v;
            }

            // A UNICODE_STRING at 'us'.
            qstring ustr(uint64_t us)
            {
                uint16_t len = 0;
                if ( us == 0 || !read(us, &len, 2) || len == 0 || len > 2048 )
                    return qstring();
                uint64_t buf = ptr(us + (m_wide ? 8 : 4));
                std::vector<wchar16_t> w(len / 2 + 1, 0);
                if ( !read(buf, w.data(), len) )
                    return qstring();
                qstring out;
                utf16_utf8(&out, w.data(), (int)(len / 2));
                return out;
            }

            // The name an OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES gives, and its root directory.
            qstring oa_name(uint64_t oa, uint64_t *root)
            {
                *root = 0;
                if ( oa == 0 )
                    return qstring();
                *root = ptr(oa + (m_wide ? 8 : 4));
                return ustr(ptr(oa + (m_wide ? 16 : 8)));
            }

        private:
            bool      m_wide;
            GuestRead m_read;
        };

        bool success(uint64_t status) { return (int32_t)(uint32_t)status >= 0; }

        qstring lower(const qstring &s)
        {
            qstring l = s;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < l.length(); i++ )
                l[i] = qtolower(l[i]);
            return l;
        }

        const uint64_t CURRENT_PROCESS_32 = 0xFFFFFFFFull;
        bool is_current_process(uint64_t h)
        {
            return h == ~0ull || h == CURRENT_PROCESS_32;
        }
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // In the database
    //=======================================================================
    // One blob, stamped with the recording it describes (trace_store).
    static const char     HD_NODE[]   = "$ ida-ttd handles";
    static const uchar    HD_TAG      = 'H';
    static const uint32_t HD_VERSION  = 1;

    static void put_str(bytevec_t *b, const qstring &s)
    {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)s.length();
        b->append(&n, sizeof(n));
        b->append(s.c_str(), n);
    }

    static bool get_str(const uchar **p, const uchar *end, qstring *s)
    {
        uint32_t n = 0;
        if ( end - *p < (ptrdiff_t)sizeof(n) )
            return false;
        memcpy(&n, *p, sizeof(n));
        *p += sizeof(n);
        if ( end - *p < (ptrdiff_t)n )
            return false;
        s->qclear();
        s->append((const char *)*p, n);
        *p += n;
        return true;
    }

    static void save_handles(const std::vector<HandleRecord> &v)
    {
        bytevec_t b;
        uint32_t ver = HD_VERSION, n = (uint32_t)v.size();
        b.append(&ver, sizeof(ver));
        b.append(&n, sizeof(n));
        for ( const HandleRecord &h : v )
        {
            uint64_t words[5] = { h.handle, h.opened.hi, h.opened.lo, h.closed.hi, h.closed.lo };
            uint32_t small[2] = { h.access, h.tid };
            b.append(words, sizeof(words));
            b.append(small, sizeof(small));
            put_str(&b, h.type);
            put_str(&b, h.name);
            put_str(&b, h.opened_by);
        }
        netnode nn(HD_NODE, 0, true);
        if ( nn == BADNODE )
            return;
        nn.delblob(0, HD_TAG);
        nn.setblob(b.begin(), b.size(), 0, HD_TAG);
        trace_store_stamp(nn);
    }

    bool load_handles(std::vector<HandleRecord> *out)
    {
        out->clear();
        netnode nn(HD_NODE);
        if ( nn == BADNODE || !trace_store_matches(nn) )
            return false;
        bytevec_t b;
        if ( nn.getblob(&b, 0, HD_TAG) <= 0 )
            return false;
        const uchar *p = b.begin(), *end = b.end();
        uint32_t ver = 0, n = 0;
        if ( end - p < 8 )
            return false;
        memcpy(&ver, p, 4);
        memcpy(&n, p + 4, 4);
        p += 8;
        if ( ver != HD_VERSION )
            return false;
        // Built aside, so a truncated blob yields nothing rather than a
        // prefix that would look complete.
        std::vector<HandleRecord> v;
        for ( uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++ )
        {
            HandleRecord h;
            uint64_t words[5];
            uint32_t small[2];
            if ( end - p < (ptrdiff_t)(sizeof(words) + sizeof(small)) )
                return false;
            memcpy(words, p, sizeof(words));
            p += sizeof(words);
            memcpy(small, p, sizeof(small));
            p += sizeof(small);
            h.handle = words[0];
            h.opened = Position{ words[1], words[2] };
            h.closed = Position{ words[3], words[4] };
            h.access = small[0];
            h.tid    = small[1];
            if ( !get_str(&p, end, &h.type) || !get_str(&p, end, &h.name) || !get_str(&p, end, &h.opened_by) )
                return false;
            v.push_back(std::move(h));
        }
        *out = std::move(v);
        return true;
    }

    bool list_handles(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<HandleRecord> *out, bool *cancelled)
    {
        out->clear();
        *cancelled = false;
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
            return false;
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();
        if ( !b->capabilities().syscalls )
            return false;

        std::vector<SyscallEvent> calls;
        if ( !list_syscalls(mgr, &calls, cancelled) || *cancelled )
            return false;

        // x64 syscall convention wherever syscalls came from 64-bit code:
        // always on Sogen, which runs WoW64's 64-bit side itself. A Microsoft
        // x86 recording has only the 32-bit side, with arguments on the stack.
        const bool wide = b->info().is64 || qstrcmp(b->id(), "sogen") == 0;

        QueryResult qr = run_query("Following the handles the program opened", [&](ProgressSink *sink)
        {
            QueryResult r;
            r.ran = true;
            // The syscalls that matter, and their registers in one batch.
            std::vector<size_t> idx;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
                if ( success(calls[i].result)
                  && (calls[i].name == "NtClose" || calls[i].name == "NtDuplicateObject"
                   || calls[i].name == "NtCreateUserProcess" || maker_of(calls[i].name) != nullptr) )
                    idx.push_back(i);
            std::vector<Position> where;
            for ( size_t i : idx )
                where.push_back(calls[i].pos);
            std::vector<ittd_regs> regs;
            StageSink regs_stage(sink, 0, 30);
            QueryResult rq = b->registers_at(where, &regs, &regs_stage);
            if ( regs_stage.cancelled() || rq.cancelled )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            // Without the registers, or a cursor to read the arguments with,
            // the list would come out empty and be saved as complete: report
            // the run as failed instead, so nothing is kept.
            if ( !rq.ran || regs.size() != where.size() )
            {
                r.ran = false;
                return r;
            }

            BatchedMemory mem;
            Reader rd(wide);
            auto arg = [&](const ittd_regs &g, int n) -> uint64_t
            {
                if ( wide )
                {
                    if ( n < 4 )
                        return g.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[n]];
                    return rd.ptr(g.gp[ITTD_REG_RSP] + 0x28 + 8 * (n - 4));
                }
                // [esp] returns into the stub, [esp+4] is the stub's own return.
                return rd.ptr(g.gp[ITTD_REG_RSP] + 8 + 4 * (uint64_t)n);
            };

            // ---- 1: what each call names, and where its handles go -----------
            //
            // Names and arguments are read at the call. The handles are out
            // parameters, resolved together below: on Microsoft TTD the
            // kernel's write surfaces only where the program reads it.
            struct Pending
            {
                enum Kind { Close, Open, Dup } kind = Open;
                HandleRecord rec;               // all but the handle
                int          slot = -1;         // index into 'slots'
                HandleRecord rec2;              // NtCreateUserProcess: its thread
                int          slot2 = -1;
                // Where the call's handles go, and what was there before:
                // read during the rounds, made into slots once they are done.
                uint64_t     out_addr = 0, out_before = 0;
                uint64_t     out2_addr = 0, out2_before = 0;
                uint64_t     handle = 0;        // Close: the handle
                uint64_t     root = 0;          // the name is relative to this handle
                uint64_t     file = 0;          // a section's file handle
                bool         dup_from_us = false, dup_close_source = false, dup_into_us = false;
                uint64_t     dup_src = 0;
            };
            std::vector<Pending> pend;
            std::vector<OutSlot> slots;
            std::vector<Pending> per_call(idx.size());
            std::vector<char>    made(idx.size(), 0);
            // One call, decoded afresh each round (decode_in_rounds runs it
            // again once the memory it missed has been fetched).
            auto decode_call = [&](size_t k)
            {
                const SyscallEvent &sc = calls[idx[k]];
                const ittd_regs &g = regs[k];
                rd.use(mem.reader(sc.pos));
                auto add_slot = [&](uint64_t addr, uint64_t *where, uint64_t *before) -> int
                {
                    *where  = addr;
                    *before = addr != 0 ? rd.ptr(addr) : 0;
                    return addr != 0 ? 0 : -1;      // numbered once the rounds are done
                };

                Pending p;
                p.rec.opened    = sc.pos;
                p.rec.opened_by = sc.name;
                p.rec.tid       = sc.tid;
                if ( sc.name == "NtClose" )
                {
                    p.kind   = Pending::Close;
                    p.handle = arg(g, 0);
                    p.rec.closed = sc.pos;
                }
                else if ( sc.name == "NtDuplicateObject" )
                {
                    const uint64_t src_proc = arg(g, 0), dst_proc = arg(g, 2);
                    p.kind             = Pending::Dup;
                    p.dup_src          = arg(g, 1);
                    p.dup_from_us      = is_current_process(src_proc);
                    p.dup_close_source = p.dup_from_us && (arg(g, 6) & 1) != 0;   // DUPLICATE_CLOSE_SOURCE
                    p.dup_into_us      = is_current_process(dst_proc);
                    p.rec.access       = (uint32_t)arg(g, 4);
                    if ( !p.dup_from_us )
                        p.rec.name.sprnt("handle 0x%llX of another process", (unsigned long long)p.dup_src);
                    if ( p.dup_into_us )
                        p.slot = add_slot(arg(g, 3), &p.out_addr, &p.out_before);
                }
                else if ( sc.name == "NtCreateUserProcess" )
                {
                    // Two handles, process and first thread, named after the
                    // image (RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS.ImagePathName).
                    const uint64_t params = arg(g, 8);
                    const qstring image = rd.ustr(params != 0 ? params + (wide ? 0x60 : 0x38) : 0);
                    p.rec.type   = "Process";
                    p.rec.name   = image;
                    p.rec.access = (uint32_t)arg(g, 2);
                    p.rec2       = p.rec;
                    p.rec2.type   = "Thread";
                    p.rec2.access = (uint32_t)arg(g, 3);
                    if ( !image.empty() )
                        p.rec2.name = qstring("first thread of ") + image;
                    p.slot  = add_slot(arg(g, 0), &p.out_addr, &p.out_before);
                    p.slot2 = add_slot(arg(g, 1), &p.out2_addr, &p.out2_before);
                }
                else
                {
                    const Maker *m = maker_of(sc.name);
                    HandleRecord &hr = p.rec;
                    hr.type = m->type;
                    if ( m->access >= 0 )
                        hr.access = (uint32_t)arg(g, m->access);
                    if ( m->attrs >= 0 )
                        hr.name = rd.oa_name(arg(g, m->attrs), &p.root);
                    if ( sc.name == "NtAlpcConnectPort" || sc.name == "NtConnectPort" || sc.name == "NtSecureConnectPort" )
                        hr.name = rd.ustr(arg(g, 1));
                    if ( sc.name == "NtOpenProcess" || sc.name == "NtOpenThread" )
                    {
                        const uint64_t cid = arg(g, 3);
                        const uint64_t pid = rd.ptr(cid), tid = rd.ptr(cid + rd.ptr_size());
                        if ( sc.name == "NtOpenProcess" && pid != 0 )
                            hr.name.sprnt("process %llu", (unsigned long long)pid);
                        else if ( tid != 0 )
                            hr.name.sprnt("thread %llu", (unsigned long long)tid);
                    }
                    if ( sc.name == "NtCreateThreadEx" )
                        hr.name.sprnt("starting at 0x%llX", (unsigned long long)arg(g, 4));
                    if ( sc.name == "NtCreateSection" || sc.name == "NtCreateSectionEx" )
                        p.file = arg(g, 6);
                    if ( hr.type == "File" )
                    {
                        const qstring l = lower(hr.name);
                        if ( l.find("\\device\\afd") == 0 )
                            hr.type = "Socket";
                        else if ( l.find("\\pipe\\") != qstring::npos || l.find("\\device\\namedpipe") == 0 )
                            hr.type = "Pipe";
                    }
                    p.slot = add_slot(arg(g, m->out), &p.out_addr, &p.out_before);
                }
                per_call[k] = std::move(p);
                made[k]     = 1;
            };
            std::vector<size_t> with_regs;
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < idx.size(); k++ )
                if ( k < regs.size() && (regs[k].have & ITTD_REGS_GP) != 0 )
                    with_regs.push_back(k);
            if ( !decode_in_rounds(mem, b, sink, with_regs, decode_call, 30, 60) )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            // The out slots, numbered in call order now that each call's
            // reads are final.
            auto number_slot = [&](const SyscallEvent &sc, uint64_t addr, uint64_t before) -> int
            {
                if ( addr == 0 )
                    return -1;
                OutSlot s;
                s.call   = sc.pos;
                s.addr   = (ea_t)addr;
                s.before = before;
                s.tid    = sc.tid;
                s.width  = (uint32_t)rd.ptr_size();
                slots.push_back(s);
                return (int)slots.size() - 1;
            };
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < idx.size(); k++ )
            {
                if ( !made[k] )
                    continue;
                Pending &p = per_call[k];
                const SyscallEvent &sc = calls[idx[k]];
                p.slot  = p.slot  >= 0 ? number_slot(sc, p.out_addr, p.out_before) : -1;
                p.slot2 = p.slot2 >= 0 ? number_slot(sc, p.out2_addr, p.out2_before) : -1;
                pend.push_back(std::move(p));
            }

            // ---- 2: the handles the calls wrote back ---------------------------
            std::vector<std::optional<uint64_t>> values;
            StageSink outs_stage(sink, 60, 100);
            if ( !b->query_out_values(slots, &values, &outs_stage) )
            {
                // The backend has the kernel's writes where they happen: read
                // the slot one position after the call, batched like the rest.
                values.assign(slots.size(), std::nullopt);
                std::vector<size_t> all(slots.size());
                std::vector<Position> one_on(slots.size());
                for ( size_t i = 0; i < slots.size(); i++ )
                {
                    all[i]    = i;
                    one_on[i] = b->position_add(slots[i].call, 1);
                }
                decode_in_rounds(mem, b, &outs_stage, all, [&](size_t i)
                {
                    rd.use(mem.reader(one_on[i]));
                    uint64_t v = 0;
                    if ( rd.read(slots[i].addr, &v, rd.ptr_size()) )
                        values[i] = v;
                    else
                        values[i] = std::nullopt;
                }, 0, 100);
            }
            if ( sink != nullptr && sink->cancelled() )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            auto value_of = [&](int slot) -> uint64_t
            {
                return slot >= 0 && (size_t)slot < values.size() && values[slot].has_value() ? *values[slot] : 0;
            };

            // ---- 3: opened and closed, in order --------------------------------
            std::map<uint64_t, size_t> live;            // handle -> its record
            std::vector<HandleRecord> recs;
            auto name_of = [&](uint64_t h) -> const HandleRecord *
            {
                auto it = live.find(h);
                return it != live.end() ? &recs[it->second] : nullptr;
            };
            auto close = [&](uint64_t h, Position p)
            {
                auto it = live.find(h);
                if ( it != live.end() )
                {
                    recs[it->second].closed = p;
                    live.erase(it);
                    return;
                }
                // Never seen opened: from before the recording, or its handle
                // could not be recovered.
                HandleRecord hr;
                hr.handle = h;
                hr.type   = "(opened before the recording)";
                hr.closed = p;
                recs.push_back(hr);
            };
            auto open = [&](HandleRecord hr)
            {
                if ( hr.handle == 0 )
                    return;
                // A live value reused without a seen close: the newer wins.
                live[hr.handle] = recs.size();
                recs.push_back(std::move(hr));
            };
            for ( Pending &p : pend )
            {
                switch ( p.kind )
                {
                    case Pending::Close:
                        close(p.handle, p.rec.closed);
                        break;
                    case Pending::Dup:
                        if ( p.dup_from_us )
                            if ( const HandleRecord *s = name_of(p.dup_src) )
                            {
                                p.rec.type = s->type;
                                p.rec.name = s->name;
                            }
                        if ( p.dup_close_source )
                            close(p.dup_src, p.rec.opened);
                        if ( p.dup_into_us )
                        {
                            if ( p.rec.type.empty() )
                                p.rec.type = "(duplicated)";
                            p.rec.handle = value_of(p.slot);
                            open(p.rec);
                        }
                        break;
                    case Pending::Open:
                        if ( !p.rec.name.empty() && p.rec.name[0] != '\\' && p.root != 0 )
                        {
                            // Relative to a directory or key opened earlier.
                            if ( const HandleRecord *base = name_of(p.root) )
                                if ( !base->name.empty() )
                                    p.rec.name = base->name + "\\" + p.rec.name;
                        }
                        if ( p.file != 0 && p.rec.name.empty() )
                            if ( const HandleRecord *f = name_of(p.file) )
                                p.rec.name = f->name;     // an image or file section
                        p.rec.handle = value_of(p.slot);
                        open(p.rec);
                        if ( p.slot2 >= 0 )
                        {
                            p.rec2.handle = value_of(p.slot2);
                            open(p.rec2);
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
            *out = std::move(recs);
            return r;
        });
        if ( qr.cancelled )
            *cancelled = true;
        else if ( qr.ran )
            save_handles(*out);
        return qr.ran;
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/handles.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/position.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class TraceManager;

    // The handles the recorded process opened and closed (files, keys,
    // sockets, pipes, sections, processes, threads, events, ...).
    //
    // Built from the syscalls (capabilities().syscalls): each create or open
    // is read at the call for what it names (OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES, client id,
    // port name) and after it for the handle written back; NtDuplicateObject
    // copies one, NtClose ends one. A handle closed but never seen opened
    // predates the recording (inherited, or made by the loader).
    struct HandleRecord
    {
        uint64_t handle = 0;
        qstring  type;                  // "File", "Key", "Socket", "Process", ...
        qstring  name;                  // the object's name or path, when it has one
        uint32_t access = 0;            // the access asked for
        Position opened;                // the syscall that made it; none when before the recording
        qstring  opened_by;             // "NtCreateFile"
        uint32_t tid = 0;
        Position closed;                // NtClose (or a duplicate that closed it); none while open
    };

    // Every handle in opening order; one from before the recording sits where
    // it was closed. Behind a cancellable wait box; false when the backend
    // cannot list syscalls. A complete answer is saved for load_handles.
    bool list_handles(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<HandleRecord> *out, bool *cancelled);

    // The list saved by the last complete list_handles against this
    // recording; false when there is none.
    bool load_handles(std::vector<HandleRecord> *out);
}
```

`src/analysis/memmap.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/memmap.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include "debugger/trace_manager.h"
#include "common/symbols.h"
#include "common/dbstore.h"

namespace idattd
{
    //=======================================================================
    // Page protections
    //=======================================================================
    // PAGE_* values spelled out rather than taken from <windows.h>: they are the
    // recording's ABI, not this build's headers.
    enum : uint32_t
    {
        P_NOACCESS           = 0x001,
        P_READONLY           = 0x002,
        P_READWRITE          = 0x004,
        P_WRITECOPY          = 0x008,
        P_EXECUTE            = 0x010,
        P_EXECUTE_READ       = 0x020,
        P_EXECUTE_READWRITE  = 0x040,
        P_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY  = 0x080,
        P_GUARD              = 0x100,
        P_NOCACHE            = 0x200,
        P_WRITECOMBINE       = 0x400,
        P_ACCESS_MASK        = 0x0FF,
    };

    // MEM_* states of an RC_STATE entry, likewise spelled out.
    enum : uint32_t
    {
        M_COMMIT             = 0x01000,
        M_FREE               = 0x10000,
    };

    // NtFreeVirtualMemory's FreeType, carried in an RC_FREE's 'protect'.
    enum : uint32_t
    {
        MEM_DECOMMIT_TYPE    = 0x4000,
        MEM_RELEASE_TYPE     = 0x8000,
    };

    uchar protection_perm(uint32_t protect)
    {
        uint32_t a = protect & P_ACCESS_MASK;
        uchar p = 0;
        if ( (a & (P_EXECUTE | P_EXECUTE_READ | P_EXECUTE_READWRITE | P_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) != 0 )
            p |= SEGPERM_EXEC;
        // PAGE_EXECUTE alone is execute-without-read, so it is in neither list
        // below.
        if ( (a & (P_READONLY | P_READWRITE | P_WRITECOPY
                 | P_EXECUTE_READ | P_EXECUTE_READWRITE | P_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) != 0 )
            p |= SEGPERM_READ;
        if ( (a & (P_READWRITE | P_WRITECOPY | P_EXECUTE_READWRITE | P_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)) != 0 )
            p |= SEGPERM_WRITE;
        return p;
    }

    qstring protection_text(uint32_t protect)
    {
        uchar p = protection_perm(protect);
        qstring s;
        s.append((p & SEGPERM_READ)  != 0 ? 'R' : '-');
        s.append((p & SEGPERM_WRITE) != 0 ? 'W' : '-');
        s.append((p & SEGPERM_EXEC)  != 0 ? 'X' : '-');
        if ( (protect & P_ACCESS_MASK) == P_NOACCESS )
            s = "none";
        if ( (protect & P_GUARD) != 0 )
            s.append(" guard");
        return s;
    }

    const char *change_name(uint8_t kind)
    {
        switch ( kind )
        {
            case RC_ALLOC:     return "Allocate";
            case RC_PROTECT:   return "Protect";
            case RC_FREE:      return "Free";
            case RC_MAPVIEW:   return "Map view";
            case RC_UNMAPVIEW: return "Unmap view";
            case RC_STATE:     return "Now";
            default:           return "?";
        }
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Folding the timeline into a region set
    //=======================================================================
    typedef std::map<ea_t, Region> LiveMap;

    // Remove [lo, hi) from the live set, keeping the parts of overlapping
    // regions outside it. This keeps the set non-overlapping and makes a
    // free-then-reallocate at one address come out right.
    static void carve(LiveMap &live, ea_t lo, ea_t hi, std::vector<Region> *removed)
    {
        if ( hi <= lo )
            return;
        // Start at the last region beginning at or before 'lo', the only one
        // before 'lo' that can reach into the range.
        LiveMap::iterator it = live.upper_bound(lo);
        if ( it != live.begin() )
            --it;

        while ( it != live.end() && it->first < hi )
        {
            Region r = it->second;
            if ( r.end() <= lo )
            {
                ++it;
                continue;
            }
            it = live.erase(it);
            if ( removed != nullptr )
                removed->push_back(r);

            if ( r.base < lo )
            {
                Region head = r;
                head.size = (uint64_t)(lo - r.base);
                live[head.base] = head;
            }
            if ( r.end() > hi )
            {
                Region tail = r;
                tail.base = hi;
                tail.size = (uint64_t)(r.end() - hi);
                live[tail.base] = tail;
            }
        }
    }

    static void apply_change(LiveMap &live, const RegionChange &c)
    {
        // A call on another process changed that process's map, not this one
        // (it stays in the listing).
        if ( c.other_process || c.base == BADADDR )
            return;

        switch ( c.kind )
        {
            case RC_ALLOC:
            case RC_MAPVIEW:
            {
                if ( c.size == 0 )
                    return;
                carve(live, c.base, (ea_t)(c.base + c.size), nullptr);
                Region r;
                r.base    = c.base;
                r.size    = c.size;
                r.protect = c.protect;
                r.origin  = c.kind;
                r.type    = c.kind == RC_MAPVIEW ? ITTD_REGION_MAPPED : ITTD_REGION_PRIVATE;
                r.since   = c.call_pos.is_valid() ? c.call_pos : c.pos;
                r.alloc   = c.base;
                live[r.base] = r;
                break;
            }

            case RC_PROTECT:
            {
                if ( c.size == 0 )
                    return;
                ea_t lo = c.base, hi = (ea_t)(c.base + c.size);
                std::vector<Region> hit;
                carve(live, lo, hi, &hit);
                if ( hit.empty() )
                {
                    // A protection change on memory no watched call allocated.
                    // Inside a module that is ordinary (the loader fixing up
                    // sections). Outside one it may be a payload whose
                    // allocation was not recovered, so it makes a region.
                    if ( c.in_module )
                        return;
                    Region r;
                    r.base    = lo;
                    r.size    = c.size;
                    r.protect = c.protect;
                    r.origin  = RC_PROTECT;
                    r.since   = c.call_pos.is_valid() ? c.call_pos : c.pos;
                    r.alloc   = lo;
                    live[r.base] = r;
                    return;
                }
                // Parts outside the range keep their protection; the part
                // inside takes the new one.
                for ( const Region &r : hit )
                {
                    if ( r.base < lo )
                    {
                        Region head = r;
                        head.size = (uint64_t)(lo - r.base);
                        live[head.base] = head;
                    }
                    if ( r.end() > hi )
                    {
                        Region tail = r;
                        tail.base = hi;
                        tail.size = (uint64_t)(r.end() - hi);
                        live[tail.base] = tail;
                    }
                    ea_t ilo = r.base > lo ? r.base : lo;
                    ea_t ihi = r.end() < hi ? r.end() : hi;
                    if ( ihi > ilo )
                    {
                        Region mid = r;
                        mid.base    = ilo;
                        mid.size    = (uint64_t)(ihi - ilo);
                        mid.protect = c.protect;
                        live[mid.base] = mid;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }

            case RC_STATE:
            {
                // The range is now what the entry says, whatever it was before.
                if ( c.size == 0 )
                    return;
                std::vector<Region> was;
                carve(live, c.base, (ea_t)(c.base + c.size), &was);
                if ( c.state == M_FREE )
                    return;
                Region r;
                r.base    = c.base;
                r.size    = c.size;
                // Reserved memory has no access at all until committed.
                r.protect = c.state == M_COMMIT ? c.protect : (uint32_t)P_NOACCESS;
                r.origin  = c.region_type == ITTD_REGION_MAPPED || c.region_type == ITTD_REGION_SECTION
                          ? RC_MAPVIEW : RC_ALLOC;
                r.type     = c.region_type;
                r.reserved = c.state != M_COMMIT;
                r.alloc    = c.alloc_base != 0 ? c.alloc_base : c.base;
                // A commit or protection change inside a region keeps the
                // position the region first appeared at.
                r.since    = c.pos;
                for ( const Region &w : was )
                    if ( w.base <= r.base && w.type == r.type && w.since.is_valid() && w.since < r.since )
                        r.since = w.since;
                live[r.base] = r;
                break;
            }

            case RC_FREE:
            case RC_UNMAPVIEW:
            {
                // A decommit leaves the range reserved, not free.
                const bool decommit = c.kind == RC_FREE && (c.protect & MEM_DECOMMIT_TYPE) != 0
                                   && (c.protect & MEM_RELEASE_TYPE) == 0;
                std::vector<Region> gone;
                if ( c.size != 0 )
                {
                    carve(live, c.base, (ea_t)(c.base + c.size), &gone);
                    // carve() keeps the parts outside the range; only the
                    // parts inside are reserved now.
                    for ( Region &g : gone )
                    {
                        ea_t lo = g.base > c.base ? g.base : c.base;
                        ea_t hi = g.end() < (ea_t)(c.base + c.size) ? g.end() : (ea_t)(c.base + c.size);
                        g.base = lo;
                        g.size = hi > lo ? (uint64_t)(hi - lo) : 0;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Size zero acts on the whole region (MEM_RELEASE, every
                    // unmap, a whole-region decommit): every piece of the
                    // allocation holding the address, which protection
                    // changes may have split.
                    LiveMap::iterator it = live.upper_bound(c.base);
                    if ( it == live.begin() )
                        return;
                    --it;
                    if ( it->second.end() <= c.base )
                        return;
                    const ea_t alloc = it->second.alloc != 0 ? it->second.alloc : it->second.base;
                    for ( it = live.lower_bound(alloc); it != live.end(); )
                    {
                        const ea_t a = it->second.alloc != 0 ? it->second.alloc : it->second.base;
                        if ( a != alloc )
                        {
                            // Pieces of one allocation are contiguous, so
                            // the first foreign region past the address ends
                            // it; one before the address is just skipped.
                            if ( it->first > c.base )
                                break;
                            ++it;
                            continue;
                        }
                        gone.push_back(it->second);
                        it = live.erase(it);
                    }
                }
                if ( decommit )
                {
                    for ( Region g : gone )
                    {
                        if ( g.size == 0 )
                            continue;
                        g.protect  = P_NOACCESS;
                        g.reserved = true;
                        live[g.base] = g;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }

            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    size_t MemoryMap::count_at(const Position &pos) const
    {
        if ( !pos.is_valid() )
            return m_changes.size();
        auto it = std::upper_bound(m_changes.begin(), m_changes.end(), pos,
                                   [](const Position &p, const RegionChange &c) { return p < c.pos; });
        return (size_t)(it - m_changes.begin());
    }

    size_t MemoryMap::checkpoint_every() const
    {
        const size_t MIN_EVERY = 256;
        const size_t MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 64;
        size_t every = m_changes.size() / MAX_CHECKPOINTS;
        return every < MIN_EVERY ? MIN_EVERY : every;
    }

    void MemoryMap::state_upto(size_t n, std::vector<Region> &out) const
    {
        out.clear();
        if ( n > m_changes.size() )
            n = m_changes.size();

        // Moving forward from the cache is the common case (a step crosses few
        // changes, if any). A change cannot be undone without knowing what it
        // displaced, so moving backward starts again from the last checkpoint
        // at or before 'n'.
        if ( !m_liveValid || n < m_liveIdx )
        {
            auto it = std::upper_bound(m_checkpoints.begin(), m_checkpoints.end(), n,
                                       [](size_t k, const std::pair<size_t, LiveMap> &c) { return k < c.first; });
            if ( it != m_checkpoints.begin() )
            {
                --it;
                m_live    = it->second;
                m_liveIdx = it->first;
            }
            else
            {
                m_live.clear();
                m_liveIdx = 0;
            }
        }

        // Every multiple of 'every' up to the last checkpoint has one (the
        // fold only ever walks forward through them), so a checkpoint is
        // added only past the last.
        const size_t every = checkpoint_every();
        while ( m_liveIdx < n )
        {
            apply_change(m_live, m_changes[m_liveIdx]);
            m_liveIdx++;
            if ( m_liveIdx % every == 0
              && (m_checkpoints.empty() || m_checkpoints.back().first < m_liveIdx) )
                m_checkpoints.emplace_back(m_liveIdx, m_live);
        }
        m_liveValid = true;

        out.reserve(m_live.size());
        for ( const auto &kv : m_live )
            out.push_back(kv.second);
    }

    void MemoryMap::drop_fold()
    {
        m_live.clear();
        m_liveIdx   = 0;
        m_liveValid = false;
        m_checkpoints.clear();
    }

    void MemoryMap::set_changes(std::vector<RegionChange> v)
    {
        m_changes = std::move(v);
        drop_fold();
        std::stable_sort(m_changes.begin(), m_changes.end(),
                         [](const RegionChange &a, const RegionChange &b)
                         { return a.pos < b.pos; });
    }

    void MemoryMap::clear()
    {
        m_changes.clear();
        drop_fold();
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Persistence
    //=======================================================================
    static const char  MM_NODE[]  = "$ ida-ttd memmap";
    static const uchar MM_TAG     = 'M';
    static const uint32_t MM_MAGIC   = 0x50414D54;   // 'TMAP'
    // A map of any other version is rebuilt, not shown:
    // 10: the chain keeps every frame in the program and outside modules,
    //     so the listing can tell callers of one allocation helper apart.
    // 9: a Microsoft TTD change with no call chain carries its calling
    //    instruction as a one-frame chain, so a v8 map shows no caller there.
    // 8: RC_STATE entries, with their state, region type and allocation base.
    // 7: positions are stored as the core's two words, whose "no position"
    //    marker differs from the one Microsoft TTD used, so a v6 map would
    //    read an absent call position back as a real one.
    // 6: the chain keeps module boundaries rather than the innermost frames.
    // 5: the called export. 4: the call chain. 3: the call position.
    // 2: RegionChange::pc is the caller, and the stack-argument offset comes
    //    from the stack rather than being assumed, so an older map can hold a
    //    wrong Protect value.
    static const uint32_t MM_VERSION = 10;
    // A recording that allocates in a loop can produce very many changes; past
    // this cap more rows add nothing, and the blob must fit the database.
    static const size_t MM_MAX_ITEMS = 200000;

    // The blob: PluginNode's header (u32 magic, u32 version, u64 fingerprint),
    // then the changes.
    void MemoryMap::save(uint64_t fingerprint) const
    {
        PluginNode node(MM_NODE);
        if ( m_changes.empty() )
        {
            node.erase(MM_TAG);
            return;
        }

        BlobWriter w;
        size_t n = m_changes.size() < MM_MAX_ITEMS ? m_changes.size() : MM_MAX_ITEMS;
        if ( n < m_changes.size() )
        {
            msg("[ida-ttd] memory map: storing %d of %d change(s); the rest will "
                "not survive reopening the database.\n",
                (int)n, (int)m_changes.size());
        }
        w.u64((uint64_t)n);
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < n; i++ )
        {
            const RegionChange &c = m_changes[i];
            w.u64(c.pos.hi);
            w.u64(c.pos.lo);
            w.u64(c.call_pos.hi);
            w.u64(c.call_pos.lo);
            w.u32(c.tid);
            w.u64((uint64_t)c.pc);
            w.u64((uint64_t)c.api);
            w.u8(c.kind);
            w.u64((uint64_t)c.base);
            w.u64(c.size);
            w.u32(c.protect);
            w.u8((uint8_t)((c.exact ? 1 : 0) | (c.other_process ? 2 : 0) | (c.in_module ? 4 : 0)));
            uint8_t nc = c.chain_n <= RegionChange::MAX_CHAIN
                       ? c.chain_n : (uint8_t)RegionChange::MAX_CHAIN;
            w.u8(nc);
            for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < nc; k++ )
                w.u64((uint64_t)c.chain[k]);
            w.u32(c.state);
            w.u32(c.region_type);
            w.u64((uint64_t)c.alloc_base);
        }
        node.put(MM_TAG, MM_MAGIC, MM_VERSION, w, fingerprint);
    }

    bool MemoryMap::load(uint64_t fingerprint)
    {
        clear();

        // get() refuses a map built from a different recording.
        std::vector<uchar> blob;
        if ( !PluginNode(MM_NODE).get(MM_TAG, MM_MAGIC, MM_VERSION, fingerprint, &blob) )
            return false;

        BlobReader r(blob.data(), blob.size());
        bool ok = true;
        uint64_t count = r.u64();
        if ( count > MM_MAX_ITEMS )
            ok = false;

        std::vector<RegionChange> v;
        if ( ok )
        {
            v.reserve((size_t)count);
            for ( uint64_t i = 0; i < count && r.ok(); i++ )
            {
                RegionChange c;
                c.pos.hi      = r.u64();
                c.pos.lo      = r.u64();
                c.call_pos.hi = r.u64();
                c.call_pos.lo = r.u64();
                c.tid          = r.u32();
                c.pc           = (ea_t)r.u64();
                c.api          = (ea_t)r.u64();
                c.kind         = r.u8();
                c.base         = (ea_t)r.u64();
                c.size         = r.u64();
                c.protect      = r.u32();
                uint8_t f      = r.u8();
                c.exact         = (f & 1) != 0;
                c.other_process = (f & 2) != 0;
                c.in_module     = (f & 4) != 0;
                uint8_t nc      = r.u8();
                if ( nc > RegionChange::MAX_CHAIN )
                {
                    ok = false;             // corrupt: refuse the whole blob
                    break;
                }
                for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < nc && r.ok(); k++ )
                    c.chain[k] = (ea_t)r.u64();
                c.chain_n = nc;
                c.state       = r.u32();
                c.region_type = r.u32();
                c.alloc_base  = (ea_t)r.u64();
                if ( c.kind < RC_COUNT )
                    v.push_back(c);
            }
            ok = ok && r.ok();
        }

        if ( !ok )
            return false;
        // Through set_changes, which sorts by position (state_at() relies on
        // it) and resets the cache.
        set_changes(std::move(v));
        return true;
    }

    void MemoryMap::erase()
    {
        PluginNode(MM_NODE).erase(MM_TAG);
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Building the map
    //=======================================================================
    bool build_memory_map(TraceManager *mgr, MemoryMap *out, bool *cancelled, qstring *error)
    {
        if ( out != nullptr )
            out->clear();
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = false;

        // Failures are said in 'error', never in a dialog: the caller (a UI
        // action, or a script that a dialog would hang) decides how to show
        // them.
        qstring ignored;
        if ( error == nullptr )
            error = &ignored;
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
        {
            *error = "the memory map can only be built while replaying a trace";
            return false;
        }
        ITraceBackend *backend = mgr->backend();

        std::vector<ittd_mapping_change> found;
        std::vector<qstring> files;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Building the memory map", [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return backend->query_mapping_changes(&found, &files, p);
        });
        if ( !qr.ran )
        {
            *error = qr.session_ended || !mgr->is_active()
                   ? "the replay session ended while the memory map was built"
                   : "the memory map could not be built for this recording (the output window has the details)";
            return false;
        }

        std::vector<RegionChange> changes;
        changes.reserve(found.size());
        for ( const ittd_mapping_change &m : found )
        {
            // Skip unknown kinds before the narrowing below could alias them.
            if ( m.kind > ITTD_MAP_STATE )
                continue;
            RegionChange c;
            c.pos      = Position{ m.pos.hi, m.pos.lo };
            c.call_pos = Position{ m.call_pos.hi, m.call_pos.lo };
            c.tid      = m.tid;
            c.api      = m.api == ITTD_BADADDR ? BADADDR : (ea_t)m.api;
            c.chain_n  = (uint8_t)std::min<uint32_t>(m.chain_n, RegionChange::MAX_CHAIN);
            for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < c.chain_n; k++ )
                c.chain[k] = m.chain[k] == ITTD_BADADDR ? BADADDR : (ea_t)m.chain[k];
            // The caller, for the listing: the innermost frame of the chain.
            c.pc       = c.chain_n > 0 ? c.chain[0] : BADADDR;
            c.kind     = m.kind == ITTD_MAP_STATE ? (uint8_t)RC_STATE : (uint8_t)m.kind;
            c.base         = (ea_t)m.base;
            c.size          = m.size;
            c.protect       = m.protect;
            c.exact         = (m.flags & ITTD_MAP_F_EXACT) != 0;
            c.other_process = (m.flags & ITTD_MAP_F_OTHER_PROCESS) != 0;
            c.in_module     = (m.flags & ITTD_MAP_F_IN_MODULE) != 0;
            c.state         = m.state;
            c.region_type   = m.region_type;
            c.alloc_base    = (ea_t)m.alloc_base;
            changes.push_back(c);
        }

        // Name what the listing shows, once per module: the stub called and
        // the code that wanted the memory. Modules are otherwise named only
        // when stopped in, which most of these never were.
        //
        // A PDB only where that code is in a library: there exports name the
        // wrong function (allocations come from internal helpers). Applying a
        // PDB blocks IDA (combase's takes a dozen seconds), so libraries the
        // chains merely pass through get exports only, for the call chain
        // column.
        {
            std::set<ea_t> exports, pdbs;
            for ( const RegionChange &c : changes )
            {
                ea_t lo = 0, hi = 0;
                if ( c.api != BADADDR && mgr->modules().range_at(c.api, lo, hi) )
                    exports.insert(lo);
                for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < c.chain_n; k++ )
                    if ( c.chain[k] != BADADDR && mgr->modules().range_at(c.chain[k], lo, hi) )
                        exports.insert(lo);
                ea_t origin = chain_origin(mgr, c);
                if ( origin != BADADDR && mgr->modules().range_at(origin, lo, hi) )
                {
                    exports.insert(lo);
                    if ( mgr->modules().is_library_address(origin) )
                        pdbs.insert(lo);
                }
            }
            if ( !exports.empty() )
            {
                show_wait_box_now("HIDECANCEL\nNaming the code the memory calls came from...");
                size_t done = 0;
                for ( ea_t b : exports )
                {
                    replace_wait_box("HIDECANCEL\nNaming the code the memory calls came from: %s (%u of %u)...",
                                     mgr->modules().name_at(b).c_str(), (unsigned)++done,
                                     (unsigned)exports.size());
                    repaint_wait_box();
                    mgr->modules().resolve_symbols(b);
                    if ( pdbs.count(b) != 0 )
                        mgr->modules().load_pdb(b);    // silent and deduplicated
                }
                hide_wait_box();
            }
        }

        if ( out != nullptr )
            out->set_changes(std::move(changes));
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        if ( qr.truncated )
            msg("[ida-ttd] memory map: hit the change limit; the map is incomplete.\n");
        return true;
    }

    bool session_memory_map(TraceManager *mgr, bool rebuild, bool *cancelled, qstring *error)
    {
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = false;
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() )
            return build_memory_map(mgr, nullptr, cancelled, error);    // says why
        if ( !rebuild && !mgr->memmap_for_update().empty() )
            return true;
        // Built aside, so a failure keeps the map the session had.
        MemoryMap fresh;
        bool stopped = false;
        if ( !build_memory_map(mgr, &fresh, &stopped, error) )
            return false;
        // The build pumps the UI, so the session may have ended meanwhile.
        if ( !mgr->is_active() )
        {
            if ( error != nullptr )
                *error = "the replay session ended while the memory map was built";
            return false;
        }
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = stopped;
        MemoryMap &map = mgr->memmap_for_update();
        map = std::move(fresh);
        if ( map.empty() )
            return true;
        if ( !stopped )
            map.save(mgr->trace_fingerprint());
        else
            msg("[ida-ttd] memory map: the sweep was cancelled, so the partial "
                "map is used for this session but not saved.\n");
        // The regions at the current position may be new to IDA (it had all
        // of user space as one segment, or an older map's regions).
        invalidate_dbgmem_config();
        refresh_idaview_anyway();
        return true;
    }

    ea_t chain_origin(TraceManager *mgr, const RegionChange &c)
    {
        if ( mgr == nullptr || c.chain_n == 0 )
            return BADADDR;

        // The first frame that is not library code: the analyzed binary, or an
        // address in no module (code the recording allocated and ran, the case
        // that matters most in malware).
        for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < c.chain_n; k++ )
        {
            if ( c.chain[k] != BADADDR && !mgr->modules().is_library_address(c.chain[k]) )
                return c.chain[k];
        }

        // All library code: take the first frame outside the syscall caller's
        // module (for a heap allocation, the CRT's malloc rather than ntdll).
        ea_t lo0 = 0, hi0 = 0;
        if ( !mgr->modules().range_at(c.chain[0], lo0, hi0) )
            return c.chain[c.chain_n - 1];
        for ( uint8_t k = 1; k < c.chain_n; k++ )
        {
            ea_t lo = 0, hi = 0;
            if ( c.chain[k] != BADADDR
              && mgr->modules().range_at(c.chain[k], lo, hi) && lo != lo0 )
            {
                return c.chain[k];
            }
        }
        // The whole chain is in one module (a DLL allocating for itself): the
        // outermost recorded frame is the best answer.
        return c.chain[c.chain_n - 1];
    }

    uint64_t trace_fingerprint(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        return mgr != nullptr ? mgr->trace_fingerprint() : 0;
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/memmap.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/position.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class TraceManager;

    // The recording's memory map, reconstructed from the syscalls that built
    // it. The TTD Replay SDK reports no protections or region list, so for a
    // Microsoft recording the calls are the only source; Sogen also records
    // region state (RC_STATE).
    //
    // Held as a timeline (every allocation, protection change and free, in
    // order), not a snapshot: folding it up to a position gives the map as it
    // stood then, since an address can mean different things over time.

    // What one recorded change did.
    enum : uint8_t
    {
        RC_ALLOC = 0,     // NtAllocateVirtualMemory
        RC_PROTECT,       // NtProtectVirtualMemory
        RC_FREE,          // NtFreeVirtualMemory
        RC_MAPVIEW,       // NtMapViewOfSection
        RC_UNMAPVIEW,     // NtUnmapViewOfSection
        // Not a call but its outcome, from a backend that records region
        // bookkeeping (Sogen): [base, base + size) is now in 'state' with
        // 'protect'. Folding it overwrites the range.
        RC_STATE,
        RC_COUNT
    };
    const char *change_name(uint8_t kind);

    // The call-chain frame to attribute an allocation to: the first that is
    // not library code (the analyzed binary, or code in no module, i.e. code
    // the recording allocated and ran). Falls back to the first frame outside
    // the syscall caller's module. BADADDR when the chain is empty.
    ea_t chain_origin(TraceManager *mgr, const struct RegionChange &c);

    // Windows page protection helpers. PAGE_* values are a stable ABI, so these
    // work on any recording.
    qstring protection_text(uint32_t protect);   // "RWX", "R--", "R-X (guard)", ...
    uchar   protection_perm(uint32_t protect);   // SEGPERM_* mask

    struct RegionChange
    {
        Position pos;                            // where the syscall returned
        // Where it was called: what the listing travels to, since the return
        // lands inside the syscall stub rather than in the code that asked.
        Position call_pos;
        uint32_t tid  = 0;
        ea_t     pc   = BADADDR;                 // the caller, for the listing
        uint8_t  kind = RC_ALLOC;
        // Runtime address of the syscall stub called, so the listing can name
        // it (and tell the two ntdlls of a WoW64 recording apart).
        ea_t     api = BADADDR;
        // The call chain, innermost first: chain[0] called the syscall, then
        // one frame per module boundary crossed. A heap allocation can be
        // twenty frames deep in ntdll, so the innermost N frames would not
        // reach the code that wanted the memory.
        static const size_t MAX_CHAIN = 8;
        ea_t     chain[MAX_CHAIN] = { 0 };
        uint8_t  chain_n = 0;
        ea_t     base = BADADDR;
        uint64_t size = 0;                       // 0 on a whole-region release
        uint32_t protect = 0;                    // PAGE_* (or the free type)
        // False when the kernel's value was not recovered and the caller's
        // request was snapped to pages instead (a floor, never too large).
        bool     exact = true;
        // The call targeted another process: listed so injection is visible,
        // never folded into this process's map.
        bool     other_process = false;
        // The range lies inside a loaded module. Only used for RC_PROTECT: it
        // decides whether a change with no known allocation makes a region.
        bool     in_module = false;
        // For RC_STATE: MEM_COMMIT, MEM_RESERVE or MEM_FREE; the ITTD_REGION_*
        // kind of memory; and the allocation's base. Zero for the others.
        uint32_t state = 0;
        uint32_t region_type = 0;
        ea_t     alloc_base = 0;
    };

    // One region as it stands at some position.
    struct Region
    {
        ea_t     base = 0;
        uint64_t size = 0;
        uint32_t protect = 0;
        uint8_t  origin = RC_ALLOC;   // RC_ALLOC, RC_MAPVIEW or RC_PROTECT
        // ITTD_REGION_*: from the recording when it says (Sogen), else implied
        // by the call that made it.
        uint32_t type = 0;
        bool     reserved = false;    // reserved, not committed (when known)
        // Base of the allocation or view this is (part of): a protection
        // change splits a region into pieces, and a whole-region release must
        // drop every one of them, not just the piece holding the address.
        ea_t     alloc = 0;
        // Position of the call that made the region (what a listing travels
        // to); for RC_STATE, the position the region first appeared at.
        Position since = Position::none();
        ea_t     end() const { return (ea_t)(base + size); }
    };

    class MemoryMap
    {
    public:
        bool   empty() const { return m_changes.empty(); }
        size_t size() const  { return m_changes.size(); }
        const RegionChange &at(size_t i) const { return m_changes[i]; }
        void   set_changes(std::vector<RegionChange> v);
        void   clear();

        // How many changes lie at or before 'pos' (all of them for an invalid
        // position). Two positions with the same count fold to the same map,
        // so this is what a cache of the fold is keyed by.
        size_t count_at(const Position &pos) const;
        // Fold the first 'n' changes into a sorted, non-overlapping region
        // list. Called on stops, so the fold is cached: moving forward
        // applies only the changes crossed, and moving backward starts from
        // the nearest checkpoint before the target instead of the beginning.
        void state_upto(size_t n, std::vector<Region> &out) const;
        // The same up to and including 'pos'; an invalid position folds all
        // of it.
        void state_at(const Position &pos, std::vector<Region> &out) const
        { state_upto(count_at(pos), out); }

        // ---- persistence in the database ----------------------------------
        //
        // A sweep costs a full replay, so its result is kept. 'fingerprint'
        // names the recording it came from; against a different one the map
        // is rebuilt.
        void save(uint64_t fingerprint) const;
        bool load(uint64_t fingerprint);
        static void erase();

    private:
        std::vector<RegionChange> m_changes;   // sorted by position

        // Incremental fold state, derivable from m_changes alone (hence
        // mutable: state_at() is logically a query).
        mutable std::map<ea_t, Region> m_live;
        mutable size_t                 m_liveIdx = 0;   // changes applied so far
        mutable bool                   m_liveValid = false;
        // The fold after every checkpoint_every() changes, in order, made as
        // the fold first passes them. At most about 64, so a recording that
        // allocates in a loop does not keep thousands of copies.
        mutable std::vector<std::pair<size_t, std::map<ea_t, Region>>> m_checkpoints;
        size_t checkpoint_every() const;
        void   drop_fold();
    };

    // Ask the backend for every allocation, protection change and free
    // (ITraceBackend::query_mapping_changes): Microsoft TTD reconstructs them
    // from the memory syscalls, Sogen reads the map it recorded.
    //
    // Shows a cancellable progress box; safe from a UI action. False when
    // there is no trace or the backend could not answer.
    //
    // Modifies the database so the listing can name callers: applies export
    // names to the modules holding the called stubs and the attributed callers
    // (chain_origin), and loads PDBs for those callers in library modules.
    //
    // A failure is returned in 'error', never shown in a dialog (which would
    // hang a script): the caller shows it.
    bool build_memory_map(TraceManager *mgr, MemoryMap *out, bool *cancelled, qstring *error = nullptr);

    // The session's memory map: the one IDA's segments, the Memory map
    // listings and every script command read. Built if the session has none
    // (or 'rebuild'), then saved in the database unless cancelled, and IDA is
    // told its segments may have changed. A failed build leaves the map the
    // session had. 'error' as for build_memory_map.
    bool session_memory_map(TraceManager *mgr, bool rebuild, bool *cancelled, qstring *error = nullptr);

    // Identity of the loaded trace, for the persistence check above.
    uint64_t trace_fingerprint(TraceManager *mgr);
}
```

`src/analysis/memsearch.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/memsearch.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include "debugger/trace_manager.h"

namespace idattd
{
    const char *access_name(uint8_t kind)
    {
        switch ( kind )
        {
            case ACC_READ:  return "Read";
            case ACC_WRITE: return "Write";
            case ACC_EXEC:  return "Execute";
            default:        return "?";
        }
    }

    bool search_memory(TraceManager *mgr, ea_t lo, ea_t hi, uint8_t mask,
                       std::vector<MemAccess> *out, bool *truncated, bool *cancelled,
                       qstring *error)
    {
        qstring ignored;
        if ( error == nullptr )
            error = &ignored;
        if ( out != nullptr )
            out->clear();
        if ( truncated != nullptr )
            *truncated = false;
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = false;

        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
        {
            *error = "Memory searching is only available while replaying a trace.";
            return false;
        }
        if ( lo >= hi || mask == 0 )
        {
            *error = "Nothing to search for: give a non-empty range and at least "
                     "one of read, write or execute.";
            return false;
        }

        ITraceBackend *backend = mgr->backend();
        if ( !backend->capabilities().access_queries )
        {
            *error = "This recording's backend cannot list memory accesses.";
            return false;
        }
        std::vector<Access> found;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Searching the recording for accesses", [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return backend->query_accesses(lo, hi, mask, PositionRange{}, &found, p);
        });
        if ( !qr.ran )
        {
            *error = query_error(mgr, backend, qr, "The replay session ended during the search.",
                                 "This recording's backend could not search for accesses.");
            return false;
        }

        // ACC_* and ACCESS_* are the same bits.
        std::vector<MemAccess> hits;
        hits.reserve(found.size());
        for ( const Access &x : found )
        {
            MemAccess a;
            a.pos  = x.pos;
            a.tid  = x.tid;
            a.pc   = x.pc;
            a.addr = x.addr;
            a.size = x.size;
            a.kind = x.kind;
            hits.push_back(a);
        }

        if ( out != nullptr )
            *out = std::move(hits);
        if ( truncated != nullptr )
            *truncated = qr.truncated;
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/memsearch.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/position.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class TraceManager;

    // What a search looks for: the plugin's own bits, not the engine's (equal
    // to the core's ACCESS_* values).
    enum : uint8_t
    {
        ACC_READ  = 1,
        ACC_WRITE = 2,
        ACC_EXEC  = 4,
    };

    // One recorded touch of the watched range.
    struct MemAccess
    {
        Position pos{};
        uint32_t tid  = 0;
        ea_t     pc   = BADADDR;   // the instruction that did it
        ea_t     addr = BADADDR;   // the address it touched
        uint32_t size = 0;
        uint8_t  kind = 0;         // one of ACC_*
    };

    // Replay the recording and collect every access to [lo, hi) matching
    // 'mask'. A watchpoint is maskable, so the engine skips stretches that
    // cannot touch the range. Behind a cancellable wait box.
    //
    // False when it could not run, with the reason in 'error' (no dialog: the
    // caller shows it). 'truncated' (the record cap was hit) and 'cancelled'
    // both leave 'out' holding what was gathered.
    bool search_memory(TraceManager *mgr, ea_t lo, ea_t hi, uint8_t mask,
                       std::vector<MemAccess> *out, bool *truncated, bool *cancelled,
                       qstring *error);

    // Human-readable name for an ACC_* value ("Read", "Write", "Execute").
    const char *access_name(uint8_t kind);
}
```
