`src/analysis/syscalls.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/syscalls.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include "debugger/trace_manager.h"
#include "debugger/apidecode.h"
#include "analysis/trace_store.h"
#include "analysis/batched_memory.h"

namespace idattd
{
    bool list_syscalls(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SyscallEvent> *out, bool *cancelled)
    {
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = false;
        if ( out != nullptr )
            out->clear();
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return false;
        ITraceBackend *backend = mgr->backend();
        if ( !backend->capabilities().syscalls )
            return false;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Listing the recording's syscalls", [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return backend->query_syscalls(out, p);
        });
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        return qr.ran;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Every syscall decoded, once
    //=======================================================================

    static DecodeStats g_decodeStats;
    const DecodeStats &last_decode_stats() { return g_decodeStats; }

    static double seconds_since(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point t0)
    {
        return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
    }

    bool decode_syscalls(TraceManager *mgr, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                         std::vector<qstring> *decoded, bool *cancelled)
    {
        const auto t_start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        DecodeStats &st = g_decodeStats;
        st = DecodeStats{};
        st.calls = calls.size();
        decoded->assign(calls.size(), qstring());
        *cancelled = false;
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
            return false;
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();

        // Signatures looked up here on the main thread (loading the index may
        // print), once per name.
        std::vector<const win32meta::FuncSig *> sigs(calls.size(), nullptr);
        {
            std::map<qstring, const win32meta::FuncSig *> by_name;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
            {
                auto it = by_name.find(calls[i].name);
                if ( it == by_name.end() )
                    it = by_name.emplace(calls[i].name, api_signature(calls[i].name.c_str())).first;
                sigs[i] = it->second;
            }
        }
        // The 64-bit syscall convention: always on Sogen. A Microsoft x86
        // recording has the 32-bit side, with arguments on the stack.
        const bool wide = b->info().is64 || qstrcmp(b->id(), "sogen") == 0;

        QueryResult qr = run_query("Decoding the recording's syscalls", [&](ProgressSink *sink)
        {
            QueryResult r;
            r.ran = true;
            std::vector<Position> where;
            std::vector<size_t>   which;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
                if ( sigs[i] != nullptr )
                {
                    where.push_back(calls[i].pos);
                    which.push_back(i);
                }
            st.with_sig = where.size();
            std::vector<ittd_regs> regs;
            StageSink regs_stage(sink, 0, 10);
            auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            b->registers_at(where, &regs, &regs_stage);
            st.t_regs = seconds_since(t0);
            if ( regs_stage.cancelled() )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            BatchedMemory mem;


            // ---- the arguments, at each call ----------------------------
            // At the syscall instruction, rcx is in r10 and the stack is one
            // return address deep (two on x86: into the stub, then the stub's
            // own). Shown as the call site sees them, as the decoder expects.
            std::vector<DecodedCall> dc(which.size());
            std::vector<size_t> with_regs;
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < which.size(); k++ )
                if ( k < regs.size() && (regs[k].have & ITTD_REGS_GP) != 0 )
                    with_regs.push_back(k);
            st.with_regs = with_regs.size();
            // The registers a call's arguments are read with: at the syscall
            // instruction rcx is in r10 and the stack one return address deep.
            auto call_regs = [&](size_t k)
            {
                ittd_regs g = regs[k];
                if ( wide )
                    g.gp[ITTD_REG_RCX] = g.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[0]];
                g.gp[ITTD_REG_RSP] += 8;
                return g;
            };

            // Where the backend can visit positions (Microsoft TTD), each call
            // is read once: its arguments at the call, every pointer followed
            // there, then just after it (a short step of the same cursor) the
            // reads its results take, recorded and replayed once the
            // out-value search below is done. The batched reads instead pay a
            // round of seeks per level of pointers, and another for the
            // results: 55 s for test-sample.run's 2,232 syscalls. Others keep
            // the rounds (Sogen answers a batch in one pass of the recording).
            using ReadKey  = std::pair<uint64_t, size_t>;
            using ReadMemo = std::map<ReadKey, std::pair<std::vector<uint8_t>, size_t>>;
            std::vector<ReadMemo> after_reads(dc.size());
            bool visited = false;
            t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            bool args_done = true;
            {
                std::vector<Position> at, next;
                at.reserve(with_regs.size());
                next.reserve(with_regs.size());
                // The step past a call only where its signature has out
                // parameters: the rest have no results to read there.
                for ( size_t k : with_regs )
                {
                    at.push_back(calls[which[k]].pos);
                    next.push_back(api_has_out_params(*sigs[which[k]])
                                   ? b->position_add(calls[which[k]].pos, 1) : Position::none());
                }
                StageSink visit_stage(sink, 10, 75);
                const QueryResult vr = b->visit_positions(at, &next,
                    [&](size_t i, int phase, const ITraceBackend::VisitRead &read)
                {
                    const size_t k = with_regs[i];
                    if ( phase == 0 )
                    {
                        const ittd_regs g = call_regs(k);
                        GuestView v;
                        v.read = read;
                        v.regs = [g](ittd_regs *out) { *out = g; return true; };
                        DecodedCall d;
                        decode_api_args(v, *sigs[which[k]], wide, &d);
                        dc[k] = std::move(d);
                        return;
                    }
                    bool outs = false;
                    for ( const DecodedArg &a : dc[k].args )
                        outs = outs || (a.out && a.raw != 0);
                    if ( !outs )
                        return;
                    // What decoding the results reads here, kept for later.
                    ReadMemo &memo = after_reads[k];
                    GuestView v;
                    v.read = [&memo, &read](uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t size) -> size_t
                    {
                        const size_t got = read(addr, buf, size);
                        const uint8_t *q = static_cast<const uint8_t *>(buf);
                        memo[ReadKey(addr, size)] = { std::vector<uint8_t>(q, q + size), got };
                        return got;
                    };
                    v.regs = [](ittd_regs *) { return false; };
                    DecodedCall probe = dc[k];
                    decode_api_outs(v, &probe);
                }, &visit_stage);
                if ( vr.ran )
                {
                    visited = true;
                    args_done = !vr.cancelled;
                    st.rounds_args = 1;
                }
            }
            if ( !visited )
                args_done = decode_in_rounds(mem, b, sink, with_regs, [&](size_t k)
                {
                    const SyscallEvent &c = calls[which[k]];
                    const ittd_regs g = call_regs(k);
                    GuestView v;
                    v.read = mem.reader(c.pos);
                    v.regs = [g](ittd_regs *out) { *out = g; return true; };
                    DecodedCall d;
                    decode_api_args(v, *sigs[which[k]], wide, &d);
                    dc[k] = std::move(d);
                }, 10, 50, &st.rounds_args);
            st.t_args = seconds_since(t0);
            if ( !args_done )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }

            // ---- what the kernel wrote back -------------------------------
            // Integers and handles from the backend's search where it has one
            // (Microsoft TTD); the rest from memory just after the call.
            std::vector<OutSlot> slots;
            std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>> slot_of;     // (call k, parameter)
            for ( size_t k : with_regs )
            {
                const SyscallEvent &c = calls[which[k]];
                for ( const auto &[param, width] : api_int_outs(dc[k]) )
                {
                    OutSlot s;
                    s.call   = c.pos;
                    s.addr   = (ea_t)dc[k].args[param].raw;
                    s.tid    = c.tid;
                    s.width  = width;
                    s.before = dc[k].args[param].pointee_before.value_or(0);
                    slots.push_back(s);
                    slot_of.emplace_back(k, param);
                }
            }
            std::vector<std::optional<uint64_t>> values;
            StageSink outs_stage(sink, 50, 75);
            st.out_slots = slots.size();
            t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            const bool searched = !slots.empty() && b->query_out_values(slots, &values, &outs_stage);
            st.t_search = seconds_since(t0);
            if ( sink != nullptr && sink->cancelled() )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            if ( searched )
                for ( size_t i = 0; i < slots.size() && i < values.size(); i++ )
                {
                    DecodedCall &d = dc[slot_of[i].first];
                    d.out_values.resize(d.args.size());
                    d.out_values[slot_of[i].second] = values[i];
                }

            // ---- the out parameters, just after each call -----------------
            std::vector<DecodedCall> after(dc.size());
            std::vector<size_t> needs_memory;
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < dc.size(); k++ )
            {
                const DecodedCall &d = dc[k];
                if ( d.sig == nullptr )
                    continue;
                bool needs = false;
                for ( size_t p = 0; p < d.args.size(); p++ )
                    if ( d.args[p].out && d.args[p].raw != 0
                      && !(p < d.out_values.size() && d.out_values[p].has_value()) )
                        needs = true;
                if ( needs )
                {
                    needs_memory.push_back(k);
                    continue;
                }
                after[k] = d;
                decode_api_outs(GuestView{}, &after[k]);
            }
            std::vector<Position> one_on(dc.size(), Position::none());
            for ( size_t k : needs_memory )
                one_on[k] = b->position_add(calls[which[k]].pos, 1);
            st.needs_after = needs_memory.size();
            t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            bool outs_done = true;
            if ( visited )
            {
                // From what the visits read just after each call. The
                // search's values only spare reads, never add any, so what was
                // recorded covers this decoding; a read not recorded reads as
                // unknown.
                for ( size_t k : needs_memory )
                {
                    const ReadMemo &memo = after_reads[k];
                    GuestView v;
                    v.read = [&memo](uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t size) -> size_t
                    {
                        memset(buf, 0, size);
                        auto it = memo.find(ReadKey(addr, size));
                        if ( it == memo.end() )
                            return 0;
                        memcpy(buf, it->second.first.data(), std::min(size, it->second.first.size()));
                        return it->second.second;
                    };
                    v.regs = [](ittd_regs *) { return false; };
                    after[k] = dc[k];
                    decode_api_outs(v, &after[k]);
                }
                st.rounds_after = 1;
            }
            else
                outs_done = decode_in_rounds(mem, b, sink, needs_memory, [&](size_t k)
                {
                    GuestView v;
                    v.read = mem.reader(one_on[k]);
                    v.regs = [](ittd_regs *) { return false; };
                    after[k] = dc[k];
                    decode_api_outs(v, &after[k]);
                }, 75, 100, &st.rounds_after);
            st.t_after = seconds_since(t0);
            st.fetches   = mem.stats().fetches;
            st.blocks    = mem.stats().blocks;
            st.positions = mem.stats().positions;
            st.t_fetch   = mem.stats().seconds;
            if ( !outs_done )
            {
                r.cancelled = true;
                return r;
            }
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < after.size(); k++ )
                if ( after[k].sig != nullptr )
                    (*decoded)[which[k]] = api_args_text(after[k]);
            return r;
        });
        *cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        if ( qr.cancelled )
            decoded->assign(calls.size(), qstring());
        st.t_total = seconds_since(t_start);
        return qr.ran;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // In the database
    //=======================================================================
    static const char     SC_NODE[]  = "$ ida-ttd syscalls";
    static const uchar    SC_TAG     = 'S';
    static const uint32_t SC_VERSION = 1;

    static void put_str(bytevec_t *b, const qstring &s)
    {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)s.length();
        b->append(&n, sizeof(n));
        b->append(s.c_str(), n);
    }

    static bool get_str(const uchar **p, const uchar *end, qstring *s)
    {
        uint32_t n = 0;
        if ( end - *p < (ptrdiff_t)sizeof(n) )
            return false;
        memcpy(&n, *p, sizeof(n));
        *p += sizeof(n);
        if ( end - *p < (ptrdiff_t)n )
            return false;
        s->qclear();
        s->append((const char *)*p, n);
        *p += n;
        return true;
    }

    void save_syscalls(const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls, const std::vector<qstring> &decoded)
    {
        bytevec_t b;
        uint32_t ver = SC_VERSION, n = (uint32_t)calls.size();
        b.append(&ver, sizeof(ver));
        b.append(&n, sizeof(n));
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
        {
            const SyscallEvent &c = calls[i];
            uint64_t words[3] = { c.pos.hi, c.pos.lo, c.result };
            uint32_t small[2] = { c.number, c.tid };
            b.append(words, sizeof(words));
            b.append(small, sizeof(small));
            put_str(&b, c.name);
            put_str(&b, i < decoded.size() ? decoded[i] : qstring());
        }
        netnode nn(SC_NODE, 0, true);
        if ( nn == BADNODE )
            return;
        nn.delblob(0, SC_TAG);
        nn.setblob(b.begin(), b.size(), 0, SC_TAG);
        trace_store_stamp(nn);
    }

    bool load_syscalls(std::vector<SyscallEvent> *calls, std::vector<qstring> *decoded)
    {
        calls->clear();
        decoded->clear();
        netnode nn(SC_NODE);
        if ( nn == BADNODE || !trace_store_matches(nn) )
            return false;
        bytevec_t b;
        if ( nn.getblob(&b, 0, SC_TAG) <= 0 )
            return false;
        const uchar *p = b.begin(), *end = b.end();
        uint32_t ver = 0, n = 0;
        if ( end - p < 8 )
            return false;
        memcpy(&ver, p, 4);
        memcpy(&n, p + 4, 4);
        p += 8;
        if ( ver != SC_VERSION )
            return false;
        for ( uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++ )
        {
            SyscallEvent c;
            uint64_t words[3];
            uint32_t small[2];
            qstring  text;
            // A truncated blob yields nothing rather than a prefix that would
            // look complete.
            if ( end - p < (ptrdiff_t)(sizeof(words) + sizeof(small)) )
            {
                calls->clear();
                decoded->clear();
                return false;
            }
            memcpy(words, p, sizeof(words));
            p += sizeof(words);
            memcpy(small, p, sizeof(small));
            p += sizeof(small);
            c.pos    = Position{ words[0], words[1] };
            c.result = words[2];
            c.number = small[0];
            c.tid    = small[1];
            if ( !get_str(&p, end, &c.name) || !get_str(&p, end, &text) )
            {
                calls->clear();
                decoded->clear();
                return false;
            }
            calls->push_back(std::move(c));
            decoded->push_back(std::move(text));
        }
        return true;
    }

    bool find_self_modifying(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SelfModHit> *out, bool *cancelled)
    {
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = false;
        if ( out != nullptr )
            out->clear();
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return false;
        ITraceBackend *backend = mgr->backend();
        if ( !backend->capabilities().self_modifying )
            return false;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Looking for code the program wrote and then ran", [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return backend->query_self_modifying(out, p);
        });
        if ( cancelled != nullptr )
            *cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        return qr.ran;
    }

    void syscall_arguments(ITraceBackend *backend, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                           size_t first, size_t count,
                           std::vector<std::optional<SyscallArgs>> *out)
    {
        out->clear();
        if ( backend == nullptr || first >= calls.size() )
            return;
        count = std::min(count, calls.size() - first);
        std::vector<Position> where;
        where.reserve(count);
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
            where.push_back(calls[first + i].pos);
        std::vector<ittd_regs> regs;
        backend->registers_at(where, &regs, nullptr);
        out->resize(count);
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < count && i < regs.size(); i++ )
        {
            const ittd_regs &r = regs[i];
            if ( (r.have & ITTD_REGS_GP) == 0 )
                continue;
            (*out)[i] = SyscallArgs{ r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[0]], r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[1]],
                                     r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[2]], r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[3]] };
        }
    }

    bool undecoded_syscall_arguments(TraceManager *mgr, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                                     const std::vector<qstring> &decoded,
                                     std::vector<std::optional<SyscallArgs>> *out)
    {
        out->assign(calls.size(), std::nullopt);
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
            return false;
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();
        std::vector<Position> where;
        std::vector<size_t>   which;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
            if ( i >= decoded.size() || decoded[i].empty() )
            {
                where.push_back(calls[i].pos);
                which.push_back(i);
            }
        if ( where.empty() )
            return true;
        std::vector<ittd_regs> regs;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Reading the undecoded syscalls' registers", [&](ProgressSink *sink)
        {
            QueryResult r;
            r.ran = true;
            b->registers_at(where, &regs, sink);
            r.cancelled = sink != nullptr && sink->cancelled();
            return r;
        });
        if ( !qr.ran || qr.cancelled )
            return false;
        for ( size_t k = 0; k < which.size() && k < regs.size(); k++ )
        {
            const ittd_regs &r = regs[k];
            if ( (r.have & ITTD_REGS_GP) != 0 )
                (*out)[which[k]] = SyscallArgs{ r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[0]], r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[1]],
                                                r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[2]], r.gp[SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[3]] };
        }
        return true;
    }

    const char *ntstatus_name(uint32_t status)
    {
        switch ( status )
        {
            case 0x00000000: return "STATUS_SUCCESS";
            case 0x00000102: return "STATUS_TIMEOUT";
            case 0x00000103: return "STATUS_PENDING";
            case 0x80000005: return "STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW";
            case 0x80000006: return "STATUS_NO_MORE_FILES";
            case 0x8000001A: return "STATUS_NO_MORE_ENTRIES";
            case 0xC0000001: return "STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL";
            case 0xC0000002: return "STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED";
            case 0xC0000003: return "STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS";
            case 0xC0000004: return "STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH";
            case 0xC0000005: return "STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION";
            case 0xC0000008: return "STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE";
            case 0xC000000D: return "STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER";
            case 0xC000000F: return "STATUS_NO_SUCH_FILE";
            case 0xC0000017: return "STATUS_NO_MEMORY";
            case 0xC0000018: return "STATUS_CONFLICTING_ADDRESSES";
            case 0xC0000022: return "STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED";
            case 0xC0000023: return "STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL";
            case 0xC0000024: return "STATUS_OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH";
            case 0xC0000033: return "STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_INVALID";
            case 0xC0000034: return "STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND";
            case 0xC0000035: return "STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_COLLISION";
            case 0xC000003A: return "STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND";
            case 0xC0000045: return "STATUS_INVALID_PAGE_PROTECTION";
            case 0xC00000BB: return "STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED";
            case 0xC0000135: return "STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND";
            case 0xC0000139: return "STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND";
            case 0xC0000225: return "STATUS_NOT_FOUND";
            default:         return nullptr;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/syscalls.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/backend.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class TraceManager;

    // The recording's syscalls (capabilities().syscalls: Sogen records them;
    // on Microsoft TTD they are the transitions into the kernel). Behind a
    // cancellable wait box. False when it could not run; when cancelled,
    // 'out' holds what was gathered.
    bool list_syscalls(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SyscallEvent> *out, bool *cancelled);

    // ITTD_REG_* of an x64 syscall's first four arguments at the syscall
    // instruction: r10, rdx, r8, r9 (the stub copies rcx to r10, since the
    // instruction overwrites rcx). The fifth on is at [rsp+0x28], past the
    // return address and the 32-byte home area.
    constexpr int SYSCALL_ARG_REGS[4] = { ITTD_REG_R8 + 2, ITTD_REG_RDX, ITTD_REG_R8, ITTD_REG_R8 + 1 };

    // The first four arguments (SYSCALL_ARG_REGS) of each syscall in
    // [first, first + count); empty where the registers were not recovered.
    using SyscallArgs = std::array<uint64_t, 4>;
    void syscall_arguments(ITraceBackend *backend, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                           size_t first, size_t count,
                           std::vector<std::optional<SyscallArgs>> *out);

    // The same registers for every call left undecoded (decoded[i] empty), in
    // one batch behind a cancellable wait box, for a listing to show without
    // reading the recording as rows are drawn. out[i] is empty for a decoded
    // call, or where the registers were not recovered. False when nothing was
    // read (no session, or cancelled).
    bool undecoded_syscall_arguments(TraceManager *mgr, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                                     const std::vector<qstring> &decoded,
                                     std::vector<std::optional<SyscallArgs>> *out);

    // Every syscall's arguments decoded from the native API metadata (phnt):
    // decoded[i] is "name=value, ..." for calls[i], empty without a
    // signature. Arguments are read at the call, out values after it. Behind
    // a cancellable wait box; cancelling leaves 'decoded' empty.
    bool decode_syscalls(TraceManager *mgr, const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls,
                         std::vector<qstring> *decoded, bool *cancelled);

    // Where the last decode_syscalls spent its time (an.decode reports it).
    struct DecodeStats
    {
        size_t   calls = 0, with_sig = 0, with_regs = 0, out_slots = 0, needs_after = 0;
        int      rounds_args = 0, rounds_after = 0;
        double   t_regs = 0, t_args = 0, t_search = 0, t_after = 0, t_total = 0;
        uint64_t fetches = 0, blocks = 0, positions = 0;
        double   t_fetch = 0;
    };
    const DecodeStats &last_decode_stats();
    // The list and its decoding, kept in the database against the recording.
    void save_syscalls(const std::vector<SyscallEvent> &calls, const std::vector<qstring> &decoded);
    bool load_syscalls(std::vector<SyscallEvent> *calls, std::vector<qstring> *decoded);

    // Every instruction the program wrote before running it
    // (capabilities().self_modifying). One pass over the recording behind a
    // cancellable wait box.
    bool find_self_modifying(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SelfModHit> *out, bool *cancelled);

    // "STATUS_SUCCESS"-style name of a common NTSTATUS, else nullptr.
    const char *ntstatus_name(uint32_t status);
}
```

`src/analysis/trace_store.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/trace_store.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // The fingerprint's tag. It must not collide with any store's own tags;
    // none uses 'z'.
    static const uchar TS_FP_TAG = 'z';
    static const nodeidx_t TS_FP_VALUE   = 0;   // alt 0 -> the fingerprint
    static const nodeidx_t TS_FP_PRESENT = 1;   // alt 1 -> it has been written

    // Not in the database: it describes the session.
    static uint64_t g_current_trace = 0;

    void set_current_trace(uint64_t fingerprint)
    {
        g_current_trace = fingerprint;
    }

    uint64_t current_trace()
    {
        return g_current_trace;
    }

    bool trace_store_matches(netnode &node)
    {
        if ( g_current_trace == 0 || node == BADNODE )
            return true;                // nothing to judge it against
        // A fingerprint of zero is a legal value, so presence is recorded
        // separately rather than inferred from the value being non-zero.
        if ( node.altval(TS_FP_PRESENT, TS_FP_TAG) == 0 )
            return true;                // written before this check existed
        return (uint64_t)node.altval(TS_FP_VALUE, TS_FP_TAG) == g_current_trace;
    }

    void trace_store_stamp(netnode &node)
    {
        if ( g_current_trace == 0 || node == BADNODE )
            return;
        node.altset(TS_FP_VALUE, (nodeidx_t)g_current_trace, TS_FP_TAG);
        node.altset(TS_FP_PRESENT, 1, TS_FP_TAG);
    }

    void trace_store_reset(netnode &node, const uchar *tags, size_t ntags)
    {
        if ( node == BADNODE )
            return;
        for ( size_t t = 0; t < ntags; t++ )
        {
            const uchar tag = tags[t];
            // Deleting invalidates the iteration: read the next index first.
            for ( nodeidx_t i = node.altfirst(tag); i != BADNODE; )
            {
                nodeidx_t next = node.altnext(i, tag);
                node.altdel(i, tag);
                i = next;
            }
            for ( nodeidx_t i = node.supfirst(tag); i != BADNODE; )
            {
                nodeidx_t next = node.supnext(i, tag);
                node.supdel(i, tag);
                i = next;
            }
        }
        trace_store_stamp(node);
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/trace_store.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // Which recording the analysis results kept in the database belong to.
    //
    // A database outlives any one trace. After the binary is recorded again,
    // an "already measured" mark or an indirect-call target describes an
    // execution that no longer exists, yet looks valid. MemoryMap carries its
    // own fingerprint; this is the same check for stores made of a few
    // netnode tags.
    //
    // The plugin sets this when a session starts and clears it when one ends.
    // Zero means no trace is loaded, and then nothing is discarded: stored
    // results are only judged against an open recording.
    void     set_current_trace(uint64_t fingerprint);
    uint64_t current_trace();

    // Has 'node' been written against the loaded recording? False only when
    // it holds results from a different one; true when it matches, when it is
    // empty or unstamped, and when no trace is loaded.
    bool trace_store_matches(netnode &node);

    // Record the loaded recording as the one 'node' now holds results for.
    void trace_store_stamp(netnode &node);

    // Delete every alt and blob in 'node' under each of 'tags', then stamp it
    // with the loaded recording. Only for contents that can simply be thrown
    // away: a store that also wrote comments or colors must undo those first.
    void trace_store_reset(netnode &node, const uchar *tags, size_t ntags);
}
```

`src/analysis/tracer.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis/tracer.h"
#include "analysis/batched_memory.h"
#include "debugger/callconv.h"
#include "debugger/apidecode.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include "debugger/trace_manager.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // Untyped functions show this many integer arguments.
    static const size_t kUntypedArgs = 4;

    // Raw integer-register argument when no prototype is available.
    static uint64_t raw_int_arg(const GuestView &view, size_t n, bool is64)
    {
        ittd_regs r{};
        if ( !view.regs || !view.regs(&r) )
            return 0;
        if ( is64 )
        {
            const int regs[4] = { ITTD_REG_RCX, ITTD_REG_RDX, ITTD_REG_R8, ITTD_REG_R8 + 1 };
            return n < 4 ? r.gp[regs[n]] : 0;
        }
        uint32_t v = 0;
        view.read((uint32_t)r.gp[ITTD_REG_RSP] + n * 4, &v, sizeof(v));
        return v;
    }

    TracedProto resolve_traced_proto(ModuleRegistry *mods, ea_t func_ea)
    {
        TracedProto p;
        tinfo_t t;
        bool has_type = get_tinfo(&t, func_ea);
        // A picked import slot (__imp_CreateFileW) holds a pointer to the
        // function: its prototype is the pointed-to type.
        if ( has_type && t.is_funcptr() )
            t = t.get_pointed_object();
        has_type = has_type && t.is_func();
        if ( !(has_type && is_userti(func_ea)) )
            p.sig = api_signature(mods, func_ea);
        if ( p.sig == nullptr )
        {
            if ( has_type )
                p.type = t;
            // A guess with nothing in it (no arguments found) is no better
            // than the untyped default, which at least shows the registers.
            else if ( is_code(get_flags(func_ea)) && guess_tinfo(&t, func_ea) == GUESS_FUNC_OK && t.is_func() )
                p.type = t;
            p.have_type = !p.type.empty() && p.type.get_func_details(&p.fd);
        }

        if ( p.sig != nullptr )
        {
            for ( uint8_t i = 0; i < p.sig->paramCount; i++ )
                p.names.push_back(qstring(p.sig->params[i].name));
        }
        else if ( p.have_type )
        {
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < p.fd.size(); i++ )
            {
                qstring nm = p.fd[i].name;
                if ( nm.empty() )
                    nm.sprnt("arg%d", (int)i);
                p.names.push_back(nm);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < kUntypedArgs; i++ )
            {
                qstring nm;
                nm.sprnt("arg%d", (int)i);
                p.names.push_back(nm);
            }
        }
        return p;
    }

    // A pointed-to type that is a UTF-16 character: wchar_t itself, or a
    // typedef of it or of a 16-bit integer that Windows uses for one.
    static bool is_wide_char(const tinfo_t &t, const qstring &printed)
    {
        if ( printed == "wchar_t" || printed == "WCHAR" || printed == "OLECHAR"
          || printed == "wchar16_t" || printed == "char16_t" )
            return true;
        return t.get_realtype(true) == (BT_INT16 | BTMT_CHAR);
    }

    static qstring render_pointer(const GuestView &cur, const tinfo_t &ptr_t, uint64_t ptr)
    {
        tinfo_t pointed = ptr_t.get_ptrarr_object();
        qstring pt;
        pointed.print(&pt);
        pt.replace("const ", "");

        qstring value;
        if ( ptr == 0 )
        {
            value = "NULL";
        }
        else if ( pointed.is_char() )
        {
            qstring s = read_string_at(cur, ptr);
            value.sprnt("0x%llX \"%s\"", (uint64_t)ptr, s.c_str());
        }
        else if ( is_wide_char(pointed, pt) )
        {
            qstring s = read_wstring_at(cur, ptr);
            value.sprnt("0x%llX L\"%s\"", (uint64_t)ptr, s.c_str());
        }
        else
        {
            value.sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)ptr);
        }
        return value;
    }

    // The integer an argument or return value of type 't' really holds: a
    // register carries 64 bits, but an int or a BYTE uses only its low bytes,
    // and the rest is whatever the register held before. Truncated to the
    // type's size and sign-extended when the type is signed (an unknown sign,
    // like plain int's, counts as signed unless the type says unsigned).
    static uint64_t fit_to_type(const tinfo_t &t, uint64_t raw)
    {
        size_t sz = t.get_size();
        if ( sz == 0 || sz >= 8 )
            return raw;                     // includes BADSIZE: nothing to cut
        const unsigned bits = (unsigned)sz * 8;
        uint64_t v = raw & ((1ULL << bits) - 1);
        if ( !t.is_unsigned() && !t.is_bool() && (v >> (bits - 1)) != 0 )
            v |= ~0ULL << bits;
        return v;
    }

    // An integer of type 't', already fitted (fit_to_type): hex, as the
    // untyped values and IDA's listings show numbers, except that a negative
    // value of a signed type reads as a signed decimal ("-1", not
    // "0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF"). A bool is 0 or 1.
    static qstring render_int(const tinfo_t &t, uint64_t v)
    {
        qstring out;
        if ( t.is_bool() )
            out.sprnt("%llu", (unsigned long long)v);
        else if ( !t.is_unsigned() && (int64_t)v < 0 )
            out.sprnt("%lld", (long long)v);
        else
            out.sprnt("0x%llX", (unsigned long long)v);
        return out;
    }

    // An enum value by member name: the member equal to it, else for a
    // bitmask enum the members whose bits it has, joined with '|', with any
    // bits left over in hex. Compared at the enum's width: a 4-byte enum's
    // members are matched against the low 32 bits only.
    static qstring render_enum(const tinfo_t &t, uint64_t raw)
    {
        size_t sz = t.get_size();
        uint64_t mask = sz == 0 || sz >= 8 ? ~0ULL : (1ULL << (sz * 8)) - 1;
        uint64_t v = raw & mask;
        qstring value;
        enum_type_data_t ed;
        if ( t.get_enum_details(&ed) )
        {
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < ed.size(); k++ )
                if ( ((uint64_t)ed[k].value & mask) == v )
                    return qstring(ed[k].name);
            if ( t.is_bitmask_enum() && v != 0 )
            {
                uint64_t rest = v;
                for ( size_t k = 0; k < ed.size(); k++ )
                {
                    uint64_t m = (uint64_t)ed[k].value & mask;
                    if ( m != 0 && (rest & m) == m )
                    {
                        if ( !value.empty() )
                            value.append('|');
                        value.append(ed[k].name);
                        rest &= ~m;
                    }
                }
                if ( !value.empty() )
                {
                    if ( rest != 0 )
                        value.cat_sprnt("|0x%llX", (unsigned long long)rest);
                    return value;
                }
            }
        }
        value.sprnt("0x%llX", (unsigned long long)v);
        return value;
    }

    // Render a single argument value (no type prefix) from the integer fetched
    // at the call site.
    static qstring render_value(const GuestView &cur, const tinfo_t &arg, uint64_t raw)
    {
        qstring value;
        if ( arg.is_ptr_or_array() )
        {
            value = render_pointer(cur, arg, raw);
        }
        else if ( arg.is_enum() )
        {
            value = render_enum(arg, raw);
        }
        else if ( arg.is_floating() )
        {
            // 'raw' holds the argument's bits (XMMn on x64, or the stack slot):
            // reinterpret them. Anything but float or double falls back to hex.
            size_t sz = arg.get_size();
            if ( sz == 4 )
            {
                float    fv;
                uint32_t bits = (uint32_t)raw;
                memcpy(&fv, &bits, sizeof(fv));
                value.sprnt("%g", (double)fv);
            }
            else if ( sz == 8 )
            {
                double dv;
                memcpy(&dv, &raw, sizeof(dv));
                value.sprnt("%g", dv);
            }
            else
            {
                value.sprnt("0x%llX", raw);
            }
        }
        else if ( arg.is_int() || arg.is_bool() || arg.is_char() || arg.is_uchar() )
        {
            value = render_int(arg, fit_to_type(arg, raw));
        }
        else
        {
            value.sprnt("0x%llX", raw);
        }
        return value;
    }

    // One value string per argument of the prototype, or four raw
    // register/stack arguments without one. Values only: the chooser's
    // column headers carry the parameter names.
    static void extract_args(const GuestView &cur, const TracedProto &proto, bool is64,
                             std::vector<qstring> &out)
    {
        out.clear();
        if ( !proto.have_type )
        {
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < kUntypedArgs; i++ )
            {
                qstring v;
                v.sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)raw_int_arg(cur, i, is64));
                out.push_back(v);
            }
            return;
        }
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < proto.fd.size(); i++ )
        {
            uint64_t raw = get_int_arg(cur, proto.fd, i, is64);
            out.push_back(render_value(cur, proto.fd[i].type, raw));
        }
    }

    // "(type)value", the type from the prototype ("int" without one).
    static qstring render_return(const GuestView &cur, const TracedProto &proto, bool is64)
    {
        uint64_t rv = get_return_value(cur, is64);

        qstring type_name = "int";
        qstring value;
        if ( proto.have_type )
        {
            const tinfo_t &rt = proto.fd.rettype;
            rt.print(&type_name);
            if ( rt.is_void() )
            {
                value = "void";
            }
            else if ( rt.is_floating() )
            {
                // Returned in XMM0 (x64) or on the x87 stack (x86, which
                // the register snapshot lacks).
                ittd_regs r{};
                if ( is64 && cur.regs && cur.regs(&r) )
                {
                    uint64_t bits = 0;
                    memcpy(&bits, r.xmm[0], sizeof(bits));
                    value = render_value(cur, rt, bits);
                }
                else
                {
                    value = "?";
                }
            }
            else
            {
                value = render_value(cur, rt, rv);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            value.sprnt("0x%llX", rv);
        }

        qstring tmp = value;
        value.sprnt("(%s)%s", type_name.c_str(), tmp.c_str());
        return value;
    }

    void FunctionTracer::reset()
    {
        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx); m_traces.clear(); }
        clear_events();
    }

    void FunctionTracer::add_func(ea_t func_ea)
    {
        if ( func_ea == BADADDR )
            return;
        ea_t fstart = get_func_start(func_ea);
        ea_t key = fstart != BADADDR ? fstart : func_ea;
        if ( is_traced(key) )
            return;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
            m_traces.push_back(key);
        }
        refresh_chooser("Traced functions");
    }

    void FunctionTracer::remove_trace(size_t n)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
        if ( n < m_traces.size() )
            m_traces.erase(m_traces.begin() + n);
    }

    bool FunctionTracer::is_traced(ea_t func_ea)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
        for ( ea_t ea : m_traces )
            if ( ea == func_ea )
                return true;
        return false;
    }

    size_t FunctionTracer::count_traced()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
        return m_traces.size();
    }

    ea_t FunctionTracer::traced_at(size_t n)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
        return n < m_traces.size() ? m_traces[n] : BADADDR;
    }

    size_t FunctionTracer::count_events()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
        return m_events.size();
    }

    FunctionInvocation FunctionTracer::event_at(size_t n)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
        return n < m_events.size() ? m_events[n] : FunctionInvocation{};
    }

    void FunctionTracer::remove_event(size_t n)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
        if ( n < m_events.size() )
            m_events.erase(m_events.begin() + n);
    }

    void FunctionTracer::clear_events()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
        m_events.clear();
    }

    std::vector<FunctionInvocation> FunctionTracer::snapshot_events()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
        return m_events;
    }

    // Read the live pointer stored at 'slot' (an IAT/import slot) and add it.
    static void add_live_ptr(ea_t slot, bool is64, std::set<ea_t> &out)
    {
        if ( slot == BADADDR )
            return;
        ea_t v = is64 ? (ea_t)get_qword(slot) : (ea_t)get_dword(slot);
        if ( v != 0 && v != BADADDR )
            out.insert(v);
    }

    // Calls reach an import directly (the real VA) or through a thunk that
    // jumps via the IAT. The function start, the thunk's target and the live
    // IAT pointer are all collected, so the sweep matches either path.
    //
    // The thunk is recognized from its instruction, not from IDA's
    // FUNC_THUNK flag: in a fresh session a system DLL's thunk (kernel32's
    // VirtualProtect, a jmp into kernelbase) is not even a function until a
    // stop lands there, and the trace then missed every call made to the
    // target directly (4 calls instead of 29 in beacon). A slot is read
    // where it holds the bound value: at the playhead, and at the end of
    // the recording for a playhead the loader had not bound it by yet.
    std::vector<ea_t> FunctionTracer::resolve_targets(ea_t func_ea, CursorPtr *at_end) const
    {
        std::set<ea_t> out;
        func_entry_info_t fi;
        bool has_func = get_func_entry_info(&fi, func_ea);
        ea_t start = has_func ? fi.start_ea : func_ea;
        out.insert(start);

        ModuleRegistry *mods = m_mgr != nullptr ? &m_mgr->modules() : nullptr;
        ITraceBackend  *backend = m_mgr != nullptr ? m_mgr->backend() : nullptr;
        const size_t    ptrsz = m_is64 ? 8 : 4;
        // A pointer read from a slot counts only when it is a recorded
        // module's code: anything else is an unbound slot or not a slot.
        auto add_slot = [&](ea_t slot)
        {
            std::set<ea_t> vals;
            add_live_ptr(slot, m_is64, vals);
            if ( !*at_end && backend != nullptr )
            {
                *at_end = backend->make_cursor();
                if ( *at_end && !(*at_end)->seek(backend->info().last) )
                    at_end->reset();
            }
            if ( *at_end )
            {
                uint64_t v = 0;
                std::vector<uint8_t> known;
                if ( (*at_end)->read_memory(slot, &v, ptrsz, &known) == ptrsz )
                    vals.insert((ea_t)v);
            }
            for ( ea_t v : vals )
                if ( mods == nullptr || mods->index_at(v) != (size_t)-1 )
                    out.insert(v);
        };

        // An import thunk (jmp cs:Foo, or a direct jmp): follow it.
        insn_t insn;
        if ( !is_data(get_flags(start))
          && decode_insn(&insn, start) > 0 && (insn.get_canon_feature(PH) & CF_STOP) != 0 )
        {
            const op_t &op = insn.ops[0];
            if ( op.type == o_near || op.type == o_far )
                out.insert(op.addr);
            else if ( op.type == o_mem )
                add_slot(op.addr);
            return std::vector<ea_t>(out.begin(), out.end());
        }

        // The import data slot itself was picked: read the live pointer there.
        // Only for data, so code bytes are never read as a pointer.
        if ( !is_code(get_flags(start)) && !has_func )
            add_slot(start);

        return std::vector<ea_t>(out.begin(), out.end());
    }

    bool FunctionTracer::run_sweep(qstring *error)
    {
        qstring ignored;
        if ( error == nullptr )
            error = &ignored;
        if ( m_mgr == nullptr || !m_mgr->is_active() || m_mgr->backend() == nullptr )
        {
            *error = "Tracing is only available while replaying a trace.";
            return false;
        }

        // Each resolved runtime target to the picked function (for display and
        // types).
        std::map<ea_t, ea_t> tgt2disp;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_traces_mtx);
            CursorPtr at_end;
            for ( ea_t picked : m_traces )
                for ( ea_t t : resolve_targets(picked, &at_end) )
                    tgt2disp.emplace(t, picked);
        }
        if ( tgt2disp.empty() )
        {
            *error = "No functions are being traced. Right-click a function and pick "
                     "'TTD: Find calls to this function'.";
            return false;
        }

        ITraceBackend *backend = m_mgr->backend();

        std::vector<ea_t> targets;
        targets.reserve(tgt2disp.size());
        for ( const auto &kv : tgt2disp )
            targets.push_back(kv.first);

        // Phase 1: the backend finds every call to one of the targets.
        std::vector<CallEvent> calls;
        QueryResult qr = run_query("Tracing function calls across the whole trace",
                                   [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return backend->query_calls(targets, PositionRange{}, &calls, p);
        });
        if ( !qr.ran )
        {
            *error = query_error(m_mgr, backend, qr, "The replay session ended during the call search.",
                                 "This recording's backend could not search for calls.");
            return false;
        }
        if ( qr.truncated )
            msg("[ida-ttd] tracer: hit the backend's call limit; results are "
                "truncated. Narrow the pattern to see the rest.\n");

        // Phase 2 runs on the main thread, with its own progress and Cancel.
        CursorPtr cur = backend->make_cursor();
        std::vector<FunctionInvocation> built;
        built.reserve(calls.size());
        bool cancelled = qr.cancelled;
        const uint64_t ptr = m_is64 ? 8 : 4;
        show_wait_box("Resolving %d call(s)... (Cancel to stop)", (int)calls.size());
        if ( cur )
        {
            // Collect every place to read, then read in position order. A
            // call and its return are far apart, and a backend that rebuilds
            // state from the nearest checkpoint (Sogen) would pay again each
            // time reads alternated between them.
            struct Visit { Position where; size_t call; bool ret; };
            std::vector<Visit> visits;
            std::vector<FunctionInvocation> slot(calls.size());
            // Each function's prototype is resolved once (resolve_traced_proto
            // says which source wins). Those the API metadata describes are
            // decoded from it (flags by name, out parameters re-read at the
            // return); others from IDA's types.
            std::vector<DecodedCall> decoded(calls.size());
            std::map<ea_t, TracedProto> protos;
            auto proto_of = [&](ea_t f) -> const TracedProto &
            {
                auto it = protos.find(f);
                if ( it == protos.end() )
                    it = protos.emplace(f, resolve_traced_proto(&m_mgr->modules(), f)).first;
                return it->second;
            };
            std::vector<bool> keep(calls.size(), false);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
            {
                const CallEvent &c = calls[i];
                auto disp = tgt2disp.find(c.target);
                if ( disp == tgt2disp.end() )
                    continue;
                // Arguments are decoded just before the call. Without a call
                // (the thread began in the callee, or a jump got there) they
                // are read at the entry instead (see below).
                Position where = c.is_call && c.pos.is_valid() ? c.pos : c.entry_pos;
                if ( !where.is_valid() )
                    continue;
                keep[i] = true;
                slot[i].func_ea = disp->second;
                slot[i].tid     = c.tid;
                slot[i].pos     = where;
                visits.push_back(Visit{ where, i, false });
                if ( c.ret_pos.is_valid() )
                    visits.push_back(Visit{ c.ret_pos, i, true });
            }
            std::sort(visits.begin(), visits.end(),
                      [](const Visit &x, const Visit &y) { return x.where < y.where; });

            // A backend that rebuilds registers by replay (Sogen) does each
            // stretch once for a batch, but once per visit through the cursor.
            // With the batch's registers, memory is batched too (below).
            std::vector<ittd_regs> pre;
            bool regs_cancelled = false;
            if ( backend->capabilities().batch_regs && !visits.empty() )
            {
                std::vector<Position> where;
                where.reserve(visits.size());
                for ( const Visit &v : visits )
                    where.push_back(v.where);
                const QueryResult rq = run_query("Reading the registers at the calls", [&](ProgressSink *p)
                {
                    return backend->registers_at(where, &pre, p);
                });
                // Cancelled here: the calls stay listed without values.
                if ( rq.cancelled )
                    cancelled = regs_cancelled = true;
                if ( !rq.ran || pre.size() != visits.size() )
                    pre.clear();
            }
            // Registers at visit k: the batch's when it has every register a
            // calling convention reads, else the cursor's.
            auto view_at = [&](size_t k)
            {
                GuestView gv = guest_view(cur.get());
                const uint32_t need = ITTD_REGS_GP | ITTD_REGS_XMM;
                if ( k < pre.size() && (pre[k].have & need) == need )
                {
                    const ittd_regs *r = &pre[k];
                    gv.regs = [r](ittd_regs *out) { *out = *r; return true; };
                }
                return gv;
            };

            // One visit, read through 'view' (memory and registers there). Run
            // again from scratch when a batched read missed something, so it
            // starts from the call's decode as it was ('at_call').
            std::vector<DecodedCall> at_call;
            auto visit_one = [&](size_t k, GuestView view)
            {
                const Visit &v = visits[k];
                FunctionInvocation &ev = slot[v.call];
                if ( v.ret )
                {
                    ev.end_pos = v.where;
                    ev.has_ret = true;
                    DecodedCall &dc = decoded[v.call];
                    if ( v.call < at_call.size() )
                        dc = at_call[v.call];
                    if ( dc.sig != nullptr )
                    {
                        decode_api_outs(view, &dc);
                        ev.args.clear();
                        for ( const DecodedArg &a : dc.args )
                            ev.args.push_back(a.text);
                        ev.retval = decode_api_return(dc, get_return_value(view, m_is64));
                        return;
                    }
                    ev.retval  = render_return(view, proto_of(ev.func_ea), m_is64);
                    return;
                }
                const CallEvent &c = calls[v.call];
                if ( !(c.is_call && c.pos.is_valid()) )
                {
                    // At the entry the return address is on the stack: skip
                    // it so stack arguments sit where a call site has them.
                    auto regs = view.regs;
                    view.regs = [regs, ptr](ittd_regs *r)
                    {
                        if ( !regs || !regs(r) )
                            return false;
                        r->gp[ITTD_REG_RSP] += ptr;
                        return true;
                    };
                }
                const TracedProto &proto = proto_of(ev.func_ea);
                if ( proto.sig != nullptr )
                {
                    decoded[v.call] = DecodedCall{};
                    decode_api_args(view, *proto.sig, m_is64, &decoded[v.call]);
                    ev.args.clear();
                    for ( const DecodedArg &a : decoded[v.call].args )
                        ev.args.push_back(a.text);
                    return;
                }
                ev.args.clear();
                extract_args(view, proto, m_is64, ev.args);
            };

            // A call both of whose visits have the batch's registers reads its
            // memory in batches (BatchedMemory) instead of seeking the cursor
            // to each visit: about 17 ms a seek on Microsoft TTD, two per call,
            // so a traced API called ten thousand times took minutes. The
            // rest are read through the cursor as before.
            const uint32_t need = ITTD_REGS_GP | ITTD_REGS_XMM;
            std::vector<char> call_batched(calls.size(), 1);
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < visits.size(); k++ )
                if ( !(k < pre.size() && (pre[k].have & need) == need) )
                    call_batched[visits[k].call] = 0;
            std::vector<size_t> batched_calls, batched_rets, seeked;
            for ( size_t k = 0; k < visits.size(); k++ )
            {
                if ( !call_batched[visits[k].call] )
                    seeked.push_back(k);
                else
                    (visits[k].ret ? batched_rets : batched_calls).push_back(k);
            }

            BatchedMemory mem;
            auto batched_view = [&](size_t k)
            {
                GuestView gv;
                gv.read = mem.reader(visits[k].where);
                const ittd_regs *r = &pre[k];
                gv.regs = [r](ittd_regs *out) { *out = *r; return true; };
                return gv;
            };
            // Decode 'todo', fetch what it missed (behind a wait box, through
            // run_query), and decode again those that missed something.
            auto in_rounds = [&](std::vector<size_t> todo) -> bool
            {
                for ( int round = 0; !todo.empty(); round++ )
                {
                    std::vector<size_t> again;
                    for ( size_t k : todo )
                    {
                        const uint64_t before = mem.misses();
                        visit_one(k, batched_view(k));
                        if ( mem.misses() != before )
                            again.push_back(k);
                    }
                    if ( again.empty() || round + 1 == kMaxFetchRounds )
                        break;
                    bool fetched = true;
                    const QueryResult fq = run_query("Reading memory at the calls", [&](ProgressSink *p)
                    {
                        fetched = mem.fetch(backend, p);
                        QueryResult q;
                        q.ran = true;
                        q.cancelled = !fetched;
                        return q;
                    });
                    if ( fq.cancelled || !fetched )
                        return false;
                    todo.swap(again);
                }
                return true;
            };
            if ( !regs_cancelled )
            {
                // Calls before returns: a return's decode starts from its
                // call's.
                if ( !in_rounds(batched_calls) )
                    cancelled = true;
                at_call = decoded;
                if ( !cancelled && !in_rounds(batched_rets) )
                    cancelled = true;
            }

            size_t done = 0;
            for ( size_t idx = 0; idx < seeked.size() && !regs_cancelled && !cancelled; idx++ )
            {
                const size_t k = seeked[idx];
                if ( user_cancelled() )
                {
                    cancelled = true;
                    break;
                }
                if ( (done & 0x3F) == 0 )
                    replace_wait_box("Resolving calls: %d of %d values... (Cancel to stop)",
                                     (int)done + 1, (int)seeked.size());
                done++;
                if ( !cur->seek(visits[k].where) )
                    continue;
                // A seeked return starts from its call's decode as it is now.
                if ( visits[k].ret && visits[k].call < at_call.size() )
                    at_call[visits[k].call] = decoded[visits[k].call];
                visit_one(k, view_at(k));
            }

            // An integer out parameter unchanged at the return may be the
            // kernel's write not yet visible on Microsoft TTD: the backend
            // searches from the return on, where it surfaces. A changed one is
            // kept as read.
            std::vector<OutSlot> oslots;
            std::vector<std::pair<size_t, size_t>> owner;     // (call, parameter)
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size() && !cancelled; i++ )
            {
                const DecodedCall &d = decoded[i];
                if ( !keep[i] || d.sig == nullptr || !slot[i].has_ret )
                    continue;
                for ( const auto &[p, width] : api_int_outs(d) )
                {
                    const DecodedArg &a = d.args[p];
                    if ( a.pointee_before.has_value() && a.pointee_after.has_value()
                      && *a.pointee_before != *a.pointee_after )
                        continue;
                    OutSlot s;
                    s.call   = slot[i].end_pos;
                    s.addr   = (ea_t)a.raw;
                    s.before = a.pointee_after.value_or(0);
                    s.tid    = slot[i].tid;
                    s.width  = width;
                    oslots.push_back(s);
                    owner.emplace_back(i, p);
                }
            }
            if ( !oslots.empty() )
            {
                std::vector<std::optional<uint64_t>> values;
                bool searched = false;
                const QueryResult oq = run_query("Finding what the calls wrote back", [&](ProgressSink *p)
                {
                    searched = backend->query_out_values(oslots, &values, p);
                    QueryResult r;
                    r.ran = true;
                    return r;
                });
                if ( oq.cancelled )
                    cancelled = true;
                std::set<size_t> touched;
                for ( size_t k = 0; searched && k < oslots.size() && k < values.size(); k++ )
                {
                    if ( !values[k].has_value() )
                        continue;
                    DecodedCall &d = decoded[owner[k].first];
                    d.out_values.resize(d.args.size());
                    d.out_values[owner[k].second] = values[k];
                    touched.insert(owner[k].first);
                }
                for ( size_t i : touched )
                {
                    decode_api_outs(GuestView{}, &decoded[i]);
                    slot[i].args.clear();
                    for ( const DecodedArg &a : decoded[i].args )
                        slot[i].args.push_back(a.text);
                }
            }

            for ( size_t i = 0; i < calls.size(); i++ )
                if ( keep[i] )
                    built.push_back(std::move(slot[i]));
        }

        std::sort(built.begin(), built.end(),
                  [](const FunctionInvocation &a, const FunctionInvocation &b) { return a.pos < b.pos; });

        const size_t nbuilt = built.size();   // read before the move below
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(m_events_mtx);
            m_events = std::move(built);
        }
        hide_wait_box();

        // Open events tabs are not refreshed: each holds a frozen snapshot.
        if ( cancelled )
            msg("[ida-ttd] tracer: cancelled - showing %d of %d recorded call(s).\n",
                (int)nbuilt, (int)calls.size());
        else
            msg("[ida-ttd] tracer: recorded %d call(s).\n", (int)nbuilt);
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/analysis/tracer.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/position.h"
#include "core/backend.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class TraceManager;
    class ModuleRegistry;
    namespace win32meta { struct FuncSig; }

    // How a traced function's calls are decoded, decided once per function:
    //   1. a prototype the user set in IDA (Y on the function) wins;
    //   2. else the API metadata, when it knows the name: it describes the
    //      same API as a type library's prototype, plus flag names, buffer
    //      lengths and which parameters the callee fills in;
    //   3. else IDA's prototype (a PDB's, a type library's, the decompiler's
    //      saved one), else the one IDA guesses from the code;
    //   4. else four untyped integer arguments.
    struct TracedProto
    {
        const win32meta::FuncSig *sig = nullptr;    // 2
        bool                 have_type = false;     // 1 or 3: 'type' and 'fd' hold it
        tinfo_t              type;
        func_type_data_t     fd;
        std::vector<qstring> names;                 // a header per argument ("arg0" when unnamed)
    };
    TracedProto resolve_traced_proto(ModuleRegistry *mods, ea_t func_ea);

    // One recorded call to a traced function, with its arguments and (when the
    // matching return was seen) its return value.
    struct FunctionInvocation
    {
        ea_t     func_ea = BADADDR;  // the user-picked function (for display/types)
        Position pos;                // position of the call site (start time)
        Position end_pos;            // position of the matching return (end time)
        uint32_t              tid = 0;            // thread the call ran on
        std::vector<qstring>  args;
        qstring               retval;
        bool                  has_ret = false;
    };

    // Records every call to a user-selected set of functions over the whole
    // recording. run_sweep finds the calls in one backend query, then reads
    // arguments and return values in a second pass. Picked addresses are
    // resolved through import thunks to the real runtime callees first.
    class FunctionTracer
    {
    public:
        void set_manager(TraceManager *mgr) { m_mgr = mgr; }
        TraceManager *manager() const       { return m_mgr; }
        void set_64bit(bool is64)           { m_is64 = is64; }
        void reset();   // forget all traced functions and events (trace closed)

        // ---- traced function list -----------------------------------------
        void   add_func(ea_t func_ea);
        void   remove_trace(size_t n);
        bool   is_traced(ea_t func_ea);
        size_t count_traced();
        ea_t   traced_at(size_t n);

        // ---- recorded events ----------------------------------------------
        size_t             count_events();
        FunctionInvocation event_at(size_t n);
        void               remove_event(size_t n);
        void               clear_events();
        // A copy of all events, for a chooser tab that a later sweep must not
        // change.
        std::vector<FunctionInvocation> snapshot_events();

        // Rebuild the event list for the traced functions from the whole
        // recording. Shows a wait box; safe from a UI action. False, with the
        // reason in 'error' and no dialog (a script would hang on one), when
        // it could not run.
        bool run_sweep(qstring *error);

    private:
        // The runtime callee addresses for a picked address (through import
        // thunks and the live IAT pointer). 'at_end' is a cursor at the end of
        // the recording, made on first use and shared by every call: one seek
        // for the whole pattern, not one per import slot (~17 ms each on
        // Microsoft TTD).
        std::vector<ea_t> resolve_targets(ea_t func_ea, CursorPtr *at_end) const;

        TraceManager      *m_mgr  = nullptr;
        bool               m_is64 = false;

        std::mutex                      m_traces_mtx;
        std::vector<ea_t>               m_traces;

        std::mutex                      m_events_mtx;
        std::vector<FunctionInvocation> m_events;
    };
}
```
