```h
    inline ittd_heat_cell to_abi(const HeatCell &c)
    {
        ittd_heat_cell x{};
        x.page     = c.page;
        x.slice    = c.slice;
        x.reads    = c.reads;
        x.writes   = c.writes;
        x.executes = c.executes;
        return x;

    {
        HeatCell c;
        c.page     = x.page;
        c.slice    = x.slice;
        c.reads    = x.reads;
        c.writes   = x.writes;
        c.executes = x.executes;
        return c;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- batch inputs

    inline ittd_out_slot to_abi(const OutSlot &s)
    {
        ittd_out_slot x{};
        x.call   = to_abi(s.call);
        x.addr   = (uint64_t)s.addr;
        x.before = s.before;
        x.tid    = s.tid;
        x.width  = s.width;
        return x;
    }
    inline OutSlot from_abi(const ittd_out_slot &x)
    {
        OutSlot s;
        s.call   = from_abi(x.call);
        s.addr   = (ea_t)x.addr;
        s.before = x.before;
        s.tid    = x.tid;
        s.width  = x.width;
        return s;
    }

    inline ittd_mem_read to_abi(const MemAt &m)
    {
        ittd_mem_read x{};
        x.pos    = to_abi(m.pos);
        x.addr   = (uint64_t)m.addr;
        x.offset = (uint64_t)m.offset;
        x.size   = (uint64_t)m.size;
        return x;
    }
    inline MemAt from_abi(const ittd_mem_read &x)
    {
        MemAt m;
        m.pos    = from_abi(x.pos);
        m.addr   = (ea_t)x.addr;
        m.offset = (size_t)x.offset;
        m.size   = (size_t)x.size;
        return m;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- replay settings

    // Going out, an empty path is NULL, 'size' is the whole struct, and the
    // log callback and its context are the caller's (backend_module.cpp
    // owns the emulator log). Coming in, each group of fields is read only
    // when 'size' covers it, NULL settings or a NULL path read as empty, and
    // the callback becomes only RecordOptions::log ("there is one"):
    // log_ctx is not kept and log_tail is never set, since the C++ backend
    // gets no callback of its own to call.
    // The settings point into 'registry_dir' and 'root', which must outlive
    // them.
    using AbiLogFn = void (*)(void *log_ctx, const char *line);

    inline ittd_fork_settings to_abi_settings(const qstring &registry_dir, const qstring &root, bool strict,
                                              bool allow_host, bool any_registry, const RecordOptions &rec,
                                              AbiLogFn log, void *log_ctx)
    {
        ittd_fork_settings fs{};
        fs.size  = sizeof(fs);
        fs.flags = (strict ? ITTD_FORK_STRICT : 0) | (allow_host ? ITTD_FORK_ALLOW_HOST : 0)
                 | (any_registry ? ITTD_FORK_ANY_REGISTRY : 0);
        fs.registry_dir   = registry_dir.empty() ? nullptr : registry_dir.c_str();
        fs.emulation_root = root.empty() ? nullptr : root.c_str();
        fs.network        = rec.network ? ITTD_NET_LIVE : ITTD_NET_OFFLINE;
        fs.access_mask    = rec.access_mask;
        fs.checkpoint_interval = rec.checkpoint_interval;
        fs.elevated       = rec.elevated ? 1 : 0;
        fs.log            = log;
        fs.log_ctx        = log_ctx;
        return fs;
    }
    inline ReplaySettings from_abi(const ittd_fork_settings *s)
    {
        // Each field only when the caller's struct is new enough to carry it.
        auto has = [s](size_t offset, size_t size) { return s != nullptr && offset + size <= s->size; };
        ReplaySettings rs;
        if ( has(offsetof(ittd_fork_settings, emulation_root), sizeof(s->emulation_root)) )
        {
            rs.registry_dir   = s->registry_dir != nullptr ? s->registry_dir : "";
            rs.emulation_root = s->emulation_root != nullptr ? s->emulation_root : "";
            rs.strict         = (s->flags & ITTD_FORK_STRICT) != 0;
            rs.allow_host     = (s->flags & ITTD_FORK_ALLOW_HOST) != 0;
            rs.any_registry   = (s->flags & ITTD_FORK_ANY_REGISTRY) != 0;
        }
        if ( has(offsetof(ittd_fork_settings, log_ctx), sizeof(s->log_ctx)) )
        {
            rs.rec.network             = s->network == ITTD_NET_LIVE;
            rs.rec.access_mask         = s->access_mask;
            rs.rec.checkpoint_interval = s->checkpoint_interval;
            rs.rec.elevated            = s->elevated != 0;
            rs.rec.log                 = s->log != nullptr;
        }
        return rs;
    }
}

```

`src/core/abi_export.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/abi_export.h"
#include "core/abi_convert.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>

namespace idattd
{
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- state

    static BackendFactory g_factory = nullptr;
    static LogSetter      g_set_log = nullptr;
    static BackendPtr     g_identity;     // unopened: id, names, can_open

    // A handle's last error. The core runs queries on a worker thread while
    // the main thread reads cursors on the same handle and later reads the
    // failure reason, so the text sits behind a mutex. get() hands out a
    // per-thread copy, which another thread's failure cannot reallocate; it
    // stays valid until the same thread asks again.
    struct ErrorSlot
    {
        void set(const char *text)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mtx);
            m_text = text != nullptr ? text : "";
        }
        const char *get() const
        {
            thread_local std::string copy;
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m_mtx);
            copy = m_text;
            return copy.c_str();
        }

    private:
        mutable std::mutex m_mtx;
        std::string        m_text;
    };

    static ErrorSlot      g_error;        // last_error(NULL)

    // One answer kept between a count query's two calls.
    struct CachedAnswer
    {
        std::string           key;
        std::shared_ptr<void> data;
        int                   rc = ITTD_OK;
        int                   truncated = 0;
        int                   served = 0;
    };

    // 'cache' and 'mapping_files' are guarded by 'mtx': the core may run a
    // query on a worker while the main thread asks another on the same
    // handle. The lock is never held while a query computes, so a long query
    // does not stall the other thread and cancellation cannot deadlock on it.
    struct ExportedBackend
    {
        BackendPtr           b;
        ErrorSlot            error;
        std::mutex           mtx;
        CachedAnswer         cache;
        std::vector<qstring> mapping_files;   // from the last query_mapping_changes
    };

    struct ExportedCursor
    {
        ExportedBackend            *owner = nullptr;
        CursorPtr                   c;
        std::unique_ptr<INavigator> nav;      // made on the first movement
        std::unique_ptr<ProgressSink> nav_sink;
        // read_memory's 'known', reused between reads to avoid an allocation
        // per read; a cursor is used by one thread at a time.
        std::vector<uint8_t>        known;
    };

    static ExportedBackend *B(ittd_backend *h) { return reinterpret_cast<ExportedBackend *>(h); }
    static ExportedCursor  *C(ittd_cursor *h)  { return reinterpret_cast<ExportedCursor *>(h); }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    // An ittd_progress as the ProgressSink a C++ backend takes.
    class AbiSink : public ProgressSink
    {
    public:
        explicit AbiSink(const ittd_progress *p) : m_p(p) {}
        void report(uint32_t percent) override
        {
            if ( m_p != nullptr && m_p->report != nullptr )
                m_p->report(m_p->ud, percent >= 100 ? 1000 : percent * 10);
        }
        bool cancelled() override
        {
            return m_p != nullptr && m_p->cancelled != nullptr && m_p->cancelled(m_p->ud) != 0;
        }

    private:
        const ittd_progress *m_p;
    };

    // Every entry point catches: an exception must not cross the C boundary.
    //
    // A call that fails without throwing takes the backend's own reason, even
    // an empty one, so an earlier failure's reason never answers for this one
    // (the core says something generic for an empty reason). Cancelling is
    // not a failure and leaves the slot alone.
    template <typename F>
    static int guarded(ExportedBackend *h, F f)
    {
        try
        {
            // This call's reason only: the backend keeps one per thread, and
            // what an earlier call on this thread left must not answer for
            // this one (a failure that sets no reason reported a stale one).
            h->b->clear_error();
            int rc = f();
            if ( rc != ITTD_OK && rc != ITTD_E_CANCELLED )
                h->error.set(h->b->last_error().c_str());
            return rc;
        }
        catch ( const std::exception &e )
        {
            h->error.set(e.what());
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            h->error.set("unexpected exception in the backend");
        }
        return ITTD_E_FAILED;
    }

    // The count-then-fill convention, for answers that are cheap to produce.
    template <typename T, typename S, typename Conv>
    static int fill(const std::vector<S> &src, T *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count, Conv conv)
    {
        if ( out_count != nullptr )
            *out_count = src.size();
        if ( buf != nullptr )
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < src.size() && i < cap; i++ )
                buf[i] = conv(src[i]);
        return ITTD_OK;
    }

    // A C++ backend's answer as ABI structs, for answer()'s cache.
    template <typename T, typename S>
    static void append_abi(const std::vector<S> &src, std::vector<T> *out)
    {
        out->reserve(out->size() + src.size());
        for ( const S &s : src )
            out->push_back(to_abi(s));
    }

    // The same for an expensive answer: computed once for the count call,
    // handed out again for the fill, then dropped. 'key' identifies the
    // question, so a different one is never answered from the cache.
    template <typename T>
    static int answer(ExportedBackend *h, const std::string &key, T *buf, size_t cap,
                      size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated,
                      const std::function<QueryResult(std::vector<T> *)> &run)
    {
        CachedAnswer &c = h->cache;
        std::shared_ptr<void> data;
        int rc = ITTD_OK;
        int truncated = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(h->mtx);
            if ( c.key == key && c.data != nullptr )
            {
                data      = c.data;
                rc        = c.rc;
                truncated = c.truncated;
            }
        }
        if ( data == nullptr )
        {
            // Computed without the lock. Two threads asking at once each
            // compute; the later store wins, and a fill that then finds
            // another key in the cache computes again, which is slow but
            // still answers its own question.
            auto v = std::make_shared<std::vector<T>>();
            QueryResult r = run(v.get());
            data      = v;
            rc        = !r.ran ? ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED : r.cancelled ? ITTD_E_CANCELLED : ITTD_OK;
            truncated = r.cancelled ? ITTD_TRUNC_CANCELLED : r.truncated ? ITTD_TRUNC_CAP : 0;
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(h->mtx);
            c.key       = key;
            c.data      = data;
            c.rc        = rc;
            c.truncated = truncated;
            c.served    = 0;
        }
        // The shared_ptr keeps this answer alive even if another thread
        // replaces the cache entry meanwhile.
        const std::vector<T> &v = *std::static_pointer_cast<std::vector<T>>(data);
        if ( out_count != nullptr )
            *out_count = v.size();
        if ( out_truncated != nullptr )
            *out_truncated = truncated;
        if ( buf != nullptr )
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < cap; i++ )
                buf[i] = v[i];
        // After a count and its fill, or a fill alone, the question is
        // answered. A failed count gets no fill, so it is not kept either:
        // asking again reruns the query rather than repeating the failure.
        // Nor does an empty answer: the core skips the fill when the count
        // is zero, and a kept entry would answer the next identical question
        // (a cancelled one included) without running it.
        bool failed = rc != ITTD_OK && rc != ITTD_E_CANCELLED;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(h->mtx);
            if ( c.data == data && (++c.served >= 2 || buf != nullptr || failed || v.empty()) )
            {
                c.data.reset();
                c.key.clear();
            }
        }
        // A cancelled count still reports what it gathered, as ITTD_OK with
        // the truncated flag saying it was cancelled: ITTD_E_CANCELLED would
        // make the core's count-then-fill drop the partial answer.
        return rc == ITTD_E_CANCELLED ? ITTD_OK : rc;
    }

    // A cache key: the query's name and the bytes of its arguments.
    struct Key
    {
        std::string s;
        explicit Key(const char *what) : s(what) {}
        template <typename T>
        Key &add(const T &v) { s.append((const char *)&v, sizeof(T)); return *this; }
        Key &add_bytes(const void *p, size_t n) { s.append((const char *)p, n); return *this; }
    };

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity

    static const char *x_id()           { return g_identity->id(); }
    static const char *x_display_name() { return g_identity->display_name(); }
    static const char *x_file_filter()  { return g_identity->file_filter(); }

    static int x_can_open(const char *path)
    {
        try
        {
            return path != nullptr && g_identity->can_open(path) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- session

    static ittd_backend *x_open(const char *path)
    {
        try
        {
            auto h = std::make_unique<ExportedBackend>();
            h->b = g_factory();
            qstring err;
            if ( h->b == nullptr || !h->b->open(path, &err) )
            {
                g_error.set(err.empty() ? "the recording could not be opened" : err.c_str());
                return nullptr;
            }
            return reinterpret_cast<ittd_backend *>(h.release());
        }
        catch ( const std::exception &e )
        {
            g_error.set(e.what());
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            g_error.set("unexpected exception while opening the recording");
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    static void x_close(ittd_backend *hb)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return;
        try { h->b->close(); } catch ( ... ) {}
        delete h;
    }

    static const char *x_last_error(ittd_backend *hb)
    {
        return hb != nullptr ? B(hb)->error.get() : g_error.get();
    }

    static int x_info(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_trace_info *out)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            const TraceInfo &ti = h->b->info();
            const Capabilities &c = h->b->capabilities();
            *out = to_abi(ti);
            uint32_t caps = to_abi(c);
            if ( !h->b->prepared() )
                caps |= ITTD_CAP_PREPARE;
            out->capabilities = caps;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_prepare(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            return h->b->prepare(&sink) ? ITTD_OK : ITTD_E_FAILED;
        });
    }

    static int x_prepared(ittd_backend *hb)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        try
        {
            return h != nullptr && h->b->prepared() ? 1 : 0;
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- positions

    static int x_format_position(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position p, char *buf, size_t buf_size)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || buf == nullptr || buf_size == 0 )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            copy_str(buf, buf_size, h->b->format_position(from_abi(p)).c_str());
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_parse_position(ittd_backend *hb, const char *text, ittd_position *out)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || text == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Position p;
            if ( !h->b->parse_position(text, &p) )
                return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
            *out = to_abi(p);
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static const char *x_position_syntax(ittd_backend *hb)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        return h != nullptr ? h->b->position_syntax() : g_identity->position_syntax();
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- cursors

    static ittd_cursor *x_cursor_open(ittd_backend *hb)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return nullptr;
        try
        {
            auto c = std::make_unique<ExportedCursor>();
            c->owner = h;
            c->c     = h->b->make_cursor();
            if ( c->c == nullptr )
                return nullptr;
            return reinterpret_cast<ittd_cursor *>(c.release());
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

    static void x_cursor_close(ittd_cursor *hc)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return;
        try
        {
            c->nav.reset();     // before the cursor it moves
            c->c.reset();
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
        }
        delete c;
    }

    static int x_cursor_position(ittd_cursor *hc, ittd_position *out)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]() { *out = to_abi(c->c->position()); return ITTD_OK; });
    }

    static int x_cursor_seek(ittd_cursor *hc, ittd_position p)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            return c->c->seek(from_abi(p)) ? ITTD_OK : ITTD_E_NO_POSITION;
        });
    }

    static int x_cursor_thread(ittd_cursor *hc, uint32_t *out)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]() { *out = c->c->thread_id(); return ITTD_OK; });
    }

    static int x_cursor_regs(ittd_cursor *hc, ittd_regs *out)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            *out = ittd_regs{};
            return c->c->read_registers(out) ? ITTD_OK : ITTD_E_FAILED;
        });
    }

    static int x_cursor_thread_regs(ittd_cursor *hc, uint32_t tid, ittd_regs *out)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            *out = ittd_regs{};
            return c->c->read_thread_registers(tid, out) ? ITTD_OK : ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
        });
    }

    static int x_cursor_read_memory(ittd_cursor *hc, uint64_t ea, void *buf, uint8_t *known,
                                    size_t size, size_t *out_known)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || (buf == nullptr && size != 0) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<uint8_t> &k = c->known;
            k.clear();
            size_t n = c->c->read_memory((ea_t)ea, buf, size, &k);
            if ( known != nullptr && size != 0 )
            {
                size_t have = std::min(k.size(), size);
                if ( have != 0 )
                    memcpy(known, k.data(), have);
                if ( have < size )
                    memset(known + have, ITTD_KNOWN_NO, size - have);
            }
            if ( out_known != nullptr )
                *out_known = n;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_cursor_threads(ittd_cursor *hc, ittd_thread *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            return fill(c->c->live_threads(), buf, cap, out_count,
                        [](const ThreadInfo &t) { return to_abi(t); });
        });
    }

    static int x_cursor_rebuild_range(ittd_cursor *hc, uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi, int replace,
                                      uint64_t *out_bytes)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            size_t n = c->c->rebuild_range((ea_t)lo, (ea_t)hi, replace != 0);
            if ( out_bytes != nullptr )
                *out_bytes = n;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- navigation

    static INavigator *nav(ExportedCursor *c)
    {
        if ( c->nav == nullptr )
            c->nav = c->owner->b->make_navigator(c->c.get());
        return c->nav.get();
    }

    template <typename Move>
    static int navigate(ittd_cursor *hc, int *out_stop, Move move)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            INavigator *n = nav(c);
            if ( n == nullptr )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            StopReason r = move(n);
            if ( out_stop != nullptr )
                *out_stop = to_abi(r);
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_nav_step(ittd_cursor *c, int fwd, int *s)
    { return navigate(c, s, [&](INavigator *n) { return n->step(fwd != 0); }); }
    static int x_nav_step_over(ittd_cursor *c, int fwd, int *s)
    { return navigate(c, s, [&](INavigator *n) { return n->step_over(fwd != 0); }); }
    static int x_nav_step_out(ittd_cursor *c, int fwd, int *s)
    { return navigate(c, s, [&](INavigator *n) { return n->step_out(fwd != 0); }); }
    static int x_nav_run(ittd_cursor *c, int fwd, int *s)
    { return navigate(c, s, [&](INavigator *n) { return n->run(fwd != 0); }); }
    static int x_nav_run_to(ittd_cursor *c, uint64_t addr, int fwd, int *s)
    { return navigate(c, s, [&](INavigator *n) { return n->run_to((ea_t)addr, fwd != 0); }); }

    static int x_nav_breakpoints(ittd_cursor *hc, const ittd_breakpoint *bpts, size_t count)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || (bpts == nullptr && count != 0) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            INavigator *n = nav(c);
            if ( n == nullptr )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            std::vector<Breakpoint> v;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                v.push_back(from_abi(bpts[i]));
            return n->set_breakpoints(v, nullptr) ? ITTD_OK : ITTD_E_FAILED;
        });
    }

    static int x_nav_take_notice(ittd_cursor *hc, char *buf, size_t buf_size)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr || buf == nullptr || buf_size == 0 )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            INavigator *n = nav(c);
            copy_str(buf, buf_size, n != nullptr ? n->take_notice().c_str() : "");
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_nav_set_progress(ittd_cursor *hc, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedCursor *c = C(hc);
        if ( c == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(c->owner, [&]()
        {
            INavigator *n = nav(c);
            if ( n == nullptr )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            if ( progress == nullptr )
            {
                n->set_progress(nullptr);
                c->nav_sink.reset();
            }
            else
            {
                c->nav_sink = std::make_unique<AbiSink>(progress);
                n->set_progress(c->nav_sink.get());
            }
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- enumeration

    static int x_modules(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_module *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            return fill(h->b->modules(), buf, cap, out_count, [](const ModuleInfo &m) { return to_abi(m); });
        });
    }

    static int x_threads(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_thread *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            return fill(h->b->threads(), buf, cap, out_count, [](const ThreadInfo &t) { return to_abi(t); });
        });
    }

    static int x_timeline(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_trace_event *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            return fill(h->b->timeline(), buf, cap, out_count, [](const TraceEvent &e) { return to_abi(e); });
        });
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- queries

    static int x_query_accesses(ittd_backend *hb, uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi, uint32_t kinds,
                                ittd_position_range when, ittd_access *buf, size_t cap,
                                size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Key k("accesses");
            k.add(lo).add(hi).add(kinds).add(when);
            return answer<ittd_access>(h, k.s, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                       [&](std::vector<ittd_access> *out)
            {
                std::vector<Access> v;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult r = h->b->query_accesses((ea_t)lo, (ea_t)hi, from_abi_kinds(kinds),
                                                     from_abi(when), &v, &sink);
                append_abi(v, out);
                return r;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_executed(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_range *ranges, size_t nranges,
                                uint64_t *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated,
                                const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (ranges == nullptr && nranges != 0) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Key k("executed");
            k.add_bytes(ranges, nranges * sizeof(ittd_range));
            return answer<uint64_t>(h, k.s, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                    [&](std::vector<uint64_t> *out)
            {
                std::vector<ea_t> v;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult res = h->b->query_executed(from_abi(ranges, nranges), &v, &sink);
                out->assign(v.begin(), v.end());
                return res;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_calls(ittd_backend *hb, const uint64_t *targets, size_t ntargets,
                             ittd_position_range when, ittd_call *buf, size_t cap,
                             size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (targets == nullptr && ntargets != 0) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Key k("calls");
            k.add(when).add_bytes(targets, ntargets * sizeof(uint64_t));
            return answer<ittd_call>(h, k.s, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                     [&](std::vector<ittd_call> *out)
            {
                std::vector<ea_t> t(targets, targets + ntargets);
                std::vector<CallEvent> v;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult r = h->b->query_calls(t, from_abi(when), &v, &sink);
                append_abi(v, out);
                return r;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_indirect(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_range *ranges, size_t nranges,
                                uint32_t flags, ittd_call_target *buf, size_t cap,
                                size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (ranges == nullptr && nranges != 0) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Key k("indirect");
            k.add(flags).add_bytes(ranges, nranges * sizeof(ittd_range));
            return answer<ittd_call_target>(h, k.s, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                            [&](std::vector<ittd_call_target> *out)
            {
                std::map<ea_t, std::vector<IndirectTarget>> m;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult res = h->b->query_indirect_targets(from_abi(ranges, nranges),
                                                               (flags & ITTD_INDIRECT_JUMPS) != 0, &m, &sink);
                for ( const auto &kv : m )
                    for ( const IndirectTarget &t : kv.second )
                        out->push_back(to_abi(kv.first, t));
                return res;
            });
        });
    }

    // A replay scan's settings, for its cache key: the same scan against other
    // hives or another root is another question. The ABI 3 fields are left
    // out: a scan replays the recording itself, offline whatever 'network'
    // says, and the others shape only a new recording or the log.
    static void add_settings(Key *k, const ittd_fork_settings *s)
    {
        uint32_t flags = s != nullptr ? s->flags : 0;
        const char *reg  = s != nullptr && s->registry_dir != nullptr ? s->registry_dir : "";
        const char *root = s != nullptr && s->emulation_root != nullptr ? s->emulation_root : "";
        k->add(flags).add_bytes(reg, strlen(reg) + 1).add_bytes(root, strlen(root) + 1);
    }

    static int x_query_strings(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_fork_settings *settings, uint32_t min_length,
                               ittd_string_hit *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count,
                               int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Key k("strings");
            k.add(min_length);
            add_settings(&k, settings);
            return answer<ittd_string_hit>(h, k.s, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                           [&](std::vector<ittd_string_hit> *out)
            {
                std::vector<StringHit> v;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult r = h->b->query_strings(from_abi(settings), min_length, &v, &sink);
                append_abi(v, out);
                return r;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_mapping_changes(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_mapping_change *buf, size_t cap,
                                       size_t *out_count, int *out_truncated,
                                       const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            return answer<ittd_mapping_change>(h, "mapping", buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                               [&](std::vector<ittd_mapping_change> *out)
            {
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                std::vector<qstring> files;
                QueryResult r = h->b->query_mapping_changes(out, &files, &sink);
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(h->mtx);
                h->mapping_files.swap(files);
                return r;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_mapping_files(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_name *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(h->mtx);
        return fill(h->mapping_files, buf, cap, out_count, [](const qstring &s) { return to_abi_name(s); });
    }

    static int x_module_symbols(ittd_backend *hb, uint64_t base, ittd_symbol *buf, size_t cap,

    static int x_regs_at(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_position *positions, size_t count,
                         ittd_regs *out, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (count != 0 && (positions == nullptr || out == nullptr)) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<Position> p;
            p.reserve(count);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                p.push_back(from_abi(positions[i]));
            std::vector<ittd_regs> v;
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            QueryResult r = h->b->registers_at(p, &v, &sink);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                out[i] = i < v.size() ? v[i] : ittd_regs{};
            return r.cancelled ? ITTD_E_CANCELLED : ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_query_instructions(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position_range when, uint32_t tid,
                                    ittd_access *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count,
                                    int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<Access> v;
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            QueryResult r = h->b->query_instructions(from_abi(when), tid, cap, &v, &sink);
            if ( !r.ran )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            size_t n = 0;
            for ( ; n < v.size() && n < cap; n++ )
                if ( buf != nullptr )
                    buf[n] = to_abi(v[n]);
            if ( out_count != nullptr )
                *out_count = n;
            if ( out_truncated != nullptr )
                *out_truncated = r.cancelled ? ITTD_TRUNC_CANCELLED : r.truncated ? ITTD_TRUNC_CAP : 0;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_position_add(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position p, int64_t delta, ittd_position *out)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]() { *out = to_abi(h->b->position_add(from_abi(p), delta)); return ITTD_OK; });
    }

    static int x_query_frame_entry(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position at, uint32_t tid, uint64_t max_back,
                                   ittd_position *out_call, uint64_t *out_entry)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Position cp;
            ea_t e = BADADDR;
            if ( !h->b->query_frame_entry(from_abi(at), tid, max_back, &cp, &e) )
                return ITTD_E_FAILED;
            if ( out_call != nullptr )
                *out_call = to_abi(cp);
            if ( out_entry != nullptr )
                *out_entry = (uint64_t)e;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_query_frame_entry_progress(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position at, uint32_t tid, uint64_t max_back,
                                            ittd_position *out_call, uint64_t *out_entry,
                                            const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Position cp;
            ea_t e = BADADDR;
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            if ( !h->b->query_frame_entry(from_abi(at), tid, max_back, &cp, &e, &sink) )
                return sink.cancelled() ? ITTD_E_CANCELLED : ITTD_E_FAILED;
            if ( out_call != nullptr )
                *out_call = to_abi(cp);
            if ( out_entry != nullptr )
                *out_entry = (uint64_t)e;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_query_register_change(ittd_backend *hb, ittd_position at, uint32_t tid, uint32_t reg,
                                       uint64_t max_back, ittd_position *out_pos, int *out_found,
                                       const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            Position p;
            bool found = false;
            if ( !h->b->query_register_change(from_abi(at), tid, reg, max_back, &p, &found, &sink) )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            if ( out_pos != nullptr )
                *out_pos = to_abi(p);
            if ( out_found != nullptr )
                *out_found = found ? 1 : 0;
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_query_access_heat_window(ittd_backend *hb, uint32_t page_shift, uint32_t slices,
                                          ittd_position_range when,
                                          ittd_heat_cell *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count,
                                          int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            // The window is part of the key, so the fill finds this window's
            // answer and not another's.
            std::string key = "heat|" + std::to_string(page_shift) + "|" + std::to_string(slices)
                            + "|" + std::to_string(when.first.hi) + ":" + std::to_string(when.first.lo)
                            + "|" + std::to_string(when.last.hi) + ":" + std::to_string(when.last.lo);
            return answer<ittd_heat_cell>(h, key, buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated,
                                          [&](std::vector<ittd_heat_cell> *out)
            {
                std::vector<HeatCell> v;
                AbiSink sink(progress);
                QueryResult r = h->b->query_access_heat_window(page_shift, slices, from_abi(when), &v, &sink);
                append_abi(v, out);
                return r;
            });
        });
    }

    static int x_query_out_values(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_out_slot *slots, size_t count,
                                  uint64_t *values, uint8_t *known, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (count != 0 && (slots == nullptr || values == nullptr || known == nullptr)) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<OutSlot> in(count);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                in[i] = from_abi(slots[i]);
            std::vector<std::optional<uint64_t>> v;
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            if ( !h->b->query_out_values(in, &v, &sink) )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
            {
                known[i]  = i < v.size() && v[i].has_value() ? 1 : 0;
                values[i] = known[i] ? *v[i] : 0;
            }
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_read_memory_at(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_mem_read *reads, size_t count,
                                uint8_t *buf, uint8_t *known, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || (count != 0 && (reads == nullptr || buf == nullptr || known == nullptr)) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<MemAt> in(count);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                in[i] = from_abi(reads[i]);
            std::vector<uint8_t> data, k;
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            QueryResult r = h->b->read_memory_at(in, &data, &k, &sink);
            if ( !r.ran )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            // Only the caller's own ranges are written: the buffers between
            // them are theirs.
            for ( const MemAt &m : in )
            {
                // Written so it cannot wrap: offset + size could, for huge
                // values, and pass the check.
                if ( m.size == 0 || m.offset > data.size() || m.size > data.size() - m.offset )
                    continue;
                memcpy(buf + m.offset, data.data() + m.offset, m.size);
                memcpy(known + m.offset, k.data() + m.offset, m.size);
            }
            return r.cancelled ? ITTD_E_CANCELLED : ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    // visit_positions' reader, through the C ABI: 'read_ctx' is the
    // backend's VisitRead for the visit being made.
    static size_t x_visit_read(void *read_ctx, uint64_t addr, void *buf, size_t size)
    {
        try
        {
            return (*static_cast<const ITraceBackend::VisitRead *>(read_ctx))(addr, buf, size);
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static int x_visit_positions(ittd_backend *hb, const ittd_position *at, const ittd_position *after,
                                 size_t count, ittd_visit_fn fn, void *ud, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || fn == nullptr || (count != 0 && at == nullptr) )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            std::vector<Position> a(count), b;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                a[i] = from_abi(at[i]);
            if ( after != nullptr )
            {
                b.resize(count);
                for ( size_t i = 0; i < count; i++ )
                    b[i] = from_abi(after[i]);
            }
            AbiSink sink(progress);
            QueryResult r = h->b->visit_positions(a, after != nullptr ? &b : nullptr,
                [fn, ud](size_t index, int phase, const ITraceBackend::VisitRead &read)
                {
                    fn(ud, index, phase, x_visit_read, const_cast<ITraceBackend::VisitRead *>(&read));
                }, &sink);
            if ( !r.ran )
                return ITTD_E_UNSUPPORTED;
            return r.cancelled ? ITTD_E_CANCELLED : ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_query_access_heat(ittd_backend *hb, uint32_t page_shift, uint32_t slices,
                                   ittd_heat_cell *buf, size_t cap, size_t *out_count,
                                   int *out_truncated, const ittd_progress *progress)
    {
        return x_query_access_heat_window(hb, page_shift, slices, to_abi(PositionRange{}),
                                          buf, cap, out_count, out_truncated, progress);
    }

    static int x_heat_window_slice_position(ittd_backend *hb, uint32_t slices, uint32_t slice,
                                            ittd_position_range when, ittd_position *out)
    {
        ExportedBackend *h = B(hb);
        if ( h == nullptr || out == nullptr )
            return ITTD_E_BAD_ARG;
        return guarded(h, [&]()
        {
            Position p = h->b->heat_window_slice_position(slices, slice, from_abi(when));
            if ( !p.is_valid() )
                return ITTD_E_FAILED;
            *out = to_abi(p);
            return ITTD_OK;
        });
    }

    static int x_heat_slice_position(ittd_backend *hb, uint32_t slices, uint32_t slice, ittd_position *out)
    {
        return x_heat_window_slice_position(hb, slices, slice, to_abi(PositionRange{}), out);
    }

    static void x_set_log(void (*log)(void *ud, const char *line), void *ud)
    {
        if ( g_set_log != nullptr )
            g_set_log(log, ud);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the table

    const ittd_backend_api *export_backend(BackendFactory factory, LogSetter set_log)
    {
        static ittd_backend_api a{};
        static bool built = false;
        if ( built )
            return &a;
        g_factory  = factory;
        g_set_log  = set_log;
        g_identity = factory();
        if ( g_identity == nullptr )
            return nullptr;

        a.abi_version           = ITTD_ABI_VERSION;
        a.size                  = sizeof(ittd_backend_api);
        a.id                    = x_id;
        a.display_name          = x_display_name;
        a.file_filter           = x_file_filter;
        a.can_open              = x_can_open;
        a.open                  = x_open;
        a.close                 = x_close;
        a.last_error            = x_last_error;
        a.info                  = x_info;
        a.prepare               = x_prepare;
        a.format_position       = x_format_position;
        a.parse_position        = x_parse_position;
        a.position_syntax       = x_position_syntax;
        a.cursor_open           = x_cursor_open;
        a.cursor_close          = x_cursor_close;
        a.cursor_position       = x_cursor_position;
        a.cursor_seek           = x_cursor_seek;
        a.cursor_thread         = x_cursor_thread;
        a.cursor_regs           = x_cursor_regs;
        a.cursor_read_memory    = x_cursor_read_memory;
        a.cursor_threads        = x_cursor_threads;
        a.nav_step              = x_nav_step;
        a.nav_step_over         = x_nav_step_over;
        a.nav_step_out          = x_nav_step_out;
        a.nav_run               = x_nav_run;
        a.nav_run_to            = x_nav_run_to;
        a.nav_breakpoints       = x_nav_breakpoints;
        a.modules               = x_modules;
        a.threads               = x_threads;
        a.timeline              = x_timeline;
        a.query_accesses        = x_query_accesses;
        a.query_executed        = x_query_executed;
        a.query_calls           = x_query_calls;
        a.query_indirect        = x_query_indirect;
        a.query_mapping_changes = x_query_mapping_changes;
        a.module_symbols        = x_module_symbols;
        a.module_functions      = x_module_functions;
        a.query_exceptions      = x_query_exceptions;
        a.regs_at               = x_regs_at;
        a.query_mapping_files   = x_query_mapping_files;
        a.query_instructions    = x_query_instructions;
        a.position_add          = x_position_add;
        a.query_frame_entry     = x_query_frame_entry;
        a.query_frame_entry_progress = x_query_frame_entry_progress;
        a.set_log               = x_set_log;
        a.prepared              = x_prepared;
        a.cursor_thread_regs    = x_cursor_thread_regs;
        a.cursor_rebuild_range  = x_cursor_rebuild_range;
        a.nav_take_notice       = x_nav_take_notice;
        a.nav_set_progress      = x_nav_set_progress;
        a.query_syscalls        = x_query_syscalls;
        a.query_self_modifying  = x_query_self_modifying;
        a.query_strings         = x_query_strings;
        a.query_buffers         = x_query_buffers;
        a.query_register_change = x_query_register_change;
        a.query_access_heat     = x_query_access_heat;
        a.heat_slice_position   = x_heat_slice_position;
        a.query_out_values      = x_query_out_values;
        a.read_memory_at        = x_read_memory_at;
        a.visit_positions       = x_visit_positions;
        // Only offered when the backend can count part of the recording; the
        // core reads a missing entry as "the heatmap cannot zoom".
        if ( g_identity->can_window_heat() )
        {
            a.query_access_heat_window   = x_query_access_heat_window;
            a.heat_window_slice_position = x_heat_window_slice_position;
        }
        built = true;
        return &a;
    }
}

```

`src/core/abi_export.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/backend.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // The C ABI for a backend written against ITraceBackend: the inverse of
    // BackendModule. A backend DLL built from C++ exports
    //
    //   extern "C" __declspec(dllexport)
    //   const ittd_backend_api *ida_ttd_backend(uint32_t abi_version)
    //   {
    //       // Any core since the last layout change (ida_ttd_backend.h).
    //       return abi_version >= ITTD_ABI_LAYOUT
    //            ? export_backend(make_my_backend, my_set_log) : nullptr;
    //   }
    //
    // and the core sees it through BackendModule like any other. Each
    // ittd_backend handle is a fresh backend from 'factory', opened on one
    // recording; identity questions go to one kept unopened.
    //
    // Count queries are asked twice (count, then fill), and a replay engine
    // answers each by replaying the recording, so the answer is kept between
    // the two calls.
    using BackendFactory = BackendPtr (*)();
    using LogCallback    = void (*)(void *ud, const char *line);
    using LogSetter      = void (*)(LogCallback log, void *ud);

    // The table, built on the first call; later calls return the same one.
    const ittd_backend_api *export_backend(BackendFactory factory, LogSetter set_log);
}

```

`src/core/backend.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/position.h"
#include "abi/ida_ttd_backend.h"
#include <filesystem>

// What the core plugin needs from a recording, independent of how any one kind
// of recording provides it. See docs/modular-backends.md.
//
// Whole-trace work is expressed as queries rather than "install a watchpoint
// and replay": Microsoft TTD answers "every access to this range" by replaying
// with a watchpoint armed, Sogen by reading a page index. Questions let each
// backend answer the way it can.
//
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// This is the CORE-SIDE view, in C++ and free to use IDA types. A backend DLL
// sees the flat C ABI in abi/ida_ttd_backend.h instead; BackendModule adapts a
// loaded module to this interface.
//
// The two are kept close in shape so the adapter stays a pure translation.
// Where this file uses an ABI type outright (ittd_regs), that is deliberate: a
// third representation of the registers would only be translated twice.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace idattd
{
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- queries
    //
    // What a backend can be asked. The core checks these before offering a
    // command, so a backend is never asked a question it cannot answer.
    //
    // The ITTD_CAP_* bits as named booleans, which core code reads far more
    // often than the adapter translates them.
    struct Capabilities
    {
        // Accesses to an address range can be listed (memory search, coverage).
        bool access_queries   = false;
        // Calls and returns can be listed (the call tracer, indirect calls).
        bool call_queries     = false;
        // The recording says where memory was mapped, unmapped and
        // reprotected, with the protection, so the memory map need not be
        // reconstructed from syscalls. Knowing only *that* a range changed
        // (all a Sogen recording older than its memory-region section says)
        // does not qualify.
        bool mapping_changes  = false;
        // Dispatched syscalls are recorded: which, where, and what they
        // returned. Not necessarily their arguments: Sogen records the result
        // and the host writes, not the registers going in.
        bool syscalls         = false;
        // Module export tables come out of the recording, so the core does not
        // need to parse them out of guest memory.
        bool recorded_exports = false;
        // registers_at over many positions costs much less than a seek and a
        // register read at each (ITTD_CAP_BATCH_REGS), so a listing that
        // needs registers at thousands of positions asks for them up front.
        bool batch_regs       = false;
        // The recording can be stepped backwards instruction by instruction.
        // Both backends can; without it the backward actions are not
        // registered.
        bool reverse_step     = true;
        // Exceptions the system dispatched can be listed (query_exceptions).
        bool exceptions       = false;
        // Reading a page costs about a copy (ITTD_CAP_CHEAP_READS): IDA may
        // analyze whole library modules, reading all of their code.
        bool cheap_reads      = false;
        // Code the program wrote and then ran can be listed
        // (query_self_modifying).
        bool self_modifying   = false;
        // The recording can be forked into a new one (record_fork).
        bool fork             = false;
        // Strings and buffers can be recovered by replaying the recording
        // (query_strings, query_buffers).
        bool replay_scans     = false;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- the trace
    struct TraceInfo
    {
        bool     is64 = false;
        // Identity of this recording, so results cached in the database for
        // one are not shown for another. Stable across opens of the same file;
        // different for a re-recording of the same program.
        uint64_t fingerprint = 0;
        Position first, last;
        // Base name of the program that was recorded ("sample.exe").
        qstring  main_module;
        // What to call this backend in the UI ("Microsoft TTD", "Sogen").
        qstring  backend_name;
    };

    struct ModuleInfo
    {
        ea_t     base = BADADDR;
        uint64_t size = 0;
        qstring  name;            // base name, as recorded
        qstring  path;            // full path on the recording machine
        // Where the recording saw it mapped. For Microsoft TTD, also the only
        // position at which the module's headers can be read.
        Position loaded;
        Position unloaded;        // none() while still mapped at the end
        // IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_*: 0x8664, or 0x14c for 32-bit code in a WoW64
        // process. 0 when the recording does not say; read the PE header.
        uint16_t machine = 0;
        // The image's TimeDateStamp and CheckSum as recorded, which tell a
        // file on this machine apart from another build of the same DLL. 0
        // when the backend does not say; the core then reads the headers.
        uint32_t timestamp = 0;
        uint32_t checksum  = 0;
    };

    struct ThreadInfo
    {
        uint32_t tid = 0;
        Position created, exited;
        qstring  name;            // empty when the recording does not say
        // 0 when the recording does not say. Bounds at creation; a fiber
        // switch rewrites them in the TEB. See ittd_thread.
        ea_t     teb = 0, teb32 = 0;
        ea_t     stack_base = 0, stack_limit = 0;
    };

    // One thing worth putting on the timeline: a thread starting or exiting, a
    // module loading or unloading, an exception.
    struct TraceEvent
    {
        Position pos;
        qstring  what;
        uint32_t kind = ITTD_EV_OTHER;   // ITTD_EV_*: what the timeline can sort by
        uint32_t tid  = 0;               // the thread it happened on; 0 when not one
    };

    enum AccessKind : uint8_t
    {
        ACCESS_READ  = 1,
        ACCESS_WRITE = 2,
        ACCESS_EXEC  = 4,
    };

    struct Access
    {
        Position pos;
        uint32_t tid  = 0;
        ea_t     pc   = BADADDR;    // the instruction that did it
        ea_t     addr = BADADDR;    // the address it touched
        uint32_t size = 0;
        uint8_t  kind = 0;          // one ACCESS_* value
    };

    // One entry into a function. See ittd_call for why there are three
    // positions: who called, the arguments, and the return value are each read
    // at a different one.
    struct CallEvent
    {
        Position pos;               // at the call; none() if the thread began in the callee
        Position entry_pos;         // at the callee's first instruction
        Position ret_pos;           // just after the return; none() if unseen
        uint32_t tid    = 0;
        ea_t     site   = BADADDR;  // the call instruction
        ea_t     target = BADADDR;  // where it actually went
        bool     is_call = true;    // false: reached by a jump, so no return of its own
    };

    // One target an indirect branch reached.
    struct IndirectTarget
    {
        ea_t     target = BADADDR;
        uint64_t hits   = 0;
        Position first;             // the first time; none() if the backend does not know
        bool     is_call = true;    // false for an indirect jump
    };

    // An exception the system dispatched. See ittd_exception for which ones
    // that leaves out.
    struct ExceptionEvent
    {
        Position pos;               // the dispatch
        Position raise_pos;         // the instruction that raised it; none() if unknown
        uint32_t tid     = 0;
        uint32_t code    = 0;
        uint32_t flags   = 0;
        ea_t     address = BADADDR;
        uint64_t information[2] = {};
    };

    // A syscall the program made (ittd_syscall). Its arguments are the
    // registers at 'pos'.
    struct SyscallEvent
    {
        Position pos;               // at the syscall instruction
        uint64_t result = 0;        // rax after it
        uint32_t number = 0;
        uint32_t tid    = 0;        // 0 when unknown
        qstring  name;              // empty when unknown
    };

    // A syscall's out parameter (ittd_out_slot).
    struct OutSlot
    {
        Position call;
        ea_t     addr = 0;
        uint64_t before = 0;
        uint32_t tid = 0;
        uint32_t width = 8;
    };

    // One read of read_memory_at (ittd_mem_read).
    struct MemAt
    {
        Position pos;
        ea_t     addr = 0;
        size_t   offset = 0;        // into the caller's buffers
        size_t   size = 0;
    };

    // The accesses to one page in one slice of time (ittd_heat_cell).
    struct HeatCell
    {
        uint64_t page = 0;
        uint32_t slice = 0;
        uint32_t reads = 0, writes = 0, executes = 0;
    };

    // An instruction the program wrote before running it (ittd_selfmod).
    struct SelfModHit
    {
        ea_t     address     = BADADDR;
        uint64_t size        = 0;
        Position write_pos;         // at the writing instruction
        ea_t     write_ip    = BADADDR;
        Position execute_pos;       // its first execution
        uint64_t executions  = 0;
    };

    // How a recording is made (a fork's, or a new one), and what its program
    // may reach: ittd_fork_settings' ABI 3 fields.
    struct RecordOptions
    {
        // The real network (ITTD_NET_LIVE): past a fork's position, or from
        // a new recording's start. Otherwise a loopback-only one.
        bool     network = false;
        uint32_t access_mask = 0;           // ITTD_ACCESS_* kept; 0: all
        uint64_t checkpoint_interval = 0;   // 0: the backend's default
        bool     elevated = false;          // an administrator's token (new recordings)
        bool     log = false;               // the emulator's log to the output window
        // The emulator's last lines kept for a recording's wait box
        // (emulator_log_tail), with or without 'log'.
        bool     log_tail = false;
    };

    // What replaying the recording needs beyond the recording itself.
    struct ReplaySettings
    {
        qstring registry_dir;               // empty: the backend's default; host recordings only
        qstring emulation_root;             // empty: the recording's own
        bool    strict = false;
        // Replay a recording made against the host, whose program then touches
        // this machine's files again (ITTD_FORK_ALLOW_HOST).
        bool    allow_host = false;
        // Replay with hives that are not the recording's (ITTD_FORK_ANY_REGISTRY).
        bool    any_registry = false;
        // Only 'log' matters to a replay of the recording itself (the scans).
        RecordOptions rec;
    };

    // What replaying the recording needs, as far as it says (ittd_replay_env).
    struct ReplayEnv
    {
        bool    host = false;               // made against the host, not an emulation root
        bool    registry_known = false;     // names its hives, so they can be checked
        bool    registry_carried = false;   // carries what it read of them: no hive files needed
        uint32_t system_dlls = ITTD_DLLS_UNKNOWN;   // this machine's against the recording's (ITTD_DLLS_*)
        qstring registry_hint;              // the emulation root's registry folder; empty for the host
        qstring emulation_root;             // empty for the host
        qstring windows_version;            // "10.0.26100.1"; empty when not recorded
    };

    // Whether a folder holds the hives the recording was made with
    // (check_registry).
    enum class HiveCheck
    {
        Match,          // the recording's own hives
        Unverified,     // hives, and the recording does not say which
        Missing,        // no hives there
        Mismatch,       // other hives than the recording's
    };

    // A string the program had in memory (ittd_string_hit).
    struct StringHit
    {
        ea_t     address = BADADDR;
        Position pos;                       // the write that completed it
        bool     wide    = false;           // UTF-16LE in memory
        uint32_t length  = 0;               // characters
        qstring  text;                      // UTF-8
    };

    // A buffer the program filled (ittd_buffer_hit).
    struct BufferHit
    {
        ea_t     address   = BADADDR;
        uint64_t size      = 0;
        Position first_pos;
        Position last_pos;
        ea_t     writer_ip = BADADDR;
        uint64_t writes    = 0;
        qstring  kind;
        qstring  preview;
    };

    // Why a replay was refused before it ran, when the user can fix it.
    enum class ReplayBlock
    {
        None,
        HostConsent,    // made against the host: needs ReplaySettings::allow_host
        Registry,       // no registry hives where the replay looked
        RegistryMismatch, // hives that are not the recording's (ReplaySettings::any_registry)
    };

    // A fork: replay to 'at', change registers and memory there, and run on,
    // recording into a new trace at 'path' (ITTD_CAP_FORK).
    struct ForkRequest
    {
        Position at;
        qstring  path;
        uint64_t max_instructions = 0;      // 0: until the program exits
        qstring  registry_dir;              // empty: the backend's default
        qstring  emulation_root;            // empty: the recording's own
        bool     strict = false;
        bool     allow_host = false;        // see ReplaySettings::allow_host
        bool     any_registry = false;      // see ReplaySettings::any_registry
        std::vector<std::pair<int, uint64_t>>   regs;     // ITTD_REG_* index (or FORK_REG_RFLAGS), value
        std::vector<std::pair<ea_t, bytevec_t>> memory;   // address, bytes
        qstring  note;                      // goes into the new trace's manifest
        RecordOptions rec;                  // 'elevated' does not apply: the fork's token is the recording's
    };
    constexpr int FORK_REG_RFLAGS = 100;

    struct ForkResult
    {
        bool     ok = false;
        bool     cancelled = false;
        uint64_t instructions = 0;          // how many the fork ran
        qstring  error;
        // Why it was refused before anything ran, when the user can fix it.
        ReplayBlock block = ReplayBlock::None;
    };

    // A program to record from its start (ITraceBackend::record_program).
    struct RecordRequest
    {
        qstring  application;               // the executable
        qstring  arguments;                 // the command line after its name, as typed
        qstring  working_dir;               // empty: the executable's folder
        qstring  path;                      // the new recording
        uint64_t max_instructions = 0;      // 0: until the program exits
        qstring  registry_dir;              // the hives it runs against (no emulation root)
        qstring  emulation_root;            // empty: against this machine's files
        bool     allow_host = false;        // consent to run against this machine's files
        int64_t  start_time = 0;            // seconds since 1970 UTC the program starts at; 0: 1970
        RecordOptions rec;
    };

    // Reported by a query that could not return everything it found.
    struct QueryResult
    {
        bool ran       = false;   // it ran to the end or was cancelled; false when
                                  // the backend cannot answer it or it failed
        bool cancelled = false;   // the user stopped it part-way
        bool truncated = false;   // a record cap was hit; results are a prefix
        // Why it did not run, read from the backend on the thread that ran
        // it, right after it failed: by the time the main thread asks, a
        // call of its own (a cursor read) may have replaced the backend's
        // last error. Empty when it ran, or the backend gave no reason.
        qstring error;
        // run_query was stopped because its session ended (and with it the
        // backend): no state of the backend may be read for it any more.
        // Decided by the session's end itself, not by comparing backend
        // pointers, which a new recording of the same kind would reuse.
        bool session_ended = false;
    };

    // How a long query reports progress and asks whether to stop. The core
    // implements it with a wait box. It may be called from a worker thread, so
    // an implementation uses only thread-safe IDA APIs. A fast backend may
    // ignore it.
    class ProgressSink
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ProgressSink() = default;
        virtual void report(uint32_t percent) = 0;
        virtual bool cancelled() = 0;
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- the cursor
    //
    // A movable viewpoint onto a recording. The core creates one for the
    // debugger's playhead and one per concurrent query, so a query never moves
    // what the user is looking at.
    class ITraceCursor
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ITraceCursor() = default;

        virtual Position position() const = 0;
        // Move to 'p', resolving the begin()/end() sentinels. False when 'p' is
        // not a position this recording has.
        virtual bool     seek(Position p) = 0;

        virtual uint32_t thread_id() const = 0;
        virtual ea_t     program_counter() const = 0;
        virtual uint64_t stack_pointer() const = 0;
        // The canonical register set (abi/ida_ttd_backend.h), which the core
        // maps onto the register table configure_debugger() installed. Not
        // regval_t: a backend DLL must not see IDA types.
        virtual bool     read_registers(ittd_regs *out) const = 0;

        // The registers of another thread at this position, for IDA's thread
        // list. False when the backend can only show the current thread's.
        virtual bool     read_thread_registers(uint32_t tid, ittd_regs *out) const
        {
            qnotused(tid); qnotused(out);
            return false;
        }

        // Bytes as the recording has them at this position.
        //
        // 'known' is resized to 'size' and marks each byte ITTD_KNOWN_*: the
        // recording's value, a placeholder zero (mapped, value unknown), or
        // nothing. Unknown bytes are left as the caller found them; the core
        // fills those and placeholders from the module's on-disk image, which
        // is the same job for every backend.
        //
        // Returns the number of bytes marked known or placeholder.
        virtual size_t   read_memory(ea_t ea, void *buf, size_t size,
                                     std::vector<uint8_t> *known) = 0;

        // The threads alive at this position.
        virtual std::vector<ThreadInfo> live_threads() const = 0;

        // Rebuild [lo, hi) as of this position from the recording's own
        // writes, for memory a position read cannot answer (an unpacker's
        // output before it runs), and serve it from then on. 'replace'
        // discards an earlier rebuild of the range (a re-read); without it a
        // rebuilt range is reused (the per-stop path). Returns the bytes
        // recovered; 0 for a backend whose reads are complete.
        virtual size_t   rebuild_range(ea_t lo, ea_t hi, bool replace)
        {
            qnotused(lo); qnotused(hi); qnotused(replace);
            return 0;
        }
    };

    // One breakpoint: an execution of 'addr', or an access of the kinds in
    // 'kinds' (AccessKind) to any byte of [addr, addr + size).
    struct Breakpoint
    {
        ea_t     addr  = BADADDR;
        uint64_t size  = 1;
        uint8_t  kinds = ACCESS_EXEC;
        bool operator==(const Breakpoint &o) const
        { return addr == o.addr && size == o.size && kinds == o.kinds; }
        bool operator<(const Breakpoint &o) const
        {
            if ( addr != o.addr ) return addr < o.addr;
            if ( size != o.size ) return size < o.size;
            return kinds < o.kinds;
        }
    };

    using CursorPtr = std::unique_ptr<ITraceCursor>;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- the navigator
    //
    // Stepping is a strategy, not a primitive: see the navigation section of
    // abi/ida_ttd_backend.h. Each backend implements the whole family.
    //
    // Every call moves the cursor the navigator was made for, honors the
    // set_breakpoints() set, and says why it stopped.
    enum class StopReason
    {
        Stepped,        // the movement completed
        Breakpoint,     // a user breakpoint was hit on the way
        TraceBoundary,  // the start or end of the recording was reached
        Failed,
    };

    class INavigator
    {
    public:
        virtual ~INavigator() = default;

        virtual StopReason step(bool forward) = 0;
        virtual StopReason step_over(bool forward) = 0;
        virtual StopReason step_out(bool forward) = 0;
        virtual StopReason run(bool forward) = 0;
        virtual StopReason run_to(ea_t addr, bool forward) = 0;
        virtual StopReason seek_to(Position p) = 0;

        // Breakpoints as the whole set (see ittd_backend_api::nav_breakpoints).
        // A data breakpoint stops at the instruction that made the access.
        //
        // 'accepted', when given, gets one entry per breakpoint: false for one
        // the engine refused, so IDA shows it as bad rather than as one that
        // silently never fires.
        virtual bool set_breakpoints(const std::vector<Breakpoint> &bpts,
                                     std::vector<bool> *accepted = nullptr) = 0;

        // A message for the user about the last movement, shown after the
        // stop ("this frame does not return anywhere"), or empty. Taking it
        // clears it.
        virtual qstring take_notice() { return qstring(); }

        // Where a long movement reports and asks whether to stop; the core
        // sets one around every movement and clears it after. Movements run
        // on the main thread, so a sink's cancelled() may pump IDA's message
        // loop. Null clears it.
        virtual void set_progress(ProgressSink *progress) { qnotused(progress); }
    };

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ the backend
    class ITraceBackend
    {
    public:
        virtual ~ITraceBackend() = default;

        // ---- identity, before anything is open -----------------------------
        //
        // Short id used in the database and when naming a module ("msttd",
        // "sogen"). Stored in the trace-link record, so changing it orphans
        // existing databases.
        virtual const char *id() const = 0;
        virtual const char *display_name() const = 0;
        // Whether this backend handles the file at 'path'. Asked of every
        // registered backend in order, by the loader and when a session
        // starts, so it must be cheap: a signature read at most, never an
        // open.
        virtual bool can_open(const char *path) const = 0;
        // The File > Open filter fragment this backend contributes, e.g.
        // "Microsoft TTD trace (*.run)".
        virtual const char *file_filter() const = 0;
        // Another instance of this backend, not open, for a second recording
        // alongside the one this instance has open (a script's, beside the
        // debugger session's). nullptr when the backend cannot make one.
        virtual std::unique_ptr<ITraceBackend> new_instance() const { return nullptr; }

        // ---- the session ---------------------------------------------------
        virtual bool open(const char *path, qstring *errbuf) = 0;
        virtual void close() = 0;
        virtual bool is_open() const = 0;
        virtual const TraceInfo     &info() const = 0;
        virtual const Capabilities  &capabilities() const = 0;

        // One-off work per recording that makes seeks fast or reads complete:
        // building Microsoft's memory index, filling Sogen's keyframes.
        // Returns true at once when there is nothing to do. Called on the main
        // thread after open(): the debugger runs it when a session starts, the
        // loader asks the user first.
        //
        // 'progress' may be null; a backend whose preparation cannot be
        // interrupted may show IDA's wait box itself.
        virtual bool prepare(ProgressSink *progress) { qnotused(progress); return true; }
        // Whether prepare() has nothing left to do for the open recording.
        virtual bool prepared() const { return true; }

        // ---- positions -----------------------------------------------------
        virtual qstring format_position(Position p) const = 0;
        virtual bool    parse_position(const char *text, Position *out) const = 0;
        // What to put next to the input box, e.g. "Sequence:Steps in hex".
        virtual const char *position_syntax() const = 0;

        // ---- reading -------------------------------------------------------
        virtual CursorPtr make_cursor() = 0;
        // A navigator over 'cursor', which it does not own and which must
        // outlive it.
        virtual std::unique_ptr<INavigator> make_navigator(ITraceCursor *cursor) = 0;

        // ---- enumeration ---------------------------------------------------
        virtual std::vector<ModuleInfo> modules() const = 0;
        virtual std::vector<ThreadInfo> threads() const = 0;
        virtual std::vector<TraceEvent> timeline() const = 0;

        // ---- whole-trace queries -------------------------------------------
        //
        // Each may take minutes on one backend and microseconds on another.
        // They report through 'progress' (may be null) and stop when it says
        // so.

        // Every access to [lo, hi) within 'when' matching 'kinds'. Appends to
        // 'out'. Requires capabilities().access_queries.
        virtual QueryResult query_accesses(ea_t lo, ea_t hi, uint8_t kinds,
                                           PositionRange when,
                                           std::vector<Access> *out,
                                           ProgressSink *progress) = 0;

        // The distinct addresses inside 'ranges' that the recording executed
        // (see ittd_backend_api::query_executed). Appends to 'out' in
        // ascending order, each address once: a vector rather than a set,
        // because a module's worth is millions of entries.
        virtual QueryResult query_executed(const std::vector<std::pair<ea_t, ea_t>> &ranges,
                                           std::vector<ea_t> *out,
                                           ProgressSink *progress) = 0;

        // Every call, within 'when', whose target is one of 'targets' (empty
        // means every call). Requires capabilities().call_queries.
        virtual QueryResult query_calls(const std::vector<ea_t> &targets,
                                        PositionRange when,
                                        std::vector<CallEvent> *out,
                                        ProgressSink *progress) = 0;

        // Every indirect call made from inside 'ranges', with where it went,
        // and every indirect jump too when 'jumps' is set. Grouped by site,
        // not by invocation.
        virtual QueryResult query_indirect_targets(
                const std::vector<std::pair<ea_t, ea_t>> &ranges,
                bool jumps,
                std::map<ea_t, std::vector<IndirectTarget>> *out,
                ProgressSink *progress) = 0;

        // Every exception the system dispatched, in order. Requires
        // capabilities().exceptions.
        virtual QueryResult query_exceptions(std::vector<ExceptionEvent> *out,
                                             ProgressSink *progress) = 0;

        // Every mapping change the recording holds, as the ABI's own structs
        // (Windows' MEM_* and PAGE_* values, which the memory map wants as
        // they are), and the mapped-file names their one-based 'file' fields
        // index. A backend without it answers not-ran.
        virtual QueryResult query_mapping_changes(std::vector<ittd_mapping_change> *out,
                                                  std::vector<qstring> *files,
                                                  ProgressSink *progress)
        {
            qnotused(out); qnotused(files); qnotused(progress);
            return QueryResult{};
        }

        // Every instruction the program wrote before running it. Requires
        // capabilities().self_modifying; a backend without it answers not-ran.
        virtual QueryResult query_self_modifying(std::vector<SelfModHit> *out,
                                                 ProgressSink *progress)
        {
            qnotused(out); qnotused(progress);
```
