`src/plugin/script_analysis.cpp`:

```cpp
// The an.* script commands that run the whole-recording analyses (the
// forks and recordings are script_fork.cpp's).
#include "plugin/script_internal.h"
#include "analysis/memsearch.h"
#include "analysis/coverage.h"
#include "analysis/callsites.h"
#include "analysis/tracer.h"
#include "analysis/memmap.h"
#include "analysis/syscalls.h"
#include "analysis/replay_scans.h"
#include "analysis/calltree.h"
#include "analysis/origin.h"
#include "analysis/handles.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ an.*
    //
    // The analyses, run exactly as their UI actions run them (same functions,
    // wait boxes and database writes), with the scope given here instead of
    // in a dialog.

    static uint8_t access_mask(const Args &a, size_t i)
    {
        return rwx_mask(a.count() > i ? a.at(i) : qstring("rwx"), ACC_READ, ACC_WRITE, ACC_EXEC);
    }

    static void cmd_an_search(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        ea_t lo = (ea_t)a.u64(0), hi = (ea_t)a.u64(1);
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(3, 200);
        std::vector<MemAccess> v;
        bool truncated = false, cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !search_memory(&mgr(), lo, hi, access_mask(a, 2), &v, &truncated, &cancelled, &err) )
            fail("the search did not run: %s", err.c_str());
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", format_position(v[i].pos)).hex("pc", v[i].pc).hex("addr", v[i].addr)
             .num("size", v[i].size).num("tid", v[i].tid).str("kind", access_name(v[i].kind));
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.boolean("truncated", truncated).boolean("cancelled", cancelled)
           .num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("accesses", arr.done());
    }

    // an.decode [MAX]: list and decode every syscall's arguments as the
    // Syscalls window does when nothing is saved (without saving), and say
    // where the time went (DecodeStats); MAX decoded rows are returned.
    static void cmd_an_decode(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        // an.decode [MAX] [file=PATH] [saved]: file= writes every decoded row
        // ("pos<TAB>name<TAB>args") to PATH, for comparing two builds;
        // saved writes what the database holds instead of decoding.
        uint64_t max = 5;
        qstring file;
        bool saved = false;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < a.count(); i++ )
        {
            if ( a.at(i).starts_with("file=") )
                file = a.at(i).substr(5);
            else if ( a.at(i) == "saved" )
                saved = true;
            else
                max = a.u64(i);
        }
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> v;
        std::vector<qstring> decoded;
        bool cancelled = false;
        auto dump = [&]()
        {
            if ( file.empty() )
                return;
            FILE *f = qfopen(file.c_str(), "w");
            if ( f == nullptr )
                fail("cannot write %s", file.c_str());
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size(); i++ )
                qfprintf(f, "%s\t%s\t%s\n", format_position(v[i].pos).c_str(), v[i].name.c_str(),
                         i < decoded.size() ? decoded[i].c_str() : "");
            qfclose(f);
        };
        if ( saved )
        {
            if ( !load_syscalls(&v, &decoded) )
                fail("this database has no saved syscalls");
            dump();
            out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size());
            return;
        }
        const auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        if ( !list_syscalls(&mgr(), &v, &cancelled) || cancelled )
            fail("this recording's syscalls were not listed");
        const double t_list = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count();
        const bool ran = decode_syscalls(&mgr(), v, &decoded, &cancelled);
        need_session();
        dump();
        const DecodeStats &st = last_decode_stats();
        JObj s;
        s.num("calls", (int64_t)st.calls).num("with_signature", (int64_t)st.with_sig)
         .num("with_registers", (int64_t)st.with_regs).num("out_slots", (int64_t)st.out_slots)
         .num("needs_after", (int64_t)st.needs_after)
         .num("rounds_args", st.rounds_args).num("rounds_after", st.rounds_after)
         .num("fetches", (int64_t)st.fetches).num("blocks", (int64_t)st.blocks)
         .num("positions", (int64_t)st.positions);
        auto secs = [](double x) { qstring t; t.sprnt("%.2f", x); return t; };
        s.str("t_list", secs(t_list)).str("t_regs", secs(st.t_regs)).str("t_args", secs(st.t_args))
         .str("t_search", secs(st.t_search)).str("t_after", secs(st.t_after))
         .str("t_fetch", secs(st.t_fetch)).str("t_total", secs(st.t_total));
        size_t nonempty = 0;
        for ( const qstring &d : decoded )
            nonempty += !d.empty();
        JArr rows;
        for ( size_t i = 0, shown = 0; i < v.size() && shown < max; i++ )
        {
            if ( decoded[i].empty() )
                continue;
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", format_position(v[i].pos)).str("name", v[i].name).str("args", decoded[i]);
            rows.add(o.done());
            shown++;
        }
        out.boolean("ran", ran).boolean("cancelled", cancelled).num("decoded", (int64_t)nonempty)
           .raw("stats", s.done()).raw("rows", rows.done());
    }

    static void cmd_an_syscalls(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 50);
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> v;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !list_syscalls(&mgr(), &v, &cancelled) )
            fail("this recording does not list its syscalls");
        std::vector<std::optional<SyscallArgs>> args;
        syscall_arguments(mgr().backend(), v, 0, (size_t)max, &args);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", format_position(v[i].pos)).num("tid", v[i].tid)
             .hex("number", v[i].number).str("name", v[i].name).hex("result", v[i].result);
            if ( i < args.size() && args[i].has_value() )
                o.hex_list("args", args[i]->data(), args[i]->size());
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.boolean("cancelled", cancelled).num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("syscalls", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_an_selfmod(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 50);
        std::vector<SelfModHit> v;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !find_self_modifying(&mgr(), &v, &cancelled) )
            fail("this recording's backend cannot look for self-modifying code");
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.hex("address", v[i].address).num("size", (int64_t)v[i].size)
             .str("written", format_position(v[i].write_pos)).hex("writer", v[i].write_ip)
             .str("first_run", format_position(v[i].execute_pos))
             .num("runs", (int64_t)v[i].executions);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.boolean("cancelled", cancelled).num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("hits", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_an_strings(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        size_t np = plain_args(a, 2);
        uint32_t min_len = np > 0 ? (uint32_t)a.u64(0) : 6;
        uint64_t max = np > 1 ? a.u64(1) : 50;
        std::vector<StringHit> v;
        bool cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !recover_strings(&mgr(), replay_args(a, np), min_len, &v, &cancelled, &err) )
            fail("the replay did not run: %s", err.c_str());
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", format_position(v[i].pos)).hex("address", v[i].address)
             .boolean("wide", v[i].wide).str("text", v[i].text);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        need_session();         // the session may have ended during the replay
        out.boolean("cancelled", cancelled).num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("strings", arr.done())
           .str("notice", mgr().backend()->scan_notice());
    }

    static void cmd_an_buffers(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        size_t np = plain_args(a, 1);
        uint64_t max = np > 0 ? a.u64(0) : 50;
        std::vector<BufferHit> v;
        bool cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !recover_buffers(&mgr(), replay_args(a, np), &v, &cancelled, &err) )
            fail("the replay did not run: %s", err.c_str());
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.hex("address", v[i].address).hex("size", v[i].size).str("kind", v[i].kind)
             .str("first", format_position(v[i].first_pos)).str("last", format_position(v[i].last_pos))
             .hex("writer", v[i].writer_ip).num("writes", (int64_t)v[i].writes).str("preview", v[i].preview);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        need_session();         // the session may have ended during the replay
        out.boolean("cancelled", cancelled).num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("buffers", arr.done())
           .str("notice", mgr().backend()->scan_notice());
    }

    static void cmd_an_calltree(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 50);
        CallTree t;
        qstring err;
        if ( !build_call_tree(&mgr(), &t, &err) )
            fail("the call tree did not build: %s", err.c_str());
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < t.rows.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            const CallTreeRow &r = t.rows[i];
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", format_position(r.pos)).num("depth", r.depth).hex("site", r.site)
             .hex("target", r.target).str("ret", format_position(r.ret_pos)).boolean("call", r.is_call);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.hex("root", t.root).str("from", format_position(t.from)).str("to", format_position(t.to))
           .boolean("from_cursor", t.from_cursor).boolean("truncated", t.truncated)
           .boolean("cancelled", t.cancelled).num("count", (int64_t)t.rows.size()).raw("calls", arr.done());
    }

    // Build the heatmap's counts, as the menu does; their size.
    static void cmd_an_heat(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        qstring err;
        if ( !build_heatmap(&mgr(), &err) )
            fail("%s", err.c_str());
        out.num("json_bytes", (int64_t)heatmap_json().length());
    }

    static void cmd_an_coverage(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        CoverageResult r;
        bgcolor_t color = (bgcolor_t)a.u64_or(2, COVERAGE_DEFAULT_COLOR);
        if ( !run_coverage(&mgr(), { { (ea_t)a.u64(0), (ea_t)a.u64(1) } }, color, &r) )
            fail("coverage did not run: %s", r.error.c_str());
        out.num("executed", (int64_t)r.executed).num("colored", (int64_t)r.colored)
           .num("both", (int64_t)r.both).num("undefined", (int64_t)r.undefined).boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled);
    }

    static void cmd_an_callsites(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        ea_t lo = (ea_t)a.u64(0), hi = (ea_t)a.u64(1);
        CallSiteResult r;
        if ( !annotate_indirect_calls(&mgr(), { { lo, hi } }, &r) )
            fail("the call site sweep did not run: %s", r.error.c_str());
        // What it wrote: the repeatable comment at each annotated site.
        JArr arr;
        for ( ea_t ea = lo; ea < hi && ea != BADADDR && arr.size() < 64; ea = next_head(ea, hi) )
        {
            qstring cmt;
            if ( get_cmt(&cmt, ea, true) > 0 && strncmp(cmt.c_str(), "TTD:", 4) == 0 )
            {
                JObj o;
                o.hex("site", ea).str("comment", cmt);
                tinfo_t ct;
                qstring ts;
                if ( get_tinfo(&ct, ea) && ct.print(&ts) )
                    o.str("call_type", ts);
                arr.add(o.done());
            }
        }
        out.num("sites", (int64_t)r.sites).num("targets", (int64_t)r.targets)
           .num("polymorphic", (int64_t)r.polymorphic).num("undefined", (int64_t)r.undefined)
           .num("typed", (int64_t)r.typed)
           .boolean("truncated", r.truncated).boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled)
           .raw("annotated", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_an_trace(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        FunctionTracer &tr = g_plugin->tracer();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(1, 40);
        tr.reset();
        // An address, or a "module!Glob*" pattern as Find calls by pattern
        // takes it. A hex word with "0x" or a leading digit is an address
        // (no symbol starts with a digit, and ida_ttd.py sends ints as bare
        // hex). One starting with a letter ("add", "face") is a name first,
        // and an address only when no function matches it.
        const qstring &word = a.at(0);
        uint64_t ea = 0;
        const bool is_hex = parse_u64(word, &ea);
        if ( is_hex && (word.starts_with("0x") || word.starts_with("0X") || qisdigit((uchar)word[0])) )
        {
            tr.add_func((ea_t)ea);
        }
        else
        {
            for ( ea_t f : mgr().modules().resolve_function_pattern(word.c_str()) )
                tr.add_func(f);
            if ( tr.count_traced() == 0 && is_hex )
                tr.add_func((ea_t)ea);
        }
        out.num("traced", (int64_t)tr.count_traced());
        qstring err;
        if ( !tr.run_sweep(&err) )
            fail("the trace did not run: %s", err.c_str());
        std::vector<FunctionInvocation> v = tr.snapshot_events();
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JArr args;
            for ( const qstring &s : v[i].args )
            {
                qstring q;
                json_escape(&q, s.c_str());
                args.add(q);
            }
            JObj o;
            qstring name;
            if ( get_name(&name, v[i].func_ea) <= 0 || name.empty() )
                name = mgr().modules().export_name_at(v[i].func_ea);
            o.hex("func", v[i].func_ea).str("name", name).str("pos", format_position(v[i].pos))
             .str("end", v[i].has_ret ? format_position(v[i].end_pos) : qstring())
             .num("tid", v[i].tid).raw("args", args.done()).str("ret", v[i].retval);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("calls", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_an_memmap(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        // The session's map, as the Memory map window and IDA's segments
        // have it: built when there is none, again with 'rebuild'.
        bool rebuild = false;
        uint64_t max = 40;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < a.count(); i++ )
        {
            if ( a.at(i) == "rebuild" )
                rebuild = true;
            else
                max = a.u64(i);
        }
        bool cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !session_memory_map(&mgr(), rebuild, &cancelled, &err) )
            fail("%s", err.c_str());
        const MemoryMap &mm = mgr().memmap_for_update();
        // The regions as they stand at the playhead.
        std::vector<Region> regions;
        mm.state_at(mgr().current_position(), regions);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < regions.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.hex("base", regions[i].base).hex("size", (ea_t)regions[i].size)
             .hex("protect", regions[i].protect).str("origin", change_name(regions[i].origin));
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("changes", (int64_t)mm.size()).boolean("cancelled", cancelled)
           .num("regions", (int64_t)regions.size()).raw("at_playhead", arr.done());
    }

    // What the automatic indirect-call resolution does on a stop in the
    // function at EA.
    static void cmd_an_autocalls(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        ea_t ea = (ea_t)a.u64(0);
        func_entry_info_t fi;
        if ( !get_func_entry_info(&fi, ea) )
            fail("no function there");
        bool ok = auto_annotate_function(&mgr(), fi.start_ea, fi.end_ea);
        out.boolean("done", ok).hex("start", fi.start_ea).hex("end", fi.end_ea);
    }

    // A "from=POS" argument, removed from the list: the position a command
    // works at instead of the playhead.
    bool from_arg(Args *a, Position *p)
    {
        for ( size_t i = 1; i < a->v.size(); i++ )
        {
            if ( !a->v[i].starts_with("from=") )
                continue;
            *p = position_arg(a->v[i].substr(5));
            a->v.erase(a->v.begin() + i);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void origin_target_json(const OriginTarget &t, JObj &o)
    {
        o.str("what", origin_target_text(t));
        if ( t.is_reg )
            o.str("reg", origin_target_text(t));
        else
            o.hex("addr", t.addr).num("size", t.size);
    }

    // Remove 'word' from the arguments; whether it was there.
    static bool flag_arg(Args *a, const char *word)
    {
        for ( size_t i = 1; i < a->v.size(); i++ )
            if ( a->v[i] == word )
            {
                a->v.erase(a->v.begin() + i);
                return true;
            }
        return false;
    }

    // REG, or mem ADDR [SIZE], from the front of the arguments.
    OriginTarget origin_target_arg(const Args &a, const char *cmd)
    {
        OriginTarget t;
        uint32_t reg = 0;
        if ( a.count() >= 2 && a.at(0) == "mem" )
        {
            t.is_reg = false;
            t.addr   = (ea_t)a.u64(1);
            t.size   = (uint32_t)std::min<uint64_t>(std::max<uint64_t>(a.u64_or(2, 8), 1), 64);
        }
        else if ( a.count() >= 1 && parse_register(a.at(0).c_str(), &reg) )
        {
            t.reg = reg;
        }
        else
        {
            fail("usage: %s REG | %s mem ADDR [SIZE], then from=POS to start there", cmd, cmd);
        }
        return t;
    }

    static qstring hop_json(const OriginHop &h)
    {
        JObj o;
        o.str("what", origin_target_text(h.what)).str("value", origin_value_text(h.value))
         .str("at", format_position(h.at)).str("kind", origin_kind_name(h.kind))
         .str("by_pos", h.by_pos.is_valid() ? format_position(h.by_pos) : qstring())
         .hex("by_pc", h.by_pc).str("insn", h.insn).str("note", h.note).boolean("combined", h.combined);
        return o.done();
    }

    // Where a value came from: "an.origin rax", "an.origin mem ADDR [SIZE]".
    static void cmd_an_origin(const Args &args, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        Args a = args;
        Position from;
        const bool has_from = from_arg(&a, &from);
        const bool through  = !flag_arg(&a, "stop");
        const OriginTarget t = origin_target_arg(a, "an.origin");
        std::vector<OriginHop> hops;
        if ( !(has_from ? trace_value_origin(&mgr(), t, from, 40, &hops, through)
                        : trace_value_origin(&mgr(), t, 40, &hops, through)) )
            fail("not traced");
        JArr arr;
        for ( const OriginHop &h : hops )
            arr.add(hop_json(h));
        out.num("hops", (int64_t)hops.size()).raw("chain", arr.done());
    }

    // Every chain at once, as the value origin graph draws it.
    static void cmd_an_origingraph(const Args &args, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        Args a = args;
        Position from = mgr().current_position();
        from_arg(&a, &from);
        size_t max_nodes = 60;
        for ( size_t i = 1; i < a.v.size(); i++ )
            if ( a.v[i].starts_with("max=") )
            {
                uint64_t n = 0;
                if ( !parse_u64(a.v[i].substr(4), &n) || n == 0 )
                    fail("max= takes a hex number of values");
                max_nodes = (size_t)n;
                a.v.erase(a.v.begin() + i);
                break;
            }
        const OriginTarget t = origin_target_arg(a, "an.origingraph");
        OriginGraph g;
        if ( !build_origin_graph(&mgr(), t, from, max_nodes, &g) )
            fail("not traced");
        JArr nodes;
        for ( const OriginHop &h : g.nodes )
            nodes.add(hop_json(h));
        JArr edges;
        for ( const OriginGraph::Edge &e : g.edges )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.num("from", e.from).num("to", e.to).boolean("input", e.input);
            edges.add(o.done());
        }
        out.raw("nodes", nodes.done()).raw("edges", edges.done())
           .boolean("truncated", g.truncated).boolean("cancelled", g.cancelled);
    }

    // What the instruction about to run at a position read: the next links
    // of a chain that ended at a computation.
    static void cmd_an_inputs(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        Position at = a.count() >= 1 ? position_arg(a.at(0)) : mgr().current_position();
        std::vector<OriginInput> v;
        if ( !origin_inputs(&mgr(), at, &v) )
            fail("no replay session is running");
        JArr arr;
        for ( const OriginInput &in : v )
        {
            JObj o;
            origin_target_json(in.what, o);
            o.str("value", origin_value_text(in.value)).boolean("address", in.address);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.str("pos", format_position(at)).raw("inputs", arr.done());
    }

    // The handle list.
    static void cmd_an_handles(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 200);
        std::vector<HandleRecord> v;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !list_handles(&mgr(), &v, &cancelled) )
            fail("the recording's syscalls cannot be listed");
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.hex("handle", (ea_t)v[i].handle).str("type", v[i].type).str("name", v[i].name)
             .str("opened", v[i].opened.is_valid() ? format_position(v[i].opened) : qstring())
             .str("by", v[i].opened_by)
             .str("closed", v[i].closed.is_valid() ? format_position(v[i].closed) : qstring());
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).boolean("cancelled", cancelled).raw("handles", arr.done());
    }

    // The Memory map listing's rows. Builds the change timeline first if
    // there is none (as the menu does, without asking).
    static void cmd_an_regions(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 200);
        bool cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !session_memory_map(&mgr(), false, &cancelled, &err) )
            fail("%s", err.c_str());
        std::vector<AddressRegion> regions;
        address_space_at(&mgr(), &regions);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < regions.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            const AddressRegion &r = regions[i];
            JObj o;
            o.hex("base", r.base).hex("size", (ea_t)r.size)
             .str("protect", r.reserved ? qstring("reserved")
                           : r.protect != 0 ? protection_text(r.protect) : qstring())
             .str("type", region_type_name(r.type)).str("use", r.use)
             .boolean("in_module", r.in_module)
             .str("since", r.since.is_valid() ? format_position(r.since) : qstring());
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("changes", (int64_t)mgr().memmap_for_update().size()).num("count", (int64_t)regions.size())
           .raw("regions", arr.done());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ commands

    static const Command ANALYSIS_COMMANDS[] = {
        { "an.search",      cmd_an_search,      "LO HI [rwx] [MAX] memory search, as the dialog runs it" },
        { "an.coverage",    cmd_an_coverage,    "LO HI [COLOR] measure and color execution coverage" },
        { "an.callsites",   cmd_an_callsites,   "LO HI annotate indirect calls, and list the comments" },
        { "an.trace",       cmd_an_trace,       "EA|module!Glob* [MAX] find all calls to a function, with arguments" },
        { "an.memmap",      cmd_an_memmap,      "[MAX] [rebuild] the session's memory map (built if there is none); the regions at the playhead" },
        { "an.regions",     cmd_an_regions,     "[MAX] the Memory map listing at the playhead" },
        { "an.handles",     cmd_an_handles,     "[MAX] the handles the program opened and closed" },
        { "an.origin",      cmd_an_origin,      "REG | mem ADDR [SIZE] [from=POS] [stop] where the value at the playhead (or POS) came from; stop: at every computation" },
        { "an.origingraph", cmd_an_origingraph, "REG | mem ADDR [SIZE] [from=POS] [max=N] every chain at once, as the graph draws it" },
        { "an.inputs",      cmd_an_inputs,      "[POS] the values the instruction about to run there read" },
        { "an.autocalls",   cmd_an_autocalls,   "EA resolve indirect calls in the function there, as a stop does automatically" },
        { "an.decode",      cmd_an_decode,      "[MAX] [file=PATH] [saved] decode every syscall's arguments as the Syscalls window does (not saved), with where the time went; file= writes every row, saved: the database's rows" },
        { "an.syscalls",    cmd_an_syscalls,    "[MAX] the recording's syscalls, with arguments" },
        { "an.selfmod",     cmd_an_selfmod,     "[MAX] code the program wrote and then ran" },
        { "an.calltree",    cmd_an_calltree,    "[MAX] the calls the function at the playhead made in this run of it" },
        { "an.strings",     cmd_an_strings,     "[MIN [MAX]] [registry=DIR] [root=DIR] [strict] [host] [anyregistry] [net] strings recovered by a replay" },
        { "an.buffers",     cmd_an_buffers,     "[MAX] [registry=DIR] [root=DIR] [strict] [host] [anyregistry] [net] buffers recovered by a replay" },
        { "an.heat",        cmd_an_heat,        "count every access by page and slice of time (the heatmap)" },
    };

    std::span<const Command> analysis_commands() { return ANALYSIS_COMMANDS; }
}
```

`src/plugin/script_api.cpp`:

```cpp
// The ttd("...") IDC function: the merged command table, 'help',
// dispatch, and the registration. The commands are in script_session.cpp,
// script_analysis.cpp, script_fork.cpp, script_ui.cpp and script_drv.cpp.
#include "plugin/script_api.h"
#include "plugin/script_internal.h"

#include <expr.hpp>

namespace idattd
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ state

    Plugin *g_plugin = nullptr;

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ dispatch

    static void cmd_help(const Args &, JObj &out);

    static const Command API_COMMANDS[] = {
        { "help",           cmd_help,           "this list; every number is hex (0x optional), 0n10 is decimal ten" },
    };

    // Every file's rows, file by file: 'help' lists the commands grouped by
    // what they drive (the session, the analyses, the windows, forks, drv.*),
    // and a new command is added in one place, its own file's table.
    static std::vector<Command> merged_commands()
    {
        const std::span<const Command> parts[] =
        {
            API_COMMANDS, session_commands(), analysis_commands(), ui_commands(),
            fork_commands(), drv_commands(),
        };
        std::vector<Command> all;
        for ( const std::span<const Command> &part : parts )
            all.insert(all.end(), part.begin(), part.end());
        return all;
    }

    // Every row's handler and strings are constants, so the other files'
    // tables are ready before this runs at load.
    static const std::vector<Command> g_commands = merged_commands();

    static void cmd_help(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        JArr arr;
        for ( const Command &c : g_commands )
        {
            qstring line = c.name;
            line.append(' ');
            line.append(c.usage);
            qstring j;
            json_escape(&j, line.c_str());
            arr.add(j);
        }
        out.raw("commands", arr.done());
    }

    static qstring dispatch(const char *line)
    {
        JObj out;
        Args a;
        a.v = tokenize(line != nullptr ? line : "");
        if ( a.v.empty() )
            a.v.push_back("help");
        // A query's wait box pumps the UI, so the session can end under a
        // command (a timer, another script, the user). The query then comes
        // back as not run, which most commands report as the backend being
        // unable to answer: say what really happened instead.
        // Not for the commands that end the session themselves.
        const bool ends_session = a.v[0] == "stop" || a.v[0] == "switch" || a.v[0] == "start";
        const bool was_active = !ends_session && g_plugin != nullptr && mgr().is_active();
        auto why = [&](const char *what) -> qstring
        {
            if ( was_active && (g_plugin == nullptr || !mgr().is_active()) )
                return qstring("the replay session ended while the command ran");
            return qstring(what);
        };
        // No modal box from a stop this command waits for (the trace's edge,
        // a notice): the caller is a script.
        struct QuietStops
        {
            TraceManager *m;
            explicit QuietStops(TraceManager *t) : m(t) { if ( m != nullptr ) m->quiet_stops(true); }
            ~QuietStops() { if ( m != nullptr ) m->quiet_stops(false); }
        } quiet(g_plugin != nullptr ? &mgr() : nullptr);
        try
        {
            const Command *found = nullptr;
            for ( const Command &c : g_commands )
            {
                if ( a.v[0] == c.name )
                {
                    found = &c;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if ( found == nullptr )
                fail("unknown command '%s'; see 'help'", a.v[0].c_str());
            JObj body;
            found->fn(a, body);
            out.boolean("ok", true).str("command", a.v[0]);
            qstring s = out.done();
            qstring b = body.done();
            // Merge: {"ok":true,"command":...} + the command's own fields.
            s.remove_last();
            if ( b.length() > 2 )
            {
                s.append(',');
                s.append(b.c_str() + 1);
            }
            else
            {
                s.append('}');
            }
            return s;
        }
        catch ( const ScriptError &e )
        {
            out.boolean("ok", false).str("command", a.v[0]).str("error", why(e.what.c_str()));
        }
        catch ( const std::exception &e )
        {
            out.boolean("ok", false).str("command", a.v[0]).str("error", why(e.what()));
        }
        catch ( ... )
        {
            // Nothing may unwind into IDA's IDC evaluator.
            out.boolean("ok", false).str("command", a.v[0]).str("error", why("the command failed"));
        }
        return out.done();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ IDC

    static error_t idaapi idc_ttd(idc_value_t *argv, idc_value_t *res)
    {
        qstring answer = dispatch(argv[0].vtype == VT_STR ? argv[0].c_str() : "help");
        res->_set_string(answer);
        return eOk;
    }

    static const char idc_ttd_args[] = { VT_STR, 0 };
    static const ext_idcfunc_t idc_ttd_desc = { "ttd", idc_ttd, idc_ttd_args, nullptr, 0, EXTFUN_BASE };

    void install_script_api(Plugin *plugin)
    {
        g_plugin = plugin;
        if ( !add_idc_func(idc_ttd_desc) )
            msg("[ida-ttd] could not register the IDC function ttd(); scripting is unavailable.\n");
    }

    void remove_script_api()
    {
        del_idc_func("ttd");
        g_drv.close();
        g_plugin = nullptr;
    }
}

```

`src/plugin/script_api.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include "common/pch.h"

namespace idattd
{
    class Plugin;

    // Driving the plugin from a script through one IDC function:
    //
    //     ttd("command arg arg ...")  ->  a JSON string
    //
    // Anything that can evaluate IDC (IDAPython, an MCP server running Python
    // in IDA, the IDC command line) can open recordings, move through them
    // and read what the plugin sees. This is how the plugin is tested without
    // a person at the UI.
    //
    // Arguments are space-separated; double-quote one that holds spaces.
    // Numbers are hex, with or without 0x. Every answer is a JSON object with
    // "ok", plus "error" on failure. "help" lists the commands;
    // scripts/ida_ttd.py wraps this for Python and docs/scripting.md
    // documents it.
    void install_script_api(Plugin *plugin);
    void remove_script_api();
}

```

`src/plugin/script_args.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "plugin/script_args.h"
#include "plugin/script_internal.h"
#include "plugin/settings.h"
#include "analysis/replay_scans.h"

#include <errno.h>

namespace idattd
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ input

    std::vector<qstring> tokenize(const char *line)
    {
        std::vector<qstring> out;
        const char *p = line;
        while ( *p != '\0' )
        {
            while ( *p == ' ' || *p == '\t' )
                p++;
            if ( *p == '\0' )
                break;
            // Quotes may sit anywhere in a word: registry="C:\Program Files\x"
            // is one argument. There is no escape for a literal quote.
            qstring tok;
            bool quoted = false;
            for ( ; *p != '\0' && (quoted || (*p != ' ' && *p != '\t')); p++ )
            {
                if ( *p == '"' )
                    quoted = !quoted;
                else
                    tok.append(*p);
            }
            out.push_back(tok);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // Every number a command takes is hex, with or without "0x", as IDA and
    // WinDbg show addresses; "0n" marks a decimal one, as in WinDbg ("0n10"
    // is ten). One rule for addresses and counts alike: "an.strings 10" is
    // sixteen characters.
    bool parse_u64(const qstring &s, uint64_t *out)
    {
        const char *p = s.c_str();
        int base = 16;
        if ( p[0] == '0' && (p[1] == 'x' || p[1] == 'X') )
            p += 2;
        else if ( p[0] == '0' && (p[1] == 'n' || p[1] == 'N') )
        {
            p += 2;
            base = 10;
        }
        // Reject what strtoull would accept but is no number here: leading
        // blanks, a sign ("-1" as 0xFFFF...), overflow.
        if ( base == 16 ? !isxdigit((unsigned char)*p) : !isdigit((unsigned char)*p) )
            return false;
        char *end = nullptr;
        errno = 0;
        *out = strtoull(p, &end, base);
        return end != nullptr && *end == '\0' && errno != ERANGE;
    }

    [[noreturn]] void fail(const char *fmt, ...)
    {
        va_list va;
        va_start(va, fmt);
        ScriptError e;
        e.what.vsprnt(fmt, va);
        va_end(va);
        throw e;
    }

    // An "rwx"-style word as access bits: any of the letters r, w and x, at
    // least one, nothing else (so "an.search LO HI 50", a MAX where the kinds
    // go, is refused rather than read as no kinds). The backend ABI and the
    // analyses number the kinds differently, so the caller supplies the bits.
    uint8_t rwx_mask(const qstring &k, uint8_t r, uint8_t w, uint8_t x)
    {
        uint8_t m = 0;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < k.length(); i++ )
        {
            switch ( k[i] )
            {
                case 'r': m |= r; break;
                case 'w': m |= w; break;
                case 'x': m |= x; break;
                default:
                    fail("'%s': access kinds are the letters r, w and x", k.c_str());
            }
        }
        if ( m == 0 )
            fail("'%s': name at least one of r, w and x", k.c_str());
        return m;
    }

    // A session position typed by the script, or a failure that says why.
    Position position_arg(const qstring &text)
    {
        Position p;
        if ( !parse_position(text.c_str(), &p) )
            fail("'%s' is not a position (%s)", text.c_str(), position_syntax());
        return p;
    }

    // A word that sets how a recording is made (RecordOptions), over the
    // Sogen settings: net / nonet (network access past a fork's position, or
    // from a new recording's start), ckpt=N (the checkpoint interval, hex
    // like every number here), access=rwx (what is kept: any of r, w, x),
    // elevated (new recordings), log (the emulator's log to the output
    // window).
    bool record_option(const qstring &t, RecordOptions *o)
    {
        if ( t == "net" )
            o->network = true;
        else if ( t == "nonet" )
            o->network = false;
        else if ( t == "elevated" )
            o->elevated = true;
        else if ( t == "log" )
            o->log = true;
        else if ( t.starts_with("ckpt=") )
        {
            uint64_t n = 0;
            if ( !parse_u64(t.substr(5), &n) )
                fail("'%s': the checkpoint interval is a hex number", t.c_str());
            o->checkpoint_interval = n;
        }
        else if ( t.starts_with("access=") )
        {
            o->access_mask = rwx_mask(t.substr(7), ITTD_ACCESS_READ, ITTD_ACCESS_WRITE, ITTD_ACCESS_EXEC);
        }
        else
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    // How long to wait for a stop: "timeout=N" seconds anywhere, else the
    // positional argument 'positional' when the command has one (start,
    // wait and switch take it bare), else a minute.
    int timeout_of(const Args &a, size_t positional)
    {
        uint64_t s = 0x3C;
        if ( const char *t = a.option("timeout") )
        {
            if ( !parse_u64(t, &s) )
                fail("'timeout=%s': the timeout is a number of seconds (hex, or 0n for decimal)", t);
        }
        else if ( positional != SIZE_MAX && positional < a.count() )
        {
            s = a.u64(positional);
        }
        // Capped at a day: a cast alone would turn a large value negative,
        // which IDA reads as "wait forever".
        return (int)qmin(s, uint64_t(86400));
    }

    // Replay options (replay_option) from argument 'from' on. Any other word
    // is refused, so a typo (registy=) is not silently ignored.
    ReplaySettings replay_args(const Args &a, size_t from)
    {
        ReplaySettings rs;
        rs.registry_dir = find_registry_dir(&mgr());
        rs.emulation_root = chosen_emulation_root(&mgr());
        rs.rec = recording_options();
        for ( size_t i = from; i < a.count(); i++ )
            if ( !replay_option(a.at(i), &rs) )
                fail("'%s' is not %s", a.at(i).c_str(), REPLAY_OPTIONS);
        return rs;
    }

    // How many arguments come before the first replay option; more than
    // 'most' is refused, so a stray word is not silently ignored.
    size_t plain_args(const Args &a, size_t most)
    {
        ReplaySettings scratch;
        size_t n = 0;
        while ( n < a.count() && !replay_option(a.at(n), &scratch) )
            n++;
        if ( n > most )
            fail("'%s': at most %d number(s) come before the options, which are %s",
                 a.at(most).c_str(), (int)most, REPLAY_OPTIONS);
        return n;
    }
}
```

`src/plugin/script_args.h`:

```h
#pragma once

// Reading a script command's words: the tokenizer, the arguments with
// their number, flag and option parsers, and the recording and replay
// options. A bad word throws ScriptError (fail), which dispatch turns into
// the command's error. The parsers' rules are beside their definitions in
// script_args.cpp.
#include "common/pch.h"
#include "core/backend.h"
#include "core/position.h"

#include <initializer_list>
#include <vector>

namespace idattd
{
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ input

    // The words of a command line; double quotes group a word.
    std::vector<qstring> tokenize(const char *line);
    // A number as every command takes it: hex, or decimal after "0n".
    bool parse_u64(const qstring &s, uint64_t *out);
    // Throw a ScriptError with the formatted message.
    [[noreturn]] void fail(const char *fmt, ...);

    // Thrown for a bad command; turned into {"ok":false,"error":...}.
    struct ScriptError
    {
        qstring what;
    };

    struct Args
    {
        std::vector<qstring> v;     // v[0] is the command

        size_t count() const { return v.size() - 1; }
        const qstring &at(size_t i) const
        {
            if ( i + 1 >= v.size() )
                fail("'%s' needs more arguments; see 'help'", v[0].c_str());
            return v[i + 1];
        }
        uint64_t u64(size_t i) const
        {
            uint64_t x = 0;
            if ( !parse_u64(at(i), &x) )
                fail("'%s' is not a hex number", at(i).c_str());
            return x;
        }
        uint64_t u64_or(size_t i, uint64_t dflt) const { return i < count() ? u64(i) : dflt; }
        static bool is_back(const qstring &w)
        {
            return w == "back" || w == "backward" || w == "backwards";
        }
        // A "back", "backward" or "backwards" after the positional arguments
        // reverses a movement.
        bool back() const
        {
            for ( size_t i = 1; i < v.size(); i++ )
                if ( is_back(v[i]) )
                    return true;
            return false;
        }
        // The value of a "name=VALUE" word, or nullptr.
        const char *option(const char *name) const
        {
            const size_t n = qstrlen(name);
            for ( size_t i = 1; i < v.size(); i++ )
                if ( v[i].length() > n && v[i][n] == '=' && strneq(v[i].c_str(), name, n) )
                    return v[i].c_str() + n + 1;
            return nullptr;
        }
        // Refuse any word after the first 'positional' arguments that is
        // not one of 'words' (a flag, or "name=" for an option): a typo
        // ("runto 401000 bakc") must not quietly do something else.
        void only(size_t positional, std::initializer_list<const char *> words) const
        {
            for ( size_t i = positional + 1; i < v.size(); i++ )
            {
                bool known = false;
                for ( const char *w : words )
                {
                    const size_t n = qstrlen(w);
                    known = n != 0 && w[n - 1] == '='
                          ? strneq(v[i].c_str(), w, n)
                          : v[i] == w;
                    if ( known )
                        break;
                }
                if ( !known )
                    fail("'%s': unknown word '%s'; see 'help'", v[0].c_str(), v[i].c_str());
            }
        }
    };

    // An "rwx"-style word as access bits, in the caller's numbering.
    uint8_t rwx_mask(const qstring &k, uint8_t r, uint8_t w, uint8_t x);
    // A session position typed by the script.
    Position position_arg(const qstring &text);
    // A word that sets how a recording is made; false when it is not one.
    bool record_option(const qstring &t, RecordOptions *o);

    // What replay_option accepts, for the message refusing anything else.
    inline constexpr char REPLAY_OPTIONS[] = "registry=DIR, root=DIR, strict, host, anyregistry, "
                                             "net, nonet, ckpt=N, access=rwx, elevated or log";

    // A word that sets up a Sogen replay: registry=DIR, root=DIR (the
    // emulation root, when it is elsewhere here), strict, host, or
    // anyregistry (accept hives that are not the recording's), or one of
    // record_option's. ForkRequest and ReplaySettings name the fields alike.
    template <typename T>
    inline bool replay_option(const qstring &t, T *s)
    {
        if ( record_option(t, &s->rec) )
            return true;
        if ( t.starts_with("registry=") )
            s->registry_dir = t.substr(9);
        else if ( t.starts_with("root=") )
            s->emulation_root = t.substr(5);
        else if ( t == "strict" )
            s->strict = true;
        else if ( t == "host" )
            s->allow_host = true;
        else if ( t == "anyregistry" )
            s->any_registry = true;
        else
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    // How long to wait for a stop, in seconds (timeout=N, else the
    // positional argument 'positional' when there is one, else a minute).
    int timeout_of(const Args &a, size_t positional = SIZE_MAX);
    // The replay options from argument 'from' on.
    ReplaySettings replay_args(const Args &a, size_t from);
    // How many arguments come before the first replay option.
    size_t plain_args(const Args &a, size_t most);
}

```

`src/plugin/script_drv.cpp`:

```cpp
// The drv.* script commands: a recording opened through a backend, with
// no debugger session, to exercise the backend and the core's adapter.
#include "plugin/script_internal.h"
#include "core/backend_registry.h"
#include "core/backend_module.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"

namespace idattd
{
    Driver g_drv;

    static ITraceBackend &drv()
    {
        if ( g_drv.backend == nullptr || !g_drv.backend->is_open() )
            fail("no recording is open for drv.*; use 'drv.open PATH'");
        return *g_drv.backend;
    }

    static const char *stop_name(StopReason r)
    {
        switch ( r )
        {
            case StopReason::Stepped:       return "stepped";
            case StopReason::Breakpoint:    return "breakpoint";
            case StopReason::TraceBoundary: return "boundary";
            default:                        return "failed";
        }
    }

    static qstring regs_json(const ittd_regs &r)
    {
        static const char *gp[ITTD_REG_GP_COUNT] = {
            "rax", "rcx", "rdx", "rbx", "rsp", "rbp", "rsi", "rdi",
            "r8", "r9", "r10", "r11", "r12", "r13", "r14", "r15", "rip",
        };
        JObj o;
        if ( (r.have & ITTD_REGS_GP) == 0 )
            return o.boolean("known", false).done();
        for ( int i = 0; i < ITTD_REG_GP_COUNT; i++ )
            o.hex(gp[i], r.gp[i]);
        o.hex("rflags", r.rflags).hex("fs_base", r.fs_base).hex("gs_base", r.gs_base);
        return o.done();
    }

    qstring bytes_json(const uint8_t *buf, const uint8_t *known, size_t n)
    {
        // Hex pairs, "??" for a byte the recording does not account for.
        qstring s;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < n; i++ )
        {
            if ( known != nullptr && known[i] == ITTD_KNOWN_NO )
                s.append("??");
            else
                s.cat_sprnt("%02x", buf[i]);
        }
        qstring j;
        json_escape(&j, s.c_str());
        return j;
    }

    static qstring position_text(ITraceBackend &b, Position p) { return b.format_position(p); }
    static Position from_abi_position(ittd_position p) { return Position{ p.hi, p.lo }; }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ drv.*

    static void cmd_drv_open(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        const qstring &path = a.at(0);
        g_drv.close();
        load_backend_modules();
        ITraceBackend *kind = a.count() > 1 ? BackendRegistry::instance().by_id(a.at(1).c_str())
                                            : BackendRegistry::instance().for_file(path.c_str());
        if ( kind == nullptr )
            fail("no loaded backend handles %s", path.c_str());
        g_drv.owned = kind->new_instance();
        if ( g_drv.owned == nullptr )
            fail("the %s backend cannot open a recording beside the debugger's", kind->id());
        ITraceBackend *b = g_drv.owned.get();
        qstring err;
        if ( !b->open(path.c_str(), &err) )
        {
            qstring id = b->id();
            g_drv.close();
            fail("%s could not open %s: %s", id.c_str(), path.c_str(), err.c_str());
        }
        // As a session does: without it a Microsoft trace has no memory
        // index and reads come back mostly empty.
        prepare_backend(b);
        g_drv.backend = b;
        g_drv.path    = path;
        g_drv.cursor  = b->make_cursor();
        if ( g_drv.cursor )
            g_drv.nav = b->make_navigator(g_drv.cursor.get());
        // Every other drv.* command needs both; do not leave it half-usable.
        if ( !g_drv.cursor || !g_drv.nav )
        {
            qstring id = b->id();
            g_drv.close();
            fail("%s opened the recording but made no cursor", id.c_str());
        }
        g_drv.cursor->seek(b->info().first);
        g_drv.handle++;
        out.str("backend", b->id()).num("handle", (int64_t)g_drv.handle);
    }

    static void cmd_drv_info(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        const TraceInfo &ti = b.info();
        const Capabilities &c = b.capabilities();
        JObj caps;
        caps.boolean("access_queries", c.access_queries).boolean("call_queries", c.call_queries)
            .boolean("mapping_changes", c.mapping_changes).boolean("syscalls", c.syscalls)
            .boolean("recorded_exports", c.recorded_exports)
            .boolean("batch_regs", c.batch_regs)
            .boolean("reverse_step", c.reverse_step).boolean("exceptions", c.exceptions)
            .boolean("cheap_reads", c.cheap_reads).boolean("self_modifying", c.self_modifying)
            .boolean("fork", c.fork).boolean("replay_scans", c.replay_scans);
        out.str("backend", b.id()).str("backend_name", ti.backend_name).str("path", g_drv.path)
           .str("main_module", ti.main_module).boolean("is64", ti.is64)
           .hex("fingerprint", ti.fingerprint)
           .str("first", position_text(b, ti.first)).str("last", position_text(b, ti.last))
           .str("position_syntax", b.position_syntax()).raw("capabilities", caps.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_modules(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        JArr arr;
        for ( const ModuleInfo &m : b.modules() )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("name", m.name).str("path", m.path).hex("base", m.base).hex("size", m.size)
             .num("machine", m.machine).str("loaded", position_text(b, m.loaded))
             .str("unloaded", position_text(b, m.unloaded));
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.raw("modules", arr.done());
    }

    static qstring thread_json(ITraceBackend &b, const ThreadInfo &t)
    {
        JObj o;
        o.num("tid", t.tid).str("name", t.name).str("created", position_text(b, t.created))
         .str("exited", position_text(b, t.exited)).hex("teb", t.teb)
         .hex("stack_base", t.stack_base).hex("stack_limit", t.stack_limit);
        return o.done();
    }

    static void cmd_drv_threads(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        bool live = a.count() > 0 && a.at(0) == "live";
        JArr arr;
        for ( const ThreadInfo &t : live ? g_drv.cursor->live_threads() : b.threads() )
            arr.add(thread_json(b, t));
        out.raw("threads", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_timeline(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 200);
        std::vector<TraceEvent> ev = b.timeline();
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < ev.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, ev[i].pos)).str("what", ev[i].what)
             .num("kind", ev[i].kind).num("tid", ev[i].tid);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)ev.size()).raw("events", arr.done());
    }

    static void cursor_state(JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        ittd_regs r;
        out.str("pos", position_text(b, g_drv.cursor->position()))
           .num("tid", g_drv.cursor->thread_id());
        if ( g_drv.cursor->read_registers(&r) )
            out.hex("pc", r.gp[ITTD_REG_RIP]).hex("sp", r.gp[ITTD_REG_RSP]);
    }

    static void cmd_drv_pos(const Args &, JObj &out) { cursor_state(out); }

    static void cmd_drv_seek(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        Position p;
        if ( a.at(0) == "first" )
            p = b.info().first;
        else if ( a.at(0) == "last" )
            p = b.info().last;
        else if ( !b.parse_position(a.at(0).c_str(), &p) )
            fail("'%s' is not a position (%s)", a.at(0).c_str(), b.position_syntax());
        if ( !g_drv.cursor->seek(p) )
            fail("could not seek to %s", a.at(0).c_str());
        cursor_state(out);
    }

    static void movement(const char *what, StopReason r, JObj &out)
    {
        out.str("movement", what).str("stop", stop_name(r));
        cursor_state(out);
    }

    static void cmd_drv_step(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    { drv(); movement("step", g_drv.nav->step(!a.back()), out); }
    static void cmd_drv_over(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    { drv(); movement("over", g_drv.nav->step_over(!a.back()), out); }
    static void cmd_drv_out(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    { drv(); movement("out", g_drv.nav->step_out(!a.back()), out); }
    static void cmd_drv_run(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    { drv(); movement("run", g_drv.nav->run(!a.back()), out); }
    static void cmd_drv_runto(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    { drv(); movement("runto", g_drv.nav->run_to((ea_t)a.u64(0), !a.back()), out); }

    static void query_status(const QueryResult &r, JObj &out);

    // EA, or EA:SIZE:KINDS with KINDS any of r, w, x.
    static Breakpoint parse_bp(const qstring &spec)
    {
        Breakpoint b;
        qstring rest = spec;
        size_t c1 = rest.find(':');
        qstring ea = c1 == qstring::npos ? rest : rest.substr(0, c1);
        uint64_t v = 0;
        if ( !parse_u64(ea, &v) )
            fail("'%s' is not a breakpoint (EA or EA:SIZE:rwx)", spec.c_str());
        b.addr = (ea_t)v;
        if ( c1 == qstring::npos )
            return b;
        qstring tail = rest.substr(c1 + 1);
        size_t c2 = tail.find(':');
        qstring sz = c2 == qstring::npos ? tail : tail.substr(0, c2);
        if ( !parse_u64(sz, &v) || v == 0 )
            fail("'%s': bad size", spec.c_str());
        b.size = v;
        qstring k = c2 == qstring::npos ? qstring("w") : tail.substr(c2 + 1);
        b.kinds = rwx_mask(k, ACCESS_READ, ACCESS_WRITE, ACCESS_EXEC);
        if ( b.kinds == 0 )
            fail("'%s': kinds are r, w and x", spec.c_str());
        return b;
    }

    static void cmd_drv_bp(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        drv();
        std::vector<Breakpoint> v;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < a.count(); i++ )
            v.push_back(parse_bp(a.at(i)));
        g_drv.nav->set_breakpoints(v);
        out.num("breakpoints", (int64_t)v.size());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_insns(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t n = a.u64_or(0, 0x20);
        // Bounded like drv.read's size: every instruction becomes a JSON object.
        if ( n == 0 || n > 0x10000 )
            fail("list at most 0x10000 instructions");
        // To the end of the recording: the backend stops after 'n', and a
        // position window would mean something different to each backend.
        Position from = g_drv.cursor->position();
        Position to   = Position::end();
        std::vector<Access> v;
        query_status(b.query_instructions(PositionRange{ from, to }, g_drv.cursor->thread_id(),
                                          (size_t)n, &v, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( const Access &x : v )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, x.pos)).hex("pc", x.pc).num("size", x.size).num("tid", x.tid);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.raw("instructions", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_regs(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        drv();
        ittd_regs r;
        if ( !g_drv.cursor->read_registers(&r) )
        {
            BackendModule *m = dynamic_cast<BackendModule *>(g_drv.backend);
            fail("no registers here%s%s", m != nullptr ? ": " : "",
                 m != nullptr ? m->last_error().c_str() : "");
        }
        cursor_state(out);
        out.raw("regs", regs_json(r));
    }

    static void cmd_drv_read(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        drv();
        uint64_t ea = a.u64(0), size = a.u64_or(1, 0x40);
        if ( size == 0 || size > 0x10000 )
            fail("read at most 0x10000 bytes");
        std::vector<uint8_t> buf((size_t)size), known;
        size_t n = g_drv.cursor->read_memory((ea_t)ea, buf.data(), buf.size(), &known);
        out.hex("ea", ea).num("size", (int64_t)size).num("known", (int64_t)n)
           .raw("bytes", bytes_json(buf.data(), known.data(), buf.size()));
    }

    static void query_status(const QueryResult &r, JObj &out)
    {
        if ( !r.ran )
            fail("the backend did not run that query");
        out.boolean("truncated", r.truncated).boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled);
    }

    static void cmd_drv_accesses(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t lo = a.u64(0), hi = a.u64(1);
        uint8_t kinds = rwx_mask(a.count() > 2 ? a.at(2) : qstring("rwx"),
                                 ACCESS_READ, ACCESS_WRITE, ACCESS_EXEC);
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(3, 200);
        std::vector<Access> v;
        query_status(b.query_accesses((ea_t)lo, (ea_t)hi, kinds, PositionRange{}, &v, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, v[i].pos)).hex("pc", v[i].pc).hex("addr", v[i].addr)
             .num("size", v[i].size).num("tid", v[i].tid)
             .str("kind", v[i].kind == ACCESS_READ ? "r" : v[i].kind == ACCESS_WRITE ? "w" : "x");
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("accesses", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_calls(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t target = a.u64(0), max = a.u64_or(1, 200);
        std::vector<CallEvent> v;
        query_status(b.query_calls({ (ea_t)target }, PositionRange{}, &v, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, v[i].pos)).str("entry", position_text(b, v[i].entry_pos))
             .str("ret", position_text(b, v[i].ret_pos)).hex("site", v[i].site)
             .num("tid", v[i].tid).boolean("is_call", v[i].is_call);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("calls", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_indirect(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        bool jumps = a.count() > 2 && a.at(2) == "jumps";
        std::map<ea_t, std::vector<IndirectTarget>> m;
        query_status(b.query_indirect_targets({ { (ea_t)a.u64(0), (ea_t)a.u64(1) } }, jumps, &m, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( const auto &[site, targets] : m )
            for ( const IndirectTarget &t : targets )
            {
                JObj o;
                o.hex("site", site).hex("target", t.target).num("hits", (int64_t)t.hits)
                 .str("first", position_text(b, t.first)).boolean("is_call", t.is_call);
                arr.add(o.done());
            }
        out.num("sites", (int64_t)m.size()).raw("edges", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_exceptions(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        std::vector<ExceptionEvent> v;
        query_status(b.query_exceptions(&v, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( const ExceptionEvent &e : v )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, e.pos)).str("raised", position_text(b, e.raise_pos))
             .hex("code", e.code).hex("address", e.address).num("tid", e.tid)
             .hex("info0", e.information[0]).hex("info1", e.information[1]);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.raw("exceptions", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_syscalls(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 200);
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> v;
        query_status(b.query_syscalls(&v, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, v[i].pos)).num("tid", v[i].tid)
             .hex("number", v[i].number).str("name", v[i].name).hex("result", v[i].result);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("syscalls", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_map(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(0, 200);
        std::vector<ittd_mapping_change> v;
        std::vector<qstring> files;
        query_status(b.query_mapping_changes(&v, &files, nullptr), out);
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            const ittd_mapping_change &m = v[i];
            JObj o;
            o.str("pos", position_text(b, from_abi_position(m.pos)))
             .str("call", position_text(b, from_abi_position(m.call_pos)))
             .hex("base", m.base).hex("size", m.size).num("kind", m.kind).hex("flags", m.flags)
             .hex("state", m.state).hex("type", m.mem_type).hex("protect", m.protect)
             .hex("alloc_base", m.alloc_base).hex("alloc_protect", m.alloc_protect)
             .num("region_type", m.region_type)
             .str("file", m.file > 0 && m.file <= files.size() ? files[m.file - 1] : qstring());
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("changes", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_symbols(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        ITraceBackend &b = drv();
        uint64_t max = a.u64_or(1, 200);
        std::vector<ITraceBackend::Symbol> v = b.module_symbols((ea_t)a.u64(0));
        JArr arr;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < v.size() && i < max; i++ )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.hex("ea", v[i].ea).str("name", v[i].name);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("symbols", arr.done());
    }

    static void cmd_drv_close(const Args &, JObj &) { g_drv.close(); }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ commands

    static const Command DRV_COMMANDS[] = {
        { "drv.open",       cmd_drv_open,       "PATH [BACKEND] open a recording through a backend, no debugger" },
        { "drv.close",      cmd_drv_close,      "close it" },
        { "drv.info",       cmd_drv_info,       "trace info and capabilities" },
        { "drv.modules",    cmd_drv_modules,    "modules" },
        { "drv.threads",    cmd_drv_threads,    "[live] threads, or those alive at the cursor" },
        { "drv.timeline",   cmd_drv_timeline,   "[MAX] timeline events" },
        { "drv.pos",        cmd_drv_pos,        "the cursor's position, thread, pc and sp" },
        { "drv.seek",       cmd_drv_seek,       "POS|first|last move the cursor" },
        { "drv.step",       cmd_drv_step,       "[back]" },
        { "drv.over",       cmd_drv_over,       "[back]" },
        { "drv.out",        cmd_drv_out,        "[back]" },
        { "drv.run",        cmd_drv_run,        "[back] to a breakpoint set with drv.bp" },
        { "drv.runto",      cmd_drv_runto,      "EA [back]" },
        { "drv.bp",         cmd_drv_bp,         "EA|EA:SIZE:rwx ... replace the breakpoints" },
        { "drv.insns",      cmd_drv_insns,      "[N] the next N instructions on the cursor's thread" },
        { "drv.regs",       cmd_drv_regs,       "registers at the cursor" },
        { "drv.read",       cmd_drv_read,       "EA [SIZE] memory at the cursor, ?? where unknown" },
        { "drv.accesses",   cmd_drv_accesses,   "LO HI [rwx] [MAX] accesses to [LO, HI)" },
        { "drv.calls",      cmd_drv_calls,      "EA [MAX] calls to a function" },
        { "drv.indirect",   cmd_drv_indirect,   "LO HI [jumps] indirect branch targets from [LO, HI)" },
        { "drv.exceptions", cmd_drv_exceptions, "dispatched exceptions" },
        { "drv.syscalls",   cmd_drv_syscalls,   "[MAX] dispatched syscalls" },
        { "drv.map",        cmd_drv_map,        "[MAX] memory map changes" },
        { "drv.symbols",    cmd_drv_symbols,    "BASE [MAX] a module's recorded exports" },
    };

    std::span<const Command> drv_commands() { return DRV_COMMANDS; }
}
```

`src/plugin/script_fork.cpp`:

```cpp
// The an.* script commands on forks and Sogen recordings: forking,
// the fork being prepared, the fork graph, the registry hives a replay
// uses, and recording a program.
#include "plugin/script_internal.h"
#include "plugin/settings.h"
#include "analysis/fork.h"
#include "analysis/fork_registry.h"
#include "analysis/replay_scans.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // an.fork PATH N [registry=DIR] [strict] [REG=VALUE ...] [mem:ADDR=HEXBYTES ...]
    static void cmd_an_fork(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        ForkRequest req;
        req.rec              = recording_options();
        req.at               = mgr().current_position();
        req.path             = a.at(0);
        req.max_instructions = a.u64(1);
        qstring regs, mem;
        for ( size_t i = 2; i < a.count(); i++ )
        {
            const qstring &t = a.at(i);
            if ( replay_option(t, &req) )
                continue;
            if ( t.starts_with("mem:") )
                mem.cat_sprnt("%s;", t.c_str() + 4);
            else
                regs.cat_sprnt("%s ", t.c_str());
        }
        qstring err;
        if ( !parse_fork_registers(regs.c_str(), &req.regs, &err)
          || !parse_fork_memory(mem.c_str(), &req.memory, &err) )
            fail("%s", err.c_str());
        req.note = "ida-ttd script";
        ForkResult r = run_fork(&mgr(), req);
        if ( !r.ok )
            fail("the fork failed: %s", r.error.c_str());
        out.boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled).num("instructions", (int64_t)r.instructions)
           .str("at", format_position(req.at)).str("path", req.path);
    }

    static void draft_json(JObj &out)
    {
        const TraceManager::ForkDraft &d = mgr().fork_draft();
        out.boolean("forking", d.active);
        if ( !d.active )
            return;
        JArr regs, mem;
        ForkRequest req;
        mgr().fill_fork_request(&req);
        for ( const auto &[idx, v] : req.regs )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.num("reg", idx).hex("value", (uint64)v);
            regs.add(o.done());
        }
        for ( const auto &[ea, bytes] : req.memory )
        {
            JObj o;
            qstring hex;
            for ( uchar b : bytes )
                hex.cat_sprnt("%02X", b);
            o.hex("address", ea).str("bytes", hex);
            mem.add(o.done());
        }
        out.str("at", format_position(d.at)).boolean("here", mgr().at_fork_draft())
           .raw("regs", regs.done()).raw("memory", mem.done());
    }

    // an.registry: where the recording's hives are looked for, what each
    // place holds, and the folder a replay would use.
    static void cmd_an_registry(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr().backend();
        ReplayEnv env;
        if ( b->replay_env(&env) )
        {
            out.boolean("host", env.host).boolean("registry_known", env.registry_known)
               .boolean("registry_carried", env.registry_carried)
               .str("chosen_root", chosen_emulation_root(&mgr()))
               .str("emulation_root", env.emulation_root).str("registry_hint", env.registry_hint)
               .str("windows_version", env.windows_version)
               .str("system_dlls", env.system_dlls == ITTD_DLLS_SAME   ? "same"
                                 : env.system_dlls == ITTD_DLLS_DIFFER ? "differ" : "unknown");
        }
        JArr arr;
        for ( const qstring &dir : registry_candidates(&mgr()) )
        {
            qstring why;
            HiveCheck c = b->check_registry(dir.c_str(), &why);
            JObj o;
            o.str("dir", dir)
             .str("holds", c == HiveCheck::Match      ? "match"
                         : c == HiveCheck::Unverified ? "unverified"
                         : c == HiveCheck::Mismatch   ? "mismatch" : "none");
            if ( c == HiveCheck::Mismatch )
                o.str("why", why);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.raw("candidates", arr.done()).str("chosen", find_registry_dir(&mgr()));
    }

    // an.forks: the forks this database knows of (the Fork manager's graph).
    static void cmd_an_forks(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        JArr arr;
        bool ok = true;
        std::vector<ForkRecord> v = load_fork_records(&ok);
        if ( !ok )
            fail("the fork list in this database could not be read");
        for ( const ForkRecord &f : v )
        {
            JObj o;
            o.str("path", f.path).str("parent", f.parent).str("at", f.at).str("changes", f.changes)
             .num("instructions", (int64_t)f.instructions);
            arr.add(o.done());
        }
        out.num("count", (int64_t)v.size()).raw("forks", arr.done());
    }

    // an.forget PATH: take a fork out of the graph.
    static void cmd_an_forget(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        remove_fork_record(a.at(0).c_str());
        out.num("count", (int64_t)load_fork_records(nullptr).size());
    }

    // Whether the views show a fork's changes right now, which is what
    // fork_draft_changed() needs to know to repaint them.
    static bool draft_shown()
    {
        const TraceManager::ForkDraft &d = mgr().fork_draft();
        return mgr().at_fork_draft() && (!d.regs.empty() || !d.bytes.empty());
    }

    // an.forkhere: make the current position a fork (TTD > Fork here); change
    // it through IDA's own debugger calls.
    static void cmd_an_forkhere(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        bool shown = draft_shown();
        mgr().begin_fork_draft();
        fork_draft_changed(g_plugin->action_context(), shown);
        draft_json(out);
    }

    // an.forkdraft: the fork being prepared, with its changes.
    static void cmd_an_forkdraft(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        draft_json(out);
    }

    static void cmd_an_forkdiscard(const Args &, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        bool shown = draft_shown();
        mgr().discard_fork_draft();
        fork_draft_changed(g_plugin->action_context(), shown);
        draft_json(out);
    }

    // an.forkrecord PATH N [registry=DIR] [strict] [host]: record the fork
    // being prepared (TTD > Record fork).
    static void cmd_an_forkrecord(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        need_session();
        if ( !mgr().fork_draft().active )
            fail("there is no fork; an.forkhere first");
        ForkRequest req;
        mgr().fill_fork_request(&req);
        req.rec              = recording_options();
        req.path             = a.at(0);
        req.max_instructions = a.u64(1);
        for ( size_t i = 2; i < a.count(); i++ )
        {
            const qstring &t = a.at(i);
            if ( !replay_option(t, &req) )
                fail("'%s' is not %s", t.c_str(), REPLAY_OPTIONS);
        }
        req.note = "ida-ttd script";
        ForkResult r = run_fork(&mgr(), req);
        if ( !r.ok )
        {
            need_session();     // the session may have ended during the fork
            ReplayBlock b = mgr().backend()->last_replay_block();
            fail("the fork failed%s: %s",
                 b == ReplayBlock::HostConsent ? " (needs host)"
                 : b == ReplayBlock::Registry ? " (needs registry=DIR)"
                 : b == ReplayBlock::RegistryMismatch ? " (wrong hives: registry=DIR or anyregistry)" : "",
                 r.error.c_str());
        }
        out.boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled).num("instructions", (int64_t)r.instructions)
           .str("at", format_position(req.at)).str("path", req.path)
           .num("regs", (int64_t)req.regs.size()).num("writes", (int64_t)req.memory.size());
    }

    // an.record PROGRAM PATH [N] [args="..."] [cwd=DIR] [registry=DIR]
    // [root=DIR] [host] [start=now|1970|DATE] [net] [ckpt=N] [access=rwx]
    // [elevated] [log]: run PROGRAM from its start in Sogen's emulator and
    // record N instructions (hex; none or 0: until it exits) into PATH (TTD >
    // Backends > Record a program with Sogen). Without root=, 'host' is the
    // consent to run it against this machine's files; the hives are
    // registry=, else the first known folder that holds some. start= is the
    // date it starts at (default: the sogen_start_now setting).
    static void cmd_an_record(const Args &a, JObj &out)
    {
        RecordRequest req;
        req.rec         = recording_options();
        req.application = a.at(0);
        req.path        = a.at(1);
        qstring place;
        qstring start = settings().sogen_start_now ? "now" : "1970";
        bool replace = false;
        for ( size_t i = 2; i < a.count(); i++ )
        {
            const qstring &t = a.at(i);
            uint64_t n = 0;
            if ( record_option(t, &req.rec) )
                continue;
            if ( t.starts_with("place=") )
                place = t.substr(6);
            else if ( t == "replace" )
                replace = true;
            else if ( t.starts_with("args=") )
                req.arguments = t.substr(5);
            else if ( t.starts_with("cwd=") )
                req.working_dir = t.substr(4);
            else if ( t.starts_with("registry=") )
                req.registry_dir = t.substr(9);
            else if ( t.starts_with("root=") )
                req.emulation_root = t.substr(5);
            else if ( t == "host" )
                req.allow_host = true;
            else if ( t.starts_with("start=") )
                start = t.substr(6);
            else if ( i == 2 && parse_u64(t, &n) )
                req.max_instructions = n;
            else
                fail("'%s' is not N, args=, cwd=, registry=, root=, place=, replace, host, start=, net, ckpt=N, "
                     "access=rwx, elevated or log", t.c_str());
        }
        // start=now, start=1970 or start=YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (UTC): the
        // system time the program starts at.
        if ( start == "now" )
        {
            req.start_time = (int64_t)time(nullptr);
        }
        else if ( start != "1970" )
        {
            int y = 0, mo = 0, d = 0, h = 0, mi = 0, s = 0;
            char tail = '\0';
            const int got = sscanf(start.c_str(), "%4d-%2d-%2dT%2d:%2d:%2d%c", &y, &mo, &d, &h, &mi, &s, &tail);
            struct tm tm = {};
            tm.tm_year = y - 1900;
            tm.tm_mon  = mo - 1;
            tm.tm_mday = d;
            tm.tm_hour = h;
            tm.tm_min  = mi;
            tm.tm_sec  = s;
            const bool shape = got == 6 || (got == 7 && tail == 'Z');
            const time_t when = shape && y >= 1970 && mo >= 1 && mo <= 12 && d >= 1 && d <= 31
                             && h <= 23 && mi <= 59 && s <= 59 ? _mkgmtime(&tm) : (time_t)-1;
            // _mkgmtime normalizes 31 February into March: refuse that.
            if ( when == (time_t)-1 || tm.tm_mday != d )
                fail("'start=%s': give now, 1970 or a UTC time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS", start.c_str());
            req.start_time = (int64_t)when;
        }
        // place=DIR: a program outside the emulation root is copied into it
        // first (the guest sees only the root).
        qstring placed_note;
        if ( !place.empty() && !req.emulation_root.empty()
          && !visible_in_emulation_root(req.emulation_root.c_str(), req.application.c_str()) )
        {
            qstring placed, err;
            PlaceResult pr = place_in_emulation_root(req.emulation_root.c_str(), req.application.c_str(),
                                                     place.c_str(), replace, &placed, &err);
            if ( pr == PlaceResult::Differs )
                fail("the emulation root already has a different %s; add 'replace' to overwrite it", placed.c_str());
            if ( pr == PlaceResult::Failed )
                fail("%s", err.c_str());
            placed_note = pr == PlaceResult::Placed ? "copied" : "already there";
            req.application = placed;
        }
        if ( req.emulation_root.empty() && req.registry_dir.empty() )
        {
            for ( const qstring &dir : registry_candidates(nullptr) )
            {
                qstring system = dir;
                system.append("\\SYSTEM");
                if ( qfileexist(system.c_str()) )
                {
                    req.registry_dir = dir;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        ForkResult r = run_record(req);
        if ( !r.ok )
            fail("the program was not recorded%s: %s",
                 r.block == ReplayBlock::HostConsent ? " (needs host or root=DIR)"
                 : r.block == ReplayBlock::Registry ? " (needs registry=DIR)" : "",
                 r.error.c_str());
        out.boolean("cancelled", r.cancelled).num("instructions", (int64_t)r.instructions)
           .str("path", req.path).boolean("network", req.rec.network)
           .str("program", req.application).str("placed", placed_note);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ commands

    static const Command FORK_COMMANDS[] = {
        { "an.registry",    cmd_an_registry,    "where the recording's registry hives are looked for, and what each place holds" },
        { "an.forks",       cmd_an_forks,       "the forks recorded in this database" },
        { "an.forget",      cmd_an_forget,      "PATH take a fork out of the fork graph" },
        { "an.forkhere",    cmd_an_forkhere,    "make this position a fork; change it with IDA's debugger calls" },
        { "an.forkdraft",   cmd_an_forkdraft,   "the fork being prepared and its changes" },
        { "an.forkdiscard", cmd_an_forkdiscard, "drop the fork being prepared" },
        { "an.forkrecord",  cmd_an_forkrecord,  "PATH N [registry=DIR] [root=DIR] [strict] [host] [anyregistry] [net] [ckpt=N] [access=rwx] [log] record the fork being prepared" },
        { "an.fork",        cmd_an_fork,        "PATH N [registry=DIR] [root=DIR] [strict] [host] [anyregistry] [net] [ckpt=N] [access=rwx] [log] [REG=V ...] [mem:EA=HEX ...] fork here" },
        { "an.record",      cmd_an_record,      "PROGRAM PATH [N] [args=\"...\"] [cwd=DIR] [registry=DIR] [root=DIR] [place=DIR] [replace] [host] [start=now|1970|DATE] [net] [ckpt=N] [access=rwx] [elevated] [log] record a program with Sogen" },
    };

    std::span<const Command> fork_commands() { return FORK_COMMANDS; }
}
```
