`src/ui/ui_fork.cpp`:

```cpp
// Forking the recording: beginning a fork, recording it, and what a replay
// asks the user for.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "analysis/fork.h"
#include "core/backend_module.h"
#include "plugin/settings.h"
#include "common/trace_link.h"

namespace idattd
{
    static bool backend_forks(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        return mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && mgr->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr->backend()->capabilities().fork;
    }

    static bool has_changes(const TraceManager::ForkDraft &d)
    {
        return !d.regs.empty() || !d.bytes.empty();
    }

    // Text for an ask_form description: '#', '<', '>', '~' and '@' mean
    // something there, and a message from a backend may hold any of them.
    static qstring form_text(const qstring &s)
    {
        qstring out;
        // Not strchr(): it finds the terminating zero too, and a range-for
        // over a qstring reaches that zero (body.end() is past it), so every
        // text ended in a stray quote.
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++ )
        {
            const char c = s[i];
            out.append(c == '#' || c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '~' || c == '@' ? '\'' : c);
        }
        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- replay consent

    // The recording this IDA may replay against the host, so consent is asked
    // once per recording rather than per replay.
    static qstring g_hostConsent;

    // For the Registry hives dialog: what a replay needs, and what each
    // searched folder holds.
    static qstring replay_needs_text(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();
        ReplayEnv env;
        bool known = b->replay_env(&env);
        qstring s;
        if ( known )
        {
            if ( env.host )
                s = "This recording was made against its machine's own files";
            else
                s.sprnt("This recording was made in the emulation root %s", env.emulation_root.c_str());
            if ( !env.windows_version.empty() )
                s.cat_sprnt(", on Windows %s", env.windows_version.c_str());
            s.append(".\n");
            if ( env.system_dlls == ITTD_DLLS_DIFFER )
                s.append(env.host
                       ? "This machine's system DLLs (ntdll, kernel32, kernelbase) are not the ones it\n"
                         "ran with, so a replay here stops early, whatever the hives: replay it on the\n"
                         "machine it was recorded on.\n"
                       : "The emulation root's system DLLs are not the ones it ran with, so a replay\n"
                         "stops early, whatever the hives.\n");
        }
        if ( known && env.registry_carried )
            s.append("It carries what it read of its registry hives, so a replay needs no hive\n"
                     "files. This one reads further than the recording did, so it needs the very\n"
                     "hive files Sogen was given when it recorded.\n");
        else
            s.append("A replay needs the very hive files Sogen was given when it recorded\n"
                     "(SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, SAM, SECURITY, HARDWARE, NTUSER.DAT). A new copy of the\n"
                     "same machine's registry is not the same: the registry changes all the time.\n");
        if ( known && !env.host )
            s.append("A replay in an emulation root loads the root's registry folder, so choose\n"
                     "the root itself where it is elsewhere on this machine.\n");
        else
            s.append("Keep them in a registry folder beside the recording to have them found.\n");
        s.append("\nLooked in:");
        for ( const qstring &dir : registry_candidates(mgr) )
        {
            const char *what = "no hives";
            switch ( b->check_registry(dir.c_str(), nullptr) )
            {
                case HiveCheck::Match:      what = "the recording's hives"; break;
                case HiveCheck::Unverified: what = "hives (the recording does not say which it used)"; break;
                case HiveCheck::Mismatch:   what = "other hives than the recording's"; break;
                case HiveCheck::Missing:    break;
            }
            s.cat_sprnt("\n  %s: %s", dir.c_str(), what);
        }
        return s;
    }

    // The sogen_emulation_root setting, for a recording made in an emulation
    // root that is not on this machine (moved, or recorded elsewhere); empty
    // otherwise, so the backend uses the root the recording names.
    static qstring default_emulation_root(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        const qstring &root = settings().sogen_emulation_root;
        ReplayEnv env;
        if ( root.empty() || mgr == nullptr || mgr->backend() == nullptr
          || !mgr->backend()->replay_env(&env) || env.host
          || (!env.emulation_root.empty() && qisdir(env.emulation_root.c_str())) )
            return qstring();
        return root;
    }

    ReplaySettings initial_replay_settings(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        ReplaySettings rs;
        rs.registry_dir = find_registry_dir(mgr);
        rs.emulation_root = chosen_emulation_root(mgr);
        rs.allow_host   = mgr != nullptr && !g_hostConsent.empty() && g_hostConsent == mgr->trace_path();
        rs.rec          = recording_options();
        if ( rs.emulation_root.empty() )
            rs.emulation_root = default_emulation_root(mgr);
        return rs;
    }

    bool ask_replay_needs(TraceManager *mgr, ReplaySettings *rs)
    {
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr != nullptr ? mgr->backend() : nullptr;
        if ( b == nullptr )
            return false;
        switch ( b->last_replay_block() )
        {
            case ReplayBlock::HostConsent:
                if ( rs->allow_host )
                    return false;
                if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO,
                            "HIDECANCEL\n"
                            "This recording was made against this machine's own files, not an\n"
                            "emulation root.\n\n"
                            "Replaying it runs the program again, and its file operations\n"
                            "happen again on this machine: whatever it created, renamed or\n"
                            "deleted, it does again. (The network stays offline, unless a fork\n"
                            "is given network access, and then only from its position on.)\n\n"
                            "Replay it anyway? Only for programs you trust.") != ASKBTN_YES )
                    return false;
                g_hostConsent   = mgr->trace_path();
                rs->allow_host  = true;
                return true;

            case ReplayBlock::Registry:
            case ReplayBlock::RegistryMismatch:
            {
                // A replay in an emulation root loads only <root>\registry,
                // so there the question is where the root is.
                ReplayEnv env;
                const bool in_root = b->replay_env(&env) && !env.host;
                static const char form[] =
                    "Registry hives\n"
                    "\n"
                    "\n"
                    "%q\n"
                    "\n"
                    "%q\n"
                    "\n"
                    "<~F~older:F::64::>\n"
                    "<~R~eplay with these hives even if they are not the recording's:C>>\n"
                    "\n";
                static const char root_form[] =
                    "Emulation root\n"
                    "\n"
                    "\n"
                    "%q\n"
                    "\n"
                    "%q\n"
                    "\n"
                    "<~E~mulation root:F::64::>\n"
                    "<~R~eplay with its hives even if they are not the recording's:C>>\n"
                    "\n";
                qstring why = form_text(b->last_error());
                qstring about = form_text(replay_needs_text(mgr));
                char dir[QMAXPATH];
                qstrncpy(dir, in_root ? (rs->emulation_root.empty() ? env.emulation_root.c_str()
                                                                     : rs->emulation_root.c_str())
                                      : rs->registry_dir.c_str(), sizeof(dir));
                ushort anyway = 0;
                if ( ask_form(in_root ? root_form : form, &why, &about, dir, &anyway) <= 0
                  || dir[0] == '\0' )
                    return false;
                if ( in_root )
                {
                    choose_emulation_root(mgr, dir);
                    rs->emulation_root = dir;
                }
                else
                {
                    save_registry_dir(dir);
                    rs->registry_dir = dir;
                }
                rs->any_registry = anyway != 0;
                return true;
            }

            case ReplayBlock::None:
                break;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ Fork here

    int idaapi ForkHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        TraceManager *m = mgr();
        if ( !backend_forks(m) )
        {
            warning("This recording cannot be forked. Sogen recordings can: the program "
                    "is replayed to the position and runs on in Sogen's emulator.");
            return 1;
        }
        const TraceManager::ForkDraft &d = m->fork_draft();
        if ( d.active && d.at == m->current_position() )
        {
            info("This position is already the fork. Change registers and memory here, "
                 "then use TTD > Record fork.");
            return 1;
        }
        if ( d.active && has_changes(d)
          && ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO, "HIDECANCEL\nThere is a fork at %s with changes.\n\n"
                               "Drop it and fork here instead?",
                    format_position(d.at).c_str()) != ASKBTN_YES )
            return 1;

        bool shown = m->at_fork_draft() && has_changes(d);
        m->begin_fork_draft();
        fork_draft_changed(ctx, shown);
        msg("[ida-ttd] Forking at %s. Change registers (the registers window) and memory "
            "(the hex view, or Edit > Patch program) as on a live target, then TTD > "
            "Record fork. The changes stay with this position while you move around.\n",
            format_position(m->fork_draft().at).c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi ForkHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_forks(mgr()) ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- Record fork

    // "2 registers and 3 bytes at 1 address changed", for the dialog.
    static qstring describe_changes(const ForkRequest &req)
    {
        size_t bytes = 0;
        for ( const auto &m : req.memory )
            bytes += m.second.size();
        if ( req.regs.empty() && bytes == 0 )
            return qstring("No changes: the program runs on as recorded.");
        qstring s;
        if ( !req.regs.empty() )
            s.sprnt("%u register%s", (uint)req.regs.size(), req.regs.size() == 1 ? "" : "s");
        if ( bytes != 0 )
            s.cat_sprnt("%s%u byte%s at %u address%s", s.empty() ? "" : " and ", (uint)bytes,
                        bytes == 1 ? "" : "s", (uint)req.memory.size(), req.memory.size() == 1 ? "" : "es");
        s.append(" changed.");
        return s;
    }

    int idaapi ForkRecordHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        TraceManager *m = mgr();
        if ( !backend_forks(m) || !m->fork_draft().active )
        {
            warning("There is no fork. Use TTD > Fork here first.");
            return 1;
        }
        ForkRequest req;
        m->fill_fork_request(&req);

        static const char form[] =
            "Record Fork\n"
            "\n"
            "\n"
            "%q\n"
            "\n"
            "<#The new recording. This one is not touched#~N~ew trace        :f:1:64::>\n"
            "<#0 records until the program exits#~I~nstruction limit:D::18::>\n"
            "\n"
            "<#The replay up to the fork stays offline either way#Ne~t~work access after the fork:C>\n"
            "<#The recording window shows it either way#Sogen's ~l~og to the Output window:C>>\n"
            "\n";
        // One text field for the whole line: IDA puts a space after each
        // %q field, which showed as "Fork at 54:55 . No changes".
        qstring where = form_text(qstring("Fork at ") + format_position(req.at) + ". " + describe_changes(req));
        char path[QMAXPATH];
        qstrncpy(path, default_fork_path(m, req.at).c_str(), sizeof(path));
        // The fork_instructions setting at first, then the last answer this
        // session.
        static sval_t count = (sval_t)qmin(settings().fork_instructions, (uint64)INT64_MAX);
        // The sogen_network setting each time: network access is not
        // something to carry over unnoticed from an earlier fork.
        // The log starts from the sogen_log setting.
        ushort checks = (settings().sogen_network ? 1 : 0) | (settings().sogen_log ? 2 : 0);
        for ( ;; )
        {
            if ( ask_form(form, &where, path, &count, &checks) <= 0 )
                return 1;
            if ( path[0] == '\0' )
            {
                warning("Name the file the new trace goes into.");
                continue;
            }
            if ( qfileexist(path)
              && ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO, "HIDECANCEL\n%s already exists. Replace it?", path) != ASKBTN_YES )
                continue;
            break;
        }

        req.path             = path;
        req.max_instructions = count > 0 ? (uint64_t)count : 0;
        req.note.sprnt("forked at %s", format_position(req.at).c_str());
        req.note.cat_sprnt("; %s", describe_fork_changes(req).c_str());

        ReplaySettings rs = initial_replay_settings(m);
        rs.rec.network = (checks & 1) != 0;
        rs.rec.log     = (checks & 2) != 0;
        ForkResult r;
        for ( ;; )
        {
            req.registry_dir = rs.registry_dir;
            req.allow_host   = rs.allow_host;
            req.any_registry = rs.any_registry;
            req.emulation_root = rs.emulation_root;
            req.rec          = rs.rec;
            r = run_fork(m, req);
            if ( r.ok || r.cancelled || !ask_replay_needs(m, &rs) )
                break;
        }
        if ( !r.ok )
        {
            if ( r.cancelled )
                msg("[ida-ttd] fork cancelled.\n");
            else if ( m->backend() == nullptr || m->backend()->last_replay_block() == ReplayBlock::None )
                warning("The fork failed: %s", r.error.c_str());
            else
                msg("[ida-ttd] fork not recorded: %s.\n", r.error.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        refresh_fork_manager();
        msg("[ida-ttd] forked at %s: %llu instruction(s) recorded into %s%s.\n",
            format_position(req.at).c_str(), (unsigned long long)r.instructions, path,
            r.cancelled ? " (stopped early; what ran is a complete trace)" : "");
        if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_YES, "HIDECANCEL\nRecorded %llu instruction(s) into\n%s\n\n"
                                "Open it in a new IDA window?",
                    (unsigned long long)r.instructions, path) == ASKBTN_YES
          && !open_in_new_ida(path) )
            warning("Could not start another IDA. Open %s from IDA's File menu.", path);
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi ForkRecordHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_forks(mgr()) && mgr()->fork_draft().active ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------- Record a program with Sogen

    static bool has_hives(const qstring &dir)
    {
        qstring system = dir;
        system.append("\\SYSTEM");
        return !dir.empty() && qfileexist(system.c_str());
    }

    // Why 'root' cannot be an emulation root, or empty when it can: it must
    // hold filesys\ and registry\ (with hives). Picking one of those two
    // instead of the root is the likely mistake, so the parent is suggested.
    static qstring emulation_root_problem(const char *root)
    {
        qstring dir = root;
        while ( !dir.empty() && (dir.last() == '\\' || dir.last() == '/') )
            dir.remove_last();
        qstring fs = dir + "\\filesys";
        if ( !qisdir(fs.c_str()) )
        {
            qstring s;
            s.sprnt("%s is not an emulation root. An emulation root is the folder that holds "
                    "filesys (the program's drives) and registry (its hives).", dir.c_str());
            ssize_t slash = dir.rfind('\\');
            if ( slash > 0 )
            {
                qstring parent = dir.substr(0, slash);
                if ( qisdir((parent + "\\filesys").c_str()) )
                    s.cat_sprnt("\n\nDid you mean %s?", parent.c_str());
            }
            return s;
        }
        if ( !has_hives(dir + "\\registry") )
        {
            qstring s;
            s.sprnt("The emulation root %s has no registry hives in its registry folder "
                    "(SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, NTUSER.DAT, ...), which Sogen needs to run the program.", dir.c_str());
            return s;
        }
        return qstring();
    }

    // The executable this database was made from, if it is one (a
    // recording's database has the recording as its input file).
    static qstring database_program()
    {
        char path[QMAXPATH] = {};
        if ( get_input_file_path(path, sizeof(path)) <= 0 )
            return qstring();
        const char *ext = get_file_ext(path);
        if ( ext == nullptr || (stricmp(ext, "exe") != 0 && stricmp(ext, "dll") != 0) || !qfileexist(path) )
            return qstring();
        return qstring(path);
    }

    // The default output file: beside the program, named after it and the
    // time the dialog opened (name-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.sogttd), so recording the
    // same program again makes a new file instead of replacing the last one,
    // perhaps the recording open in this window.
    static void timestamped_output(char *out, size_t size, const char *program)
    {
        qstring base = program;
        const char *ext = get_file_ext(program);
        if ( ext != nullptr )
            base.resize(base.length() - strlen(ext) - 1);
        const time_t now = time(nullptr);
        struct tm local{};
        char stamp[32] = {};
        if ( localtime_s(&local, &now) == 0 )
            strftime(stamp, sizeof(stamp), "-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S", &local);
        qsnprintf(out, size, "%s%s.sogttd", base.c_str(), stamp);
    }

    // "1 h 02 min", "3 min 05 s", "12.3 s": how long a recording took.
    static qstring duration_text(uint64 ms)
    {
        const uint64 s = ms / 1000;
        qstring t;
        if ( s >= 3600 )
            t.sprnt("%llu h %02llu min", (unsigned long long)(s / 3600), (unsigned long long)(s / 60 % 60));
        else if ( s >= 60 )
            t.sprnt("%llu min %02llu s", (unsigned long long)(s / 60), (unsigned long long)(s % 60));
        else
            t.sprnt("%.1f s", ms / 1000.0);
        return t;
    }

    // Whether IDA itself runs elevated. Sogen's "elevated" only changes the
    // token the program sees; what it does to this machine's files is done
    // with IDA's rights.
    static bool ida_is_elevated()
    {
        HANDLE tok = nullptr;
        if ( !OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &tok) )
            return false;
        TOKEN_ELEVATION el{};
        DWORD n = 0;
        const bool ok = GetTokenInformation(tok, TokenElevation, &el, sizeof(el), &n) != 0;
        CloseHandle(tok);
        return ok && el.TokenIsElevated != 0;
    }

    // The base name of a path, without case, for comparing programs.
    static qstring base_name_lower(const char *path)
    {
        const char *slash = strrchr(path, '\\');
        const char *fwd = strrchr(path, '/');
        if ( fwd != nullptr && (slash == nullptr || fwd > slash) )
            slash = fwd;
        qstring s = slash != nullptr ? slash + 1 : path;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++ )
            s[i] = (char)qtolower(s[i]);
        return s;
    }

    // Whether this database is of the program just recorded, so the new
    // recording can be replayed here: its input file is that executable, or
    // it was made from a recording of it.
    static bool database_is_of(const char *program)
    {
        const qstring want = base_name_lower(program);
        TraceLink link;
        if ( trace_link_read(&link) && !link.module_name.empty() )
            return base_name_lower(link.module_name.c_str()) == want;
        char path[QMAXPATH] = {};
        return get_input_file_path(path, sizeof(path)) > 0 && base_name_lower(path) == want;
    }

    // The Record a program dialog's fields, as ask_form fills them.
    struct RecordProgramForm
    {
        char    program[QMAXPATH] = {};
        qstring args;
        char    cwd[QMAXPATH]     = {};
        char    out[QMAXPATH]     = {};
        sval_t  count             = 0;      // instruction limit; 0: until the program exits
        char    root[QMAXPATH]    = {};     // emulation root; empty: this machine's files
        qstring place;                      // guest folder a program outside the root is copied to
        char    hives[QMAXPATH]   = {};     // without a root
        ushort  checks            = 0;      // 1 network, 2 administrator, 4 current date, 8 log
        qstring run_program;                // the program as recorded: a copy in the root, or itself
    };

    // The last answers this session. The program starts as the database's
    // own executable, the hives as the first folder that has some, and the
    // copy goes to a folder of its own, so none of the root's files is
    // replaced unasked.
    static struct
    {
        qstring program, args, cwd, root, hives, place = "C:\\ida-ttd";
        sval_t  count = 0;
        bool    asked = false;  // root holds an answer (perhaps "none")
    } g_recordAnswers;

    // Why the dialog's answers cannot be recorded, or empty when they can.
    // Only checks: the questions (replace the output file, replace a copy
    // in the root) and the copy itself come after, in ask_record_program.
    static qstring record_form_problem(const RecordProgramForm &f, const TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        if ( f.program[0] == '\0' || !qfileexist(f.program) )
            return "Choose the program to record.";
        if ( f.out[0] == '\0' )
            return "Choose the output file.";
        // The replay reads it as it goes: writing over it would change the
        // recording under the session. (The backend refuses any file that is
        // open, in another IDA too; this says it before asking anything else.)
        if ( mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && stricmp(mgr->trace_path().c_str(), f.out) == 0 )
            return "That recording is open in this window. Choose another output file.";
        if ( f.root[0] != '\0' )
        {
            const qstring problem = emulation_root_problem(f.root);
            if ( !problem.empty() )
                return problem;
            if ( !visible_in_emulation_root(f.root, f.program) && f.place.empty() )
                return "The program is outside the emulation root. Name a folder to copy it to.";
            if ( f.cwd[0] != '\0' && !visible_in_emulation_root(f.root, f.cwd) )
                return "The working folder must be inside the emulation root.";
        }
        else if ( !has_hives(f.hives) )
        {
            return "Choose a folder of registry hives (SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, NTUSER.DAT, ...).";
        }
        return qstring();
    }

    // Copy a program from outside the emulation root into it, asking before
    // replacing a different copy. False, having said why, to ask again.
    static bool place_program(RecordProgramForm *f)
    {
        f->run_program = f->program;
        if ( f->root[0] == '\0' || visible_in_emulation_root(f->root, f->program) )
            return true;
        qstring placed, err;
        PlaceResult pr = place_in_emulation_root(f->root, f->program, f->place.c_str(), false, &placed, &err);
        if ( pr == PlaceResult::Differs )
        {
            if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO, "HIDECANCEL\nThe emulation root already has a different\n%s\n\n"
                                   "Replace it?", placed.c_str()) != ASKBTN_YES )
                return false;
            pr = place_in_emulation_root(f->root, f->program, f->place.c_str(), true, &placed, &err);
        }
        if ( pr == PlaceResult::Failed )
        {
            warning("Could not copy the program into the emulation root: %s", err.c_str());
            return false;
        }
        if ( pr == PlaceResult::Placed )
            msg("[ida-ttd] copied %s into the emulation root: %s\n", f->program, placed.c_str());
        f->run_program = placed;
        return true;
    }

    // Ask until the answers hold (or Cancel: false), copy the program into
    // the emulation root if it must be, and remember the answers for the
    // next time.
    static bool ask_record_program(RecordProgramForm *f, const TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        // Short labels, the details in the tooltips. IDA places a field
        // right after its label's characters, so the labels are padded with
        // spaces to one length (17, the longest) to line the fields up.
        static const char form[] =
            "Record a program with Sogen\n"
            "\n"
            "<#The program to run from its start#~P~rogram          :f:0:60::>\n"
            "<#Passed to the program as typed#~A~rguments        :q::60::>\n"
            "<#Empty for the program's own folder#~W~orking folder   :F::60::>\n"
            "<#The new Sogen recording#~O~utput file      :f:1:60::>\n"
            "<#0 records until the program exits#~I~nstruction limit:D::16::>\n"
            "\n"
            "<#The folder holding filesys and registry. Empty runs the program against this machine's own files#~E~mulation root   :F::60::>\n"
            "<#The guest folder a program from outside the root is copied to#~C~opy into root at:q::60::>\n"
            "<#The hives to run against when there is no emulation root#~R~egistry hives   :F::60::>\n"
            "\n"
            "<#Let the program reach the real network#~N~etwork access:C>\n"
            "<#The program's token says administrator (high integrity). Its file and registry operations still have only IDA's own rights#Run as a~d~ministrator:C>\n"
            "<#The program sees the date and time recording starts. Off, it starts on 1 January 1970. Replays see the same dates either way#S~t~art at the current date:C>\n"
            "<#The recording window shows it either way#Sogen's ~l~og to the Output window:C>>\n"
            "\n";
        auto &last = g_recordAnswers;
        if ( !last.asked )
            last.root = settings().sogen_emulation_root;
        if ( last.program.empty() )
            last.program = database_program();
        if ( last.hives.empty() )
            for ( const qstring &dir : registry_candidates(nullptr) )
                if ( has_hives(dir) )
                {
                    last.hives = dir;
                    break;
                }
        qstrncpy(f->program, last.program.c_str(), sizeof(f->program));
        qstrncpy(f->cwd, last.cwd.c_str(), sizeof(f->cwd));
        qstrncpy(f->root, last.root.c_str(), sizeof(f->root));
        qstrncpy(f->hives, last.hives.c_str(), sizeof(f->hives));
        f->out[0] = '\0';
        if ( f->program[0] != '\0' )
            timestamped_output(f->out, sizeof(f->out), f->program);
        f->args  = last.args;
        f->place = last.place;
        f->count = last.count;
        const RecordOptions defaults = recording_options();
        f->checks = (defaults.network ? 1 : 0) | (defaults.elevated ? 2 : 0)
                  | (settings().sogen_start_now ? 4 : 0) | (defaults.log ? 8 : 0);
        for ( ;; )
        {
            if ( ask_form(form, f->program, &f->args, f->cwd, f->out, &f->count, f->root, &f->place,
                          f->hives, &f->checks) <= 0 )
                return false;
            f->place.trim2();
            const qstring problem = record_form_problem(*f, mgr);
            if ( !problem.empty() )
            {
                warning("%s", problem.c_str());
                continue;
            }
            if ( qfileexist(f->out)
              && ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO, "HIDECANCEL\n%s already exists. Replace it?", f->out) != ASKBTN_YES )
                continue;
            // Last, once everything else holds: the copy into the root.
            if ( !place_program(f) )
                continue;
            break;
        }
        last.program = f->program;
        last.args    = f->args;
        last.cwd     = f->cwd;
        last.root    = f->root;
        last.hives   = f->hives;
        last.place   = f->place;
        last.count   = f->count;
        last.asked   = true;
        if ( f->root[0] == '\0' )
            save_registry_dir(f->hives);
        return true;
    }

    // Record what the dialog asked for, say how it went, and offer to open
    // the recording: here (replacing this window's replay) when the database
    // is of the same program, else in a new IDA.
    static void run_program_recording(const ActionContext *ctx, const RecordProgramForm &f)
    {
        RecordRequest req;
        req.application      = f.run_program;
        req.arguments        = f.args;
        req.working_dir      = f.cwd;
        req.path             = f.out;
        req.max_instructions = f.count > 0 ? (uint64_t)f.count : 0;
        req.emulation_root   = f.root;
        req.registry_dir     = f.root[0] == '\0' ? qstring(f.hives) : qstring();
        req.rec              = recording_options();
        req.rec.network      = (f.checks & 1) != 0;
        req.rec.elevated     = (f.checks & 2) != 0;
        req.rec.log          = (f.checks & 8) != 0;
        // Each time: consent for one program is not consent for the next.
        if ( f.root[0] == '\0' )
        {
            if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO,
                        "HIDECANCEL\n"
                        "Without an emulation root the program runs against this machine's\n"
                        "own files: whatever it creates, changes or deletes happens for real%s.\n\n"
                        "Record it? Only for programs you trust.",
                        req.rec.network ? ", and it reaches the network" : "") != ASKBTN_YES )
                return;
            req.allow_host = true;
        }

        if ( req.rec.elevated && !ida_is_elevated() )
            msg("[ida-ttd] the program's token says administrator, but IDA is not running elevated: "
                "operations needing real administrator rights on this machine's files still fail.\n");

        // Taken now, after the questions, so it is when the program starts.
        if ( (f.checks & 4) != 0 )
            req.start_time = (int64_t)time(nullptr);
        const uint64 started = GetTickCount64();
        ForkResult r = run_record(req);
        const qstring took = duration_text(GetTickCount64() - started);
        if ( !r.ok )
        {
            if ( r.cancelled )
                msg("[ida-ttd] recording cancelled after %s.\n", took.c_str());
            else
                warning("The program was not recorded: %s", r.error.c_str());
            return;
        }
        msg("[ida-ttd] recorded %s: %llu instruction(s) in %s into %s%s.\n", f.run_program.c_str(),
            (unsigned long long)r.instructions, took.c_str(), f.out,
            r.cancelled ? " (stopped early; what ran is a complete recording)" : "");

        // Replaying it here suits only a database of the same program: this
        // window's analysis then goes on over the new recording.
        const bool here_ok = ctx != nullptr && ctx->switch_trace && database_is_of(f.program);
        bool here = false, elsewhere = false;
        if ( here_ok )
        {
            const int choice = ask_buttons("~T~his window", "~N~ew window", "~D~on't open", ASKBTN_YES,
                                           "Recorded %llu instruction(s) in %s into\n%s\n\nOpen it?",
                                           (unsigned long long)r.instructions, took.c_str(), f.out);
            here = choice == ASKBTN_YES;
            elsewhere = choice == ASKBTN_NO;
        }
        else
        {
            elsewhere = ask_yn(ASKBTN_YES, "HIDECANCEL\nRecorded %llu instruction(s) in %s into\n%s\n\n"
                                           "Open it in a new IDA window?",
                               (unsigned long long)r.instructions, took.c_str(), f.out) == ASKBTN_YES;
        }
        // Here: the replay switches to it in this database, as the Fork
        // manager's switch does (any running session ends first).
        if ( here )
            ctx->switch_trace(qstring(f.out));
        else if ( elsewhere && !open_in_new_ida(f.out) )
            warning("Could not start another IDA. Open %s from IDA's File menu.", f.out);
    }

    int idaapi RecordProgramHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( find_recorder() == nullptr )
        {
            warning("No installed backend can record programs (the Sogen backend can).");
            return 1;
        }
        RecordProgramForm f;
        if ( ask_record_program(&f, ctx != nullptr ? ctx->mgr : nullptr) )
            run_program_recording(ctx, f);
        return 1;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- Discard fork

    int idaapi ForkDiscardHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        TraceManager *m = mgr();
        if ( m == nullptr || !m->fork_draft().active )
            return 1;
        bool shown = m->at_fork_draft() && has_changes(m->fork_draft());
        m->discard_fork_draft();
        fork_draft_changed(ctx, shown);
        msg("[ida-ttd] fork discarded.\n");
        return 1;
    }

    void fork_draft_changed(const ActionContext *c, bool views_showed_changes)
    {
        if ( c != nullptr && c->refresh_position )
            c->refresh_position();
        // Its recording's node says where the fork is, and offers recording it.
        refresh_fork_manager();
        // The views showed the fork's changes: have IDA reread the recording.
        if ( views_showed_changes )
        {
            invalidate_dbg_state(DBGINV_REGS);
            invalidate_dbgmem_contents(BADADDR, 0);
            refresh_idaview_anyway();
        }
    }

    action_state_t idaapi ForkDiscardHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return mgr() != nullptr && mgr()->fork_draft().active ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }
}

```

`src/ui/ui_forkmgr.cpp`:

```cpp
// The Fork manager: the database's recording and every fork recorded from it
// (and from its forks), as a graph. A node is a recording; double-clicking one
// switches this IDA to it or opens it in another.
//
// Drawn by the plugin's graph window (graph_view.h) where IDAPython with
// PySide6 is available, else by IDA's graph viewer, which most of this file
// handles. Users without IDAPython, or whose PySide window failed to open,
// get the viewer, so both stay; both take a node's text from describe().
//
// IDA 9.4 bug, worked around in guard_graph(): after a step or register
// change, IDA updates the current instruction in every graph view as if it
// were a disassembly graph, calling virtual slots 35 and 39 ("node at this
// address", "line in it"). A plugin graph (IDA's user_graph_t, the SDK's
// interactive_graph_t) has 33 slots, so the calls ran into another class's
// table and crashed IDA. Not yet checked whether IDA 9.5 still does this; the
// guard is harmless if it does not.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "analysis/fork.h"
#include "analysis/fork_registry.h"
#include "common/trace_link.h"
#include "ui/clipboard.h"
#include "ui/graph_view.h"

#include <graph.hpp>

namespace idattd
{
    static const char FM_TITLE[] = "TTD forks";
    static const char FM_KIND[]  = "forks";
    static const char FM_NODE[]  = "$ ida-ttd fork graph";

    namespace
    {
        struct Node
        {
            qstring path;
            qstring text;               // IDA's graph viewer: viewer_text()
            qstring hint;               // both renderers' tooltip
            int     record  = -1;       // index into records; -1 for a recording not forked here
            bool    current = false;    // the one being replayed
            bool    missing = false;    // its file is gone
        };

        struct ForkGraph
        {
            const ActionContext     *ctx  = nullptr;
            graph_viewer_t          *gv   = nullptr;
            std::vector<ForkRecord>  records;
            std::vector<Node>        nodes;
            std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> edges;

            int find(const qstring &path) const
            {
                for ( size_t i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++ )
                    if ( same_trace_path(nodes[i].path, path) )
                        return (int)i;
                return -1;
            }

            int add(const qstring &path)
            {
                int n = find(path);
                if ( n >= 0 )
                    return n;
                Node node;
                node.path = path;
                nodes.push_back(node);
                return (int)nodes.size() - 1;
            }

            void rebuild();
        };

        ForkGraph g_fm;
    }

    static qstring viewer_text(const ForkGraph &fg, const Node &n);

    void ForkGraph::rebuild()
    {
        records = load_fork_records(nullptr);
        nodes.clear();
        edges.clear();

        // The database's own recording first, so it is the root even with
        // no forks yet.
        TraceLink link;
        if ( trace_link_read(&link) && !link.trace_path.empty() )
            add(link.trace_path);
        TraceManager *mgr = ctx != nullptr ? ctx->mgr : nullptr;
        if ( mgr != nullptr && !mgr->trace_path().empty() )
            add(mgr->trace_path());
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < records.size(); i++ )
        {
            int parent = add(records[i].parent);
            int child  = add(records[i].path);
            if ( parent == child )
                continue;
            nodes[child].record = (int)i;
            edges.emplace_back(parent, child);
        }

        for ( Node &n : nodes )
        {
            n.current = mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && same_trace_path(n.path, mgr->trace_path());
            n.missing = !qfileexist(n.path.c_str());
        }
        for ( Node &n : nodes )
        {
            n.hint = n.path;
            if ( n.record >= 0 )
            {
                const ForkRecord &r = records[n.record];
                char when[64] = {};
                qstrftime64(when, sizeof(when), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", (qtime64_t)r.time);
                n.hint.cat_sprnt("\nforked at %s, %s\nchanges: %s", r.at.c_str(), when, r.changes.c_str());
            }
            n.text = viewer_text(*this, n);
        }
    }

    // Forks can be made from the recording being replayed now.
    static bool can_fork_now()
    {
        TraceManager *mgr = g_fm.ctx != nullptr ? g_fm.ctx->mgr : nullptr;
        return mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && mgr->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr->backend()->capabilities().fork;
    }

    // What a node says, for both renderers: its title, the fork's changes
    // (as an instruction), comment lines, its kind, and how it is framed.
    // The menu is the graph window's alone (fork_model).
    static GraphNode describe(const ForkGraph &fg, const Node &n)
    {
        GraphNode g;
        g.title   = qbasename(n.path.c_str());
        g.tooltip = n.hint;
        if ( n.record >= 0 )
        {
            const ForkRecord &r = fg.records[n.record];
            g.code = r.changes;
            g.lines.push_back(qstring().sprnt("%llu instructions", (unsigned long long)r.instructions));
            char when[64] = {};
            qstrftime64(when, sizeof(when), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", (qtime64_t)r.time);
            g.lines.push_back(qstring("recorded ") + when);
            g.badge = "fork";
        }
        else
        {
            g.lines.push_back("the recording this database was made from");
            g.badge = "recording";
        }
        if ( n.current )
        {
            g.badge    = "replaying";
            g.emphasis = true;
            if ( can_fork_now() )
            {
                const TraceManager::ForkDraft &d = g_fm.ctx->mgr->fork_draft();
                if ( d.active )
                    g.lines.push_back(qstring("a fork is being made at ") + format_position(d.at));
            }
        }
        if ( n.missing )
        {
            g.badge  = "missing";
            g.dashed = true;
            g.lines.push_back("the file is not there any more");
        }
        return g;
    }

    // The node's text in IDA's graph viewer, which has one block of text per
    // node and no edge labels: the description's lines, its kind as a
    // comment after the title as the graph window shows it, and the edge's
    // "forked at" as a line of its own.
    static qstring viewer_text(const ForkGraph &fg, const Node &n)
    {
        const GraphNode g = describe(fg, n);
        qstring t = g.title;
        if ( !g.badge.empty() )
            t.cat_sprnt("  ; %s", g.badge.c_str());
        if ( n.record >= 0 )
            t.cat_sprnt("\nforked at %s", fg.records[n.record].at.c_str());
        if ( !g.code.empty() )
            t.cat_sprnt("\n%s", g.code.c_str());
        for ( const qstring &line : g.lines )
            t.cat_sprnt("\n; %s", line.c_str());
        return t;
    }

    //-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // The graph's extra virtual table
    //-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Give the plugin's graph object a copy of its class's virtual table,
    // extended past the class's own slots with harmless functions: "no node"
    // (-1) for slot 39 of IDA's current-instruction update, zero for the
    // rest. Only code that wrongly treats the graph as a disassembly graph
    // calls past the real slots. The copy keeps the RTTI entry in front.
    namespace
    {
        constexpr size_t EXTRA_SLOTS = 64;      // beyond the class's own
        constexpr size_t NODE_AT_LINE_SLOT = 39;  // "-1": no node, skip it

        uint64_t idaapi slot_nothing() { return 0; }
        int64_t  idaapi slot_no_node() { return -1; }

        struct GuardedTable
        {
            void *const      *original = nullptr;
            std::vector<void *> slots;           // [0] = the type information, then the table
        };
        std::vector<GuardedTable *> g_tables;    // never freed: IDA may keep a graph past the plugin

        bool executable(const void *p)
        {
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
            if ( p == nullptr || VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0 || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT )
                return false;
            const DWORD x = PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY;
            return (mbi.Protect & x) != 0;
        }

        bool readable(const void *p, size_t n)
        {
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
            if ( p == nullptr || VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof(mbi)) == 0 || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT
              || (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) != 0 )
                return false;
            return (const char *)p + n <= (const char *)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
        }

        // The class name the compiler recorded for the object's table.
        qstring class_of(void *const *vtbl)
        {
            struct Col { uint32_t sig, off, cdoff, td, cd, self; };
            if ( !readable(vtbl - 1, sizeof(void *)) )
                return qstring();
            const Col *col = (const Col *)vtbl[-1];
            if ( !readable(col, sizeof(Col)) || col->sig != 1 )
                return qstring();
            const char *base = (const char *)col - col->self;
            const char *name = base + col->td + 16;
            if ( !readable(name, 64) )
                return qstring();
            return qstring(name, strnlen(name, 64));
        }
    }

    static void guard_graph(interactive_graph_t *g)
    {
        if ( g == nullptr )
            return;
        void *const **vptr = (void *const **)g;
        void *const *vtbl = *vptr;
        for ( const GuardedTable *t : g_tables )
            if ( vtbl == t->slots.data() + 1 )
                return;                             // already guarded
        // Only IDA's own graph class, whose layout this is about.
        if ( class_of(vtbl) != ".?AVuser_graph_t@@" )
        {
            msg("[ida-ttd] the fork graph is not the kind expected (%s); stepping with it open may crash IDA.\n",
                class_of(vtbl).c_str());
            return;
        }
        GuardedTable *t = nullptr;
        for ( GuardedTable *x : g_tables )
            if ( x->original == vtbl )
                t = x;
        if ( t == nullptr )
        {
            size_t own = 0;
            while ( own < 256 && readable(vtbl + own, sizeof(void *)) && executable(vtbl[own]) )
                own++;
            // 33 in IDA 9.4 and 9.5 (the 9.5 SDK leaves interactive_graph_t's
            // virtual functions as they were); the lookups IDA makes are slots
            // 35 and 39.
            if ( own < 30 || own >= 35 )
            {
                msg("[ida-ttd] the fork graph's class has %d functions, not the 33 expected; "
                    "stepping with it open may crash IDA.\n", (int)own);
                return;
            }
            t = new GuardedTable;
            t->original = vtbl;
            t->slots.push_back(vtbl[-1]);
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < own; i++ )
                t->slots.push_back(vtbl[i]);
            for ( size_t i = own; i < own + EXTRA_SLOTS; i++ )
                t->slots.push_back(i == NODE_AT_LINE_SLOT ? (void *)&slot_no_node : (void *)&slot_nothing);
            g_tables.push_back(t);
            msg("[ida-ttd] fork graph: guarded IDA's current-instruction update (%d functions).\n", (int)own);
        }
        *(void *const **)vptr = t->slots.data() + 1;
    }

    static void act_on(int node)
    {
        if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_fm.nodes.size() )
            return;
        const Node &n = g_fm.nodes[node];
        if ( n.current )
        {
            info("%s is the recording being replayed.", n.path.c_str());
            return;
        }
        if ( n.missing )
        {
            warning("%s is not there any more.", n.path.c_str());
            return;
        }
        qstring path = n.path;
        int answer = ask_buttons("~S~witch here", "Open in a ~n~ew IDA", "Cancel", ASKBTN_YES,
                                 "HIDECANCEL\n%s\n\n"
                                 "Switch this IDA to that recording? The replay stops here and starts\n"
                                 "again on it, in this database. Or open it in a new IDA instead.",
                                 path.c_str());
        if ( answer == ASKBTN_YES )
        {
            if ( g_fm.ctx != nullptr && g_fm.ctx->switch_trace )
                g_fm.ctx->switch_trace(path);
        }
        else if ( answer == ASKBTN_NO )
        {
            if ( !open_in_new_ida(path.c_str()) )
                warning("Could not start another IDA. Open %s from IDA's File menu.", path.c_str());
        }
    }

    static void forget(int node)
    {
        if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_fm.nodes.size() || g_fm.nodes[node].record < 0 )
            return;
        const qstring path = g_fm.nodes[node].path;
        if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_NO, "HIDECANCEL\nRemove the fork %s?\n\nIts file is kept.",
                    qbasename(path.c_str())) != ASKBTN_YES )
            return;
        remove_fork_record(path.c_str());
        refresh_fork_manager();
    }

    //-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // The graph window's model
    //-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // An action run once the graph window's menu handler has returned:
    // Record fork runs a recording for minutes, with its own window, which
    // is better not nested inside the Python call that reported the click.
    static void run_action_later(const char *name)
    {
        struct Later : public exec_request_t
        {
            const char *name;
            explicit Later(const char *n) : name(n) {}
            ssize_t idaapi execute() override
            {
                process_ui_action(name);
                return 0;
            }
        };
        // With MFF_NOWAIT, IDA deletes the request after running it.
        execute_sync(*new Later(name), MFF_WRITE | MFF_NOWAIT);
    }

    static void graph_action(int node, const qstring &action)
    {
        if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_fm.nodes.size() )
            return;
        const qstring path = g_fm.nodes[node].path;
        if ( action == "open" )
        {
            act_on(node);
        }
        else if ( action == "switch" )
        {
            if ( g_fm.ctx != nullptr && g_fm.ctx->switch_trace )
                g_fm.ctx->switch_trace(path);
        }
        else if ( action == "newida" )
        {
            if ( !open_in_new_ida(path.c_str()) )
                warning("Could not start another IDA. Open %s from IDA's File menu.", path.c_str());
        }
        else if ( action == "copypath" )
        {
            copy_to_clipboard(path.c_str());
        }
        else if ( action == "forget" )
        {
            forget(node);
        }
        // Forking, on the recording being replayed: the same commands as
        // TTD > Forks, at the playhead.
        else if ( action == "fork" )
        {
            run_action_later(actions::FORK);
        }
        else if ( action == "forkrecord" )
        {
            run_action_later(actions::FORK_RECORD);
        }
        else if ( action == "forkdiscard" )
        {
            run_action_later(actions::FORK_DISCARD);
        }
    }

    static GraphModel fork_model()
    {
        GraphModel m;
        m.title = FM_TITLE;
        int forks = 0;
        for ( const Node &n : g_fm.nodes )
        {
            GraphNode g = describe(g_fm, n);
            if ( n.record >= 0 )
                forks++;
            if ( n.current && can_fork_now() )
            {
                g.menu.emplace_back("Fork at the current position", "fork");
                if ( g_fm.ctx->mgr->fork_draft().active )
                {
                    g.menu.emplace_back("Record fork...", "forkrecord");
                    g.menu.emplace_back("Discard fork", "forkdiscard");
                }
                g.menu.emplace_back("", "");
            }
            if ( !n.current && !n.missing )
            {
                g.menu.emplace_back("Open...", "open");
                g.menu.emplace_back("Switch this IDA to it", "switch");
                g.menu.emplace_back("Open it in a new IDA", "newida");
                g.menu.emplace_back("", "");
            }
            g.menu.emplace_back("Copy the path", "copypath");
            if ( n.record >= 0 )
                g.menu.emplace_back("Remove fork", "forget");
            m.nodes.push_back(std::move(g));
        }
        for ( const auto &[src, dst] : g_fm.edges )
        {
            GraphEdge e;
            e.src = src;
            e.dst = dst;
            const int rec = g_fm.nodes[dst].record;
            if ( rec >= 0 )
                e.label.sprnt("forked at %s", g_fm.records[rec].at.c_str());
            m.edges.push_back(std::move(e));
        }
        if ( forks == 0 )
            m.status = "No forks yet: right-click the recording being replayed, or use Fork here "
                       "(TTD menu, or right-click in the disassembly), on a Sogen recording.";
        else
            m.status.sprnt("%d fork%s. Double-click a recording to switch to it or open it in a new IDA; "
                           "right-click for more. Ctrl+wheel zooms, F fits.", forks, forks == 1 ? "" : "s");
        m.act = graph_action;
        return m;
    }

    static ssize_t idaapi fm_callback(void *, int code, va_list va)
    {
        switch ( code )
        {
            case grcode_user_refresh:
            {
                interactive_graph_t *g = va_arg(va, interactive_graph_t *);
                guard_graph(g);
                g_fm.rebuild();
                g->clear();
                g->resize((int)g_fm.nodes.size());
                for ( const auto &[src, dst] : g_fm.edges )
                    g->add_edge(src, dst, nullptr);
                return 1;
            }

            // A new graph object (grouping makes one): guard it too.
            case grcode_changed_graph:
                guard_graph(va_arg(va, interactive_graph_t *));
                return 0;

            case grcode_user_text:
            {
                va_arg(va, interactive_graph_t *);
                int          node    = va_arg(va, int);
                const char **text    = va_arg(va, const char **);
                bgcolor_t   *bgcolor = va_arg(va, bgcolor_t *);
                if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_fm.nodes.size() )
                    return 0;
                const Node &n = g_fm.nodes[node];
                *text = n.text.c_str();
                if ( bgcolor != nullptr )
                    *bgcolor = n.current ? 0xC0F0C0 : n.missing ? 0xC0C0C0 : DEFCOLOR;
                return 1;
            }

            case grcode_user_hint:
            {
                va_arg(va, interactive_graph_t *);
                int    node = va_arg(va, int);
                va_arg(va, int);
                va_arg(va, int);
                char **hint = va_arg(va, char **);
                if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_fm.nodes.size() )
                    return 0;
                *hint = qstrdup(g_fm.nodes[node].hint.c_str());
                return 1;
            }

            case grcode_dblclicked:
            {
                va_arg(va, graph_viewer_t *);
                selection_item_t *s = va_arg(va, selection_item_t *);
                if ( s != nullptr && s->is_node )
                    act_on(s->node);
                return 1;
            }

            default:
                break;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // Still open? IDA deletes the widget when the user closes it.
    static bool fm_open()
    {
        if ( g_fm.gv != nullptr && find_widget(FM_TITLE) == (TWidget *)g_fm.gv )
            return true;
        g_fm.gv = nullptr;
        return false;
    }

    // The fork under the graph's selection, for the popup actions.
    static int selected_node(action_ctx_base_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( ctx == nullptr || !fork_manager_widget(ctx->widget) || ctx->graph_selection == nullptr )
            return -1;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < ctx->graph_selection->size(); i++ )
            if ( ctx->graph_selection->at(i).is_node )
                return ctx->graph_selection->at(i).node;
        return -1;
    }

    int idaapi ForkOpenHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        act_on(selected_node(ctx));
        return 1;
    }


    action_state_t idaapi ForkOpenHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( !fork_manager_widget(ctx->widget) )
            return AST_DISABLE_FOR_WIDGET;
        return selected_node(ctx) >= 0 ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }

    int idaapi ForkForgetHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        forget(selected_node(ctx));
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi ForkForgetHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( !fork_manager_widget(ctx->widget) )
            return AST_DISABLE_FOR_WIDGET;
        // The selection is the graph's, which can lag a rebuild of the nodes.
        int node = selected_node(ctx);
        return node >= 0 && node < (int)g_fm.nodes.size() && g_fm.nodes[node].record >= 0
             ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }

    // Redrawn from a timer: callers include IDA's process start and exit
    // notifications, and refreshing a graph viewer inside the exit one
    // stopped IDA with internal error 40183.
    static qtimer_t g_refreshTimer = nullptr;

    static int idaapi refresh_cb(void *)
    {
        g_refreshTimer = nullptr;
        if ( fm_open() )
            refresh_viewer(g_fm.gv);
        if ( graph_is_open(FM_KIND) )
        {
            g_fm.rebuild();
            refresh_graph(FM_KIND, fork_model());
        }
        return -1;                      // once
    }

    void refresh_fork_manager()
    {
        if ( g_refreshTimer == nullptr && (fm_open() || graph_is_open(FM_KIND)) )
            g_refreshTimer = register_timer(50, refresh_cb, nullptr);
    }

    bool fork_manager_widget(TWidget *w)
    {
        return w != nullptr && fm_open() && w == (TWidget *)g_fm.gv;
    }

    bool fork_manager_is_open()
    {
        return fm_open() || graph_is_open(FM_KIND);
    }

    void close_fork_manager_window()
    {
        if ( g_refreshTimer != nullptr )
        {
            unregister_timer(g_refreshTimer);
            g_refreshTimer = nullptr;
        }
        if ( fm_open() )
            close_widget(g_fm.gv, 0);
        g_fm.gv = nullptr;
        close_graph(FM_KIND);
    }

    void close_fork_manager()
    {
        close_fork_manager_window();
        g_fm = ForkGraph();
    }

    int idaapi ForkManagerHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        g_fm.ctx = ctx;
        if ( graph_window_available() && !fm_open() )
        {
            g_fm.rebuild();
            if ( show_graph(FM_KIND, fork_model()) )
                return 1;
        }
        if ( fm_open() )
        {
            refresh_fork_manager();
            activate_widget(g_fm.gv, true);
            return 1;
        }
        netnode id;
        id.create(FM_NODE);
        g_fm.gv = create_graph_viewer(FM_TITLE, id, fm_callback, nullptr, 0);
        if ( g_fm.gv == nullptr )
        {
            warning("Could not open the fork graph.");
            return 1;
        }
        guard_graph(get_viewer_graph(g_fm.gv));
        display_widget(g_fm.gv, WOPN_DP_TAB | WOPN_RESTORE);
        viewer_fit_window(g_fm.gv);
        return 1;
    }
}

```

`src/ui/ui_handles.cpp`:

```cpp
// The handles the program opened and closed: the listing and its action.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"

namespace idattd
{
    static const int   g_hd_widths[] = { 10, 14, 60, 14, 22, 14, 8 };
    static const char *g_hd_header[] = { "Handle", "Type", "Name", "Opened", "By", "Closed", "Thread" };

    HandlesChooser::HandlesChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<HandleRecord> &&rows)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, CH_CAN_EDIT | CH_CAN_REFRESH, qnumber(g_hd_widths), g_hd_widths, g_hd_header,
                         nullptr, std::move(rows))
    {
        size_t open = 0;
        for ( const HandleRecord &h : m_rows )
            open += h.opened.is_valid() && !h.closed.is_valid();
        set_unique_title(qstring().sprnt("TTD handles [%d, %d open at the end]", (int)m_rows.size(), (int)open));
        popup_names[POPUP_EDIT]    = "Travel to where it was closed";
        popup_names[POPUP_REFRESH] = "Rebuild from the recording";
    }

    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi HandlesChooser::refresh(ssize_t n)
    {
        std::vector<HandleRecord> rows;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( m_mgr != nullptr && m_mgr->is_active() && list_handles(m_mgr, &rows, &cancelled) && !cancelled )
            restamp(std::move(rows));
        // The title is not remade: the widget is keyed by it, and
        // make_title_unique would find this chooser's own window and add
        // ' (2)'.
        return cbret_t(n, ALL_CHANGED);
    }

    void idaapi HandlesChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                        chooser_item_attrs_t *attrs, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const HandleRecord &h = *row(n);
        cols->at(0).sprnt("0x%llX", (unsigned long long)h.handle);
        cols->at(1) = h.type;
        cols->at(2) = h.name;
        cols->at(3) = h.opened.is_valid() ? format_position(h.opened) : qstring("before");
        cols->at(4) = h.opened_by;
        cols->at(5) = h.closed.is_valid() ? format_position(h.closed) : qstring("open");
        if ( h.tid != 0 )
            cols->at(6).sprnt("%X", h.tid);
        // Still open when the recording ended: what the program held on to.
        if ( attrs != nullptr && h.opened.is_valid() && !h.closed.is_valid() )
            attrs->flags |= CHITEM_BOLD;
    }

    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi HandlesChooser::edit(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n < m_rows.size() )
        {
            if ( m_rows[n].closed.is_valid() )
                travel_to(m_mgr, m_rows[n].closed, m_made);
            else
                info("This handle was still open when the recording ended.");
        }
        return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
    }

    int idaapi HandlesHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() || mgr()->backend() == nullptr
          || !mgr()->backend()->capabilities().syscalls )
        {
            warning("The handle list needs a recording whose syscalls can be listed.");
            return 1;
        }
        // The list saved the last time, else built now (and saved).
        std::vector<HandleRecord> rows;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( load_handles(&rows) )
            msg("[ida-ttd] handles: the list saved in the database; Refresh (Ctrl+U) in it rebuilds it.\n");
        else if ( !list_handles(mgr(), &rows, &cancelled) )
            return 1;
        msg("[ida-ttd] %d handle(s)%s.\n", (int)rows.size(), cancelled ? " (cancelled)" : "");
        if ( rows.empty() )
        {
            if ( !cancelled )
                info("The recording opened no handles that could be followed.");
            return 1;
        }
        HandlesChooser *ch = new HandlesChooser(mgr(), std::move(rows));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi HandlesHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return mgr() != nullptr && mgr()->is_active() && mgr()->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr()->backend()->capabilities().syscalls ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_heatmap.cpp`:

```cpp
// The memory heatmap: which pages the recording read, wrote and ran from,
// and when. The backend counts (ITraceBackend::query_access_heat); a PySide6
// window draws it (scripts/ida_ttd_heatmap.py), asking for the counts with
// ttd("ui.heat") and travelling with ttd("ui.showbytes POS EA").
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/graph_view.h"
#include "analysis/query_runner.h"
#include <expr.hpp>

namespace idattd
{
    static const uint32_t kHeatPageShift = 12;
    static const uint32_t kHeatSlices    = 256;

    static qstring g_heatJson;
    // Each slice's start and the span's end, to place the current position
    // without asking the backend again.
    static std::vector<Position> g_heatStarts;
    static Position              g_heatEnd = Position::none();

    const qstring &heatmap_json()
    {
        return g_heatJson;
    }

    // {"page_shift":12,"slices":256,"starts":["HI:LO",...],"end":"HI:LO",
    //  "whole":true,"can_zoom":true,
    //  "pages":[{"page":N,"label":"ntdll","cells":[[slice,r,w,x],...]},...]}
    // 'end' is where the last slice ends: the span's last position, or the
    // recording's.
    static qstring heat_json(TraceManager *mgr, const std::vector<HeatCell> &cells, PositionRange when)
    {
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();
        qstring j;
        j.sprnt("{\"page_shift\":%u,\"slices\":%u,\"starts\":[", kHeatPageShift, kHeatSlices);
        g_heatStarts.clear();
        for ( uint32_t s = 0; s < kHeatSlices; s++ )
        {
            if ( s != 0 )
                j.append(',');
            Position p = b->heat_window_slice_position(kHeatSlices, s, when);
            g_heatStarts.push_back(p);
            json_str(&j, p.is_valid() ? format_position(p).c_str() : "");
        }
        Position end = when.last == Position::end() ? b->info().last : when.last;
        g_heatEnd = end;
        j.append("],\"end\":");
        json_str(&j, end.is_valid() ? format_position(end).c_str() : "");
        j.cat_sprnt(",\"whole\":%s,\"can_zoom\":%s",
                    when.whole_trace() ? "true" : "false", b->can_window_heat() ? "true" : "false");
        j.append(",\"pages\":[");
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < cells.size(); )
        {
            const uint64_t page = cells[i].page;
            if ( i != 0 )
                j.append(',');
            const ea_t ea = (ea_t)(page << kHeatPageShift);
            j.cat_sprnt("{\"page\":%llu,\"label\":", (unsigned long long)page);
            json_str(&j, mgr->modules().name_at(ea).c_str());
            j.append(",\"cells\":[");
            bool first = true;
            for ( ; i < cells.size() && cells[i].page == page; i++ )
            {
                const HeatCell &c = cells[i];
                j.cat_sprnt("%s[%u,%u,%u,%u]", first ? "" : ",", c.slice, c.reads, c.writes, c.executes);
                first = false;
            }
            j.append("]}");
        }
        j.append("]}");
        return j;
    }

    static bool open_heatmap_window()
    {
        if ( !graph_window_available() )
            return false;
        qstring err;
        if ( run_python_window("ida_ttd_heatmap", "show()", &err) )
            return true;
        msg("[ida-ttd] the heatmap window could not be opened: %s\n", err.c_str());
        return false;
    }

    // Count, keep the answer for the window, and open it.
    bool build_heatmap(TraceManager *mgr, qstring *err, PositionRange when)
    {
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || mgr->backend() == nullptr )
        {
            *err = "no trace is being replayed";
            return false;
        }
        ITraceBackend *b = mgr->backend();
        if ( !when.whole_trace() && !b->can_window_heat() )
        {
            *err = "this recording's backend can only count the whole recording";
            return false;
        }
        if ( !when.whole_trace() && !(when.first < when.last) )
        {
            *err = "the span is empty: its start must come before its end";
            return false;
        }
        std::vector<HeatCell> cells;
        QueryResult qr = run_query(when.whole_trace() ? "Counting every memory access"
                                                      : "Counting the memory accesses in this span",
                                   [&](ProgressSink *p)
        {
            return b->query_access_heat_window(kHeatPageShift, kHeatSlices, when, &cells, p);
        });
        if ( !qr.ran )
        {
            *err = "this recording's backend cannot count its accesses";
            return false;
        }
        if ( qr.cancelled )
        {
            *err = "cancelled";
            return false;
        }
        g_heatJson = heat_json(mgr, cells, when);
        return true;
    }

    int heatmap_current_slice(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || g_heatStarts.empty() || !g_heatEnd.is_valid() )
            return -1;
        const Position cur = mgr->current_position();
        if ( !cur.is_valid() || !g_heatStarts[0].is_valid() || cur < g_heatStarts[0] || g_heatEnd < cur )
            return -1;
        // The last slice starting at or before the position. Starts are in
        // order; unknown ones (none) are skipped.
        int found = 0;
        for ( size_t s = 1; s < g_heatStarts.size(); s++ )
        {
            if ( !g_heatStarts[s].is_valid() )
                continue;
            if ( cur < g_heatStarts[s] )
                break;
            found = (int)s;
        }
        return found;
    }

    void heatmap_session_ended()
    {
        g_heatJson.clear();
        g_heatStarts.clear();
        g_heatEnd = Position::none();
        // The title scripts/ida_ttd_heatmap.py gives its window.
        TWidget *w = find_widget("TTD memory heatmap");
        if ( w != nullptr )
            close_widget(w, 0);
    }

    int idaapi HeatmapHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("The memory heatmap is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }
        qstring err;
        if ( !build_heatmap(mgr(), &err) )
        {
            if ( err != "cancelled" )
                warning("Could not build the memory heatmap: %s", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
        if ( !open_heatmap_window() )
            warning("The memory heatmap needs IDAPython with PySide6.");
        return 1;
    }
}
```
