`src/ui/ui_memmap.cpp`:

```cpp
// The reconstructed memory map: the change timeline, the map at the playhead,
// and re-reading memory from the recording.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"
#include "plugin/settings.h"

#include <expr.hpp>

namespace idattd
{
    //=======================================================================
    // MemoryTimelineChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_mm_widths[] = { 16, 8, 11, 18, 20, 11, 32, 32, 80 };
    static const char *g_mm_header[] = { "Position", "Thread", "Change",
                                         "Base", "Size", "Protection",
                                         "Requested by", "API", "Call chain" };

    // NtFreeVirtualMemory's "protection" argument is really its free type.
    static const uint32_t MEM_RELEASE_BIT  = 0x8000;
    static const uint32_t MEM_DECOMMIT_BIT = 0x4000;

    MemoryTimelineChooser::MemoryTimelineChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<RegionChange> &&rows)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, 0, qnumber(g_mm_widths), g_mm_widths, g_mm_header, nullptr, std::move(rows))
    {
        set_unique_title(qstring().sprnt("TTD memory timeline [%d]", (int)m_rows.size()));
    }

    void idaapi MemoryTimelineChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                          chooser_item_attrs_t * /*attrs*/, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const RegionChange &c = *row(n);
        cols->at(0) = format_position(c.pos);
        cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%X", c.tid);

        qstring what = change_name(c.kind);
        // A call on another process is left out of this process's map, but
        // that it happened is worth showing.
        if ( c.other_process )
            what.append(" (other process)");
        cols->at(2) = what;

        cols->at(3).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)c.base);
        if ( c.size == 0 )
            cols->at(4) = "whole region";
        else
            cols->at(4).sprnt("0x%llX", c.size);
        // Not exact: the kernel's out-parameters were not in the recording, so
        // the caller's request was rounded out to pages. A floor on the real
        // region, never an overstatement.
        if ( !c.exact )
            cols->at(4).append(" (at least)");

        if ( c.kind == RC_FREE )
            cols->at(5) = (c.protect & MEM_RELEASE_BIT) != 0 ? "release"
                        : (c.protect & MEM_DECOMMIT_BIT) != 0 ? "decommit" : "";
        else if ( c.kind == RC_UNMAPVIEW )
            cols->at(5) = "";
        else
            cols->at(5) = protection_text(c.protect);

        // Who wanted the memory, and the API they called. The instruction that
        // invoked the syscall is nearly always an unnamed helper in the stub's
        // DLL, so it is not a column; double-click travels there, with the
        // whole stack live.
        ea_t origin = chain_origin(m_mgr, c);
        cols->at(6) = origin != BADADDR ? described(origin) : qstring();
        cols->at(7) = c.api != BADADDR ? described(c.api) : qstring();
        // Every recorded frame, innermost first. One call the program makes
        // (loading a DLL, its malloc) can be behind dozens of changes that
        // "Requested by" attributes alike; the library frames inside it, and
        // the program's frames beyond it, are what tell them apart.
        for ( uint8_t k = 0; k < c.chain_n; k++ )
        {
            if ( c.chain[k] == BADADDR )
                continue;
            if ( !cols->at(8).empty() )
                cols->at(8).append(" <- ");
            cols->at(8).append(described(c.chain[k]));
        }
    }

    const qstring &MemoryTimelineChooser::described(ea_t ea) const
    {
        const size_t names = get_nlist_size();
        if ( names != m_namesSeen )
        {
            m_described.clear();
            m_namesSeen = names;
        }
        auto it = m_described.find(ea);
        if ( it == m_described.end() )
            it = m_described.emplace(ea, describe_address(m_mgr, ea)).first;
        return it->second;
    }

    ea_t idaapi MemoryTimelineChooser::get_ea(size_t n) const
    {
        if ( n >= m_rows.size() )
            return BADADDR;
        // Follow what the row names: the code that asked for the memory.
        ea_t origin = chain_origin(m_mgr, m_rows[n]);
        return origin != BADADDR ? origin : m_rows[n].pc;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Re-read memory from the recording
    //=======================================================================
    int idaapi RereadHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("Re-reading memory is only possible while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }

        // A selection in the disassembly, else ask (the menu, nothing selected).
        ea_t lo = BADADDR, hi = BADADDR;
        if ( !read_range_selection(nullptr, &lo, &hi) || lo >= hi )
        {
            ea_t here = get_screen_ea();
            if ( here == BADADDR )
            {
                warning("Put the cursor on an address, or select a range, first.");
                return 1;
            }
            // Default to the enclosing function, else a page, clipped to the
            // cursor's segment.
            lo = here;
            hi = here + 0x1000;
            segment_info_t si;
            if ( get_segment_info(&si, here) )
            {
                func_entry_info_t fi;
                if ( get_func_entry_info(&fi, here) && fi.end_ea > fi.start_ea )
                {
                    lo = fi.start_ea;
                    hi = fi.end_ea;
                }
                if ( hi > si.end_ea )
                    hi = si.end_ea;
            }

            static const char form[] =
                "TTD re-read memory\n"
                "\n"
                "Discard what IDA has cached for this range, rebuild it from the\n"
                "recording, and disassemble it again.\n"
                "\n"
                "  <~S~tart:$::16::>\n"
                "  <~E~nd:$::16::>\n"
                "\n";
            if ( ask_form(form, &lo, &hi) <= 0 )
                return 1;
        }

        if ( lo >= hi )
        {
            warning("The end address must be above the start address.");
            return 1;
        }

        size_t got = mgr()->reread_range(lo, hi);
        msg("[ida-ttd] re-read %a..%a: %d byte(s) recovered from recorded "
            "writes.\n", lo, hi, (int)got);
        refresh_idaview_anyway();
        return 1;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Memory map actions
    //=======================================================================
    // Build the change timeline if this database has none yet, asking first
    // since it replays the whole recording. False when there is none after.
    static bool ensure_timeline(TraceManager *mgr, const char *declined_note)
    {
        MemoryMap &map = mgr->memmap_for_update();
        if ( !map.empty() )
            return true;

        qstring q;
        q.sprnt("Reconstructing the memory map replays the whole recording "
                "once, watching every call that allocates, protects or frees "
                "memory.\n\n"
                "That can take a while on a large trace. It is saved in the "
                "database afterwards, so this is paid once.%s\n\n"
                "Build it now?", declined_note);
        if ( ask_yn(ASKBTN_YES, "%s", q.c_str()) != ASKBTN_YES )
            return false;

        // The session's map, which IDA's segments and the scripts read too;
        // saved and handed to IDA there.
        bool cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !session_memory_map(mgr, false, &cancelled, &err) )
        {
            if ( mgr->is_active() && !err.empty() && err.find("could not be built") != qstring::npos )
                warning("The memory map could not be built for this recording.\n\n"
                        "For a Microsoft TTD trace this happens when ntdll's export "
                        "table was never read during recording; for another kind of "
                        "recording, its backend may not record the memory map. The "
                        "output window has the details.");
            else if ( !err.empty() )
                warning("The memory map was not built: %s.", err.c_str());
            return false;
        }
        if ( mgr->memmap_for_update().empty() )
        {
            info("The recording made no memory allocations, protection changes "
                 "or frees that could be recovered.");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    int idaapi MemoryTimelineHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("The memory timeline is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }
        if ( !ensure_timeline(mgr(), "") )
            return 1;

        const MemoryMap &map = mgr()->memmap();
        std::vector<RegionChange> rows;
        rows.reserve(map.size());
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < map.size(); i++ )
            rows.push_back(map.at(i));

        MemoryTimelineChooser *ch = new MemoryTimelineChooser(mgr(), std::move(rows));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    int idaapi MemoryMapHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("The memory map is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }
        // Without the timeline the map still has modules, stacks and the PEB,
        // just not the program's allocations.
        ensure_timeline(mgr(), "\n\nWithout it, the map shows the modules, "
                               "stacks and the PEB, but nothing the program "
                               "allocated.");
        if ( find_widget(MemoryMapChooser::TITLE) != nullptr )
        {
            MemoryMapChooser::refresh_open();
            activate_widget(find_widget(MemoryMapChooser::TITLE), true);
            return 1;
        }
        MemoryMapChooser *ch = new MemoryMapChooser(mgr());
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // MemoryMapChooser: the map at the playhead
    //=======================================================================
    const char *const MemoryMapChooser::TITLE = "TTD memory map";

    // The SDK cannot say; Qt's palette can (scripts/ida_ttd_qt.py). Asked
    // once: the theme changes only with a restart.
    static bool theme_is_dark()
    {
        static int dark = -1;
        if ( dark < 0 )
        {
            dark = 0;
            extlang_object_t py = find_extlang_by_name("Python");
            idc_value_t rv;
            qstring err;
            if ( py != nullptr && py->eval_snippet != nullptr && py->eval_expr != nullptr
              && py->eval_snippet("import ida_ttd_qt\n", &err)
              && py->eval_expr(&rv, BADADDR, "ida_ttd_qt.theme_is_dark()", &err)
              && rv.vtype == VT_LONG )
            {
                dark = rv.num != 0 ? 1 : 0;
            }
        }
        return dark == 1;
    }

    static const int   g_am_widths[] = { 16, 16, 10, 12, 8, 36, 16 };
    static const char *g_am_header[] = { "Base", "End", "Size", "Protection",
                                         "Type", "Use", "Allocated at" };

    MemoryMapChooser::MemoryMapChooser(TraceManager *mgr)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, CH_CAN_EDIT | CH_CAN_REFRESH, qnumber(g_am_widths), g_am_widths,
                         g_am_header, TITLE)
    {
        popup_names[POPUP_EDIT]    = "Travel to where it was allocated";
        popup_names[POPUP_REFRESH] = "Refresh";
    }

    void MemoryMapChooser::rebuild()
    {
        if ( m_mgr == nullptr || !m_mgr->is_active() )
        {
            m_rows.clear();
            m_at = Position::none();
            return;
        }
        Position now = m_mgr->current_position();
        size_t map_size = m_mgr->memmap().size();
        if ( now.is_valid() && now == m_at && map_size == m_mapSize )
            return;
        // Rebuilt from the session being replayed, a fork's after a switch.
        std::vector<AddressRegion> rows;
        address_space_at(m_mgr, &rows);
        restamp(std::move(rows));
        m_at      = now;
        m_mapSize = map_size;
    }

    void MemoryMapChooser::refresh_open()
    {
        if ( find_widget(TITLE) != nullptr )
            refresh_chooser(TITLE);
    }

    // IDA asks for the count first whenever it redraws, so the rows follow
    // the playhead from here; rebuild() is a cache refresh, hence the cast.
    size_t idaapi MemoryMapChooser::get_count() const
    {
        const_cast<MemoryMapChooser *>(this)->rebuild();
        return m_rows.size();
    }

    void idaapi MemoryMapChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                          chooser_item_attrs_t *attrs, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const AddressRegion &r = *row(n);
        cols->at(0).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)r.base);
        cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)r.end());
        cols->at(2).sprnt("0x%llX", r.size);
        if ( r.reserved )
            cols->at(3) = "reserved";
        else if ( r.protect != 0 )
            cols->at(3) = protection_text(r.protect);
        cols->at(4) = region_type_name(r.type);
        cols->at(5) = r.use;
        if ( r.since.is_valid() )
            cols->at(6) = format_position(r.since);

        // What this view is most often opened to find.
        if ( attrs != nullptr && !r.reserved && r.type != ITTD_REGION_IMAGE )
        {
            uchar perm = protection_perm(r.protect);
            if ( (perm & SEGPERM_EXEC) != 0 && (perm & SEGPERM_WRITE) != 0 )
                attrs->flags |= CHITEM_BOLD;
        }
        if ( attrs != nullptr && settings().memmap_flag_code && is_code_outside_modules(r) )
            attrs->color = theme_is_dark() ? 0x2A2A5C : 0xC8D2FF;   // muted red (0xBBGGRR)
    }

    ea_t idaapi MemoryMapChooser::get_ea(size_t n) const
    {
        return n < m_rows.size() ? m_rows[n].base : BADADDR;
    }

    // The column of the cell double-clicked in the chooser titled 'title', -1
    // when unknown: enter() is told the row only, and Qt knows the rest
    // (scripts/ida_ttd_qt.py).
    static int current_column(const char *title)
    {
        extlang_object_t py = find_extlang_by_name("Python");
        idc_value_t rv;
        qstring err, expr;
        // The titles passed here are the plugin's own, with no quotes in them.
        expr.sprnt("ida_ttd_qt.chooser_current_column('%s')", title);
        if ( py != nullptr && py->eval_snippet != nullptr && py->eval_expr != nullptr
          && py->eval_snippet("import ida_ttd_qt\n", &err)
          && py->eval_expr(&rv, BADADDR, expr.c_str(), &err)
          && rv.vtype == VT_LONG )
        {
            return (int)rv.num;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static const int AM_COL_ALLOCATED = 6;      // "Allocated at"

    // Double-click: on "Allocated at", travel there (as Ctrl+E); anywhere
    // else, go to the region.
    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi MemoryMapChooser::enter(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n >= m_rows.size() )
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        if ( current_column(TITLE) == AM_COL_ALLOCATED )
            return edit(n);
        jumpto(m_rows[n].base);
        return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
    }

    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi MemoryMapChooser::edit(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n >= m_rows.size() )
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        if ( !m_rows[n].since.is_valid() )
        {
            info("The recording does not say where this region was made: the "
                 "kernel made it, or it existed before the recording started.");
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        }
        travel_to(m_mgr, m_rows[n].since, m_made);
        return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
    }

    // Asked for, so rebuilt even at the same position.
    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi MemoryMapChooser::refresh(ssize_t n)
    {
        m_at = Position::none();
        rebuild();
        return cbret_t(n, ALL_CHANGED);
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_memsearch.cpp`:

```cpp
// Memory access search: the address/length/kind prompt and the hit listing.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"

namespace idattd
{
    //=======================================================================
    // MemAccessChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_ma_widths[] = { 16, 8, 8, 18, 6, 28 };
    static const char *g_ma_header[] = { "Position", "Thread", "Access",
                                         "Address", "Size", "Instruction" };

    MemAccessChooser::MemAccessChooser(TraceManager *mgr, ea_t lo, ea_t hi,
                                       std::vector<MemAccess> &&hits)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, CH_CAN_DEL, qnumber(g_ma_widths), g_ma_widths, g_ma_header, nullptr,
                         std::move(hits))
    {
        // A unique title per search, so two searches open as two tabs.
        qstring t;
        if ( hi - lo <= 1 )
            t.sprnt("TTD accesses: 0x%llX [%d]", (uint64_t)lo, (int)m_rows.size());
        else
            t.sprnt("TTD accesses: 0x%llX..0x%llX [%d]",
                    (uint64_t)lo, (uint64_t)hi, (int)m_rows.size());
        set_unique_title(t);
    }

    void idaapi MemAccessChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                          chooser_item_attrs_t * /*attrs*/, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const MemAccess &a = *row(n);
        cols->at(0) = format_position(a.pos);
        cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%X", a.tid);
        cols->at(2) = access_name(a.kind);
        cols->at(3).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)a.addr);
        cols->at(4).sprnt("%u", a.size);
        // Where the access came from, as name+offset when possible.
        cols->at(5) = func_offset_name(a.pc);
    }

    ea_t idaapi MemAccessChooser::get_ea(size_t n) const
    {
        return n < m_rows.size() ? m_rows[n].pc : BADADDR;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Memory access search action
    //=======================================================================
    int idaapi MemSearchHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("Memory searching is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }

        static const char form[] =
            "TTD memory access search\n"
            "\n"
            "\n"
            "Find every time the recording touched this memory.\n"
            "\n"
            "<~A~ddress:$::18::>\n"
            "<~L~ength in bytes:D::18::>\n"
            "<##Access##~R~ead:C>\n"
            "<~W~rite:C>\n"
            "<E~x~ecute:C>>\n"
            "\n";

        // Seeded from the cursor, usually what is meant.
        static sval_t  len  = 1;
        static ushort  bits = ACC_READ | ACC_WRITE;
        ea_t addr = ctx != nullptr && ctx->cur_ea != BADADDR ? ctx->cur_ea : get_screen_ea();
        // A selection (bytes in the hex view, or instructions) is the range
        // to search.
        ea_t sel_lo = BADADDR, sel_hi = BADADDR;
        if ( ctx != nullptr && ctx->has_flag(ACF_HAS_SELECTION)
          && read_range_selection(ctx->widget, &sel_lo, &sel_hi) && sel_lo < sel_hi )
        {
            addr = sel_lo;
            len  = (sval_t)(sel_hi - sel_lo);
        }
        if ( ask_form(form, &addr, &len, &bits) <= 0 )
            return 1;
        if ( len <= 0 )
            len = 1;

        std::vector<MemAccess> hits;
        bool truncated = false, cancelled = false;
        qstring err;
        if ( !search_memory(mgr(), addr, addr + (ea_t)len, (uint8_t)bits,
                            &hits, &truncated, &cancelled, &err) )
        {
            warning("%s", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        msg("[ida-ttd] memory search: %d access(es) to 0x%llX..0x%llX%s%s.\n",
            (int)hits.size(), (uint64_t)addr, (uint64_t)(addr + (ea_t)len),
            truncated ? " (record limit reached, results are partial)" : "",
            cancelled ? " (stopped early)" : "");
        if ( hits.empty() )
        {
            info("Nothing in the recording read, wrote or executed that memory.");
            return 1;
        }

        MemAccessChooser *ch = new MemAccessChooser(mgr(), addr, addr + (ea_t)len,
                                                    std::move(hits));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }
}
```

```cpp
// Moving through the recording: the timeline listing, the movement actions IDA
// has no native equivalent for, and the toolbar position readout.
#include "ui/ui.h"

namespace idattd
{
    //=======================================================================
    // PositionChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_pos_widths[] = { 16, 48 };
    static const char *g_pos_header[] = { "Position", "Event" };

    PositionChooser::PositionChooser(TraceManager *mgr)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, 0, qnumber(g_pos_widths), g_pos_widths, g_pos_header, "TTD Timeline",
                         mgr != nullptr ? mgr->collect_positions() : std::vector<TraceManager::NamedPosition>())

    void idaapi PositionChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                         chooser_item_attrs_t * /*attrs*/, size_t n) const
    {
        const TraceManager::NamedPosition *e = row(n);
        if ( e == nullptr )
            return;
        cols->at(0) = format_position(e->pos);
        cols->at(1) = e->name.c_str();

    void travel_to(TraceManager *mgr, Position p)
    {
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || !p.is_valid() )
            return;
        mgr->set_next_position(p);
        request_continue_process();
        run_requests();
    }

    bool listing_is_current(const RecordingStamp &made)
    {
        if ( made.current() )
            return true;
        warning("This list was made from another recording than the one being replayed "
                "(the session ended, or switched to a fork or back).\n\n"
                "Open it again to list this recording.");
        return false;
    }

    void make_title_unique(qstring *title)
    {
        if ( title == nullptr || find_widget(title->c_str()) == nullptr )
            return;
        for ( int n = 2; n < 1000; n++ )
        {
            qstring t;
            t.sprnt("%s (%d)", title->c_str(), n);
            if ( find_widget(t.c_str()) == nullptr )
            {
                *title = t;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void travel_to(TraceManager *mgr, Position p, const RecordingStamp &made)
    {
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() || !p.is_valid() )
            return;
        if ( listing_is_current(made) )
            travel_to(mgr, p);
    }

    //=======================================================================

    int idaapi InstallRuntimeHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        // Done in Python (HTTP, zip, a license dialog); the module is in
        // ida-ttd-python\, put on sys.path at plugin load.
        extlang_object_t py = find_extlang_by_name("Python");
        if ( py == nullptr || py->eval_snippet == nullptr )
        {
            warning("Installing the TTD runtime needs IDAPython, which is not available.\n\n"
                    "Install WinDbg (aka.ms/windbg/download) and copy its amd64\\ttd folder "
                    "to ida-ttd\\windbg\\amd64\\ttd in your IDA user directory "
                    "(%%APPDATA%%\\Hex-Rays\\IDA Pro) instead.");
            return 1;
        }
        qstring err;
        if ( !py->eval_snippet("import ida_ttd_runtime\n"
                               "ida_ttd_runtime.install_runtime()\n", &err) )
            warning("Installing the TTD runtime failed: %s", err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    int idaapi InstallSogenHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        extlang_object_t py = find_extlang_by_name("Python");

        {
            warning("Installing the Sogen backend needs IDAPython, which is not available.\n\n"
                    "Copy ida-ttd-sogen.dll to ida-ttd\\backends\\ in your IDA user "
                    "directory (%%APPDATA%%\\Hex-Rays\\IDA Pro) instead, and restart IDA.");
            return 1;
        }
        qstring err;
        if ( !py->eval_snippet("import ida_ttd_runtime\n"
                               "ida_ttd_runtime.install_sogen()\n", &err) )
            warning("Installing the Sogen backend failed: %s", err.c_str());
        return 1;

    //=======================================================================
    // Travel, then show memory in the hex view
    //=======================================================================
    // IDA moves its views (a synchronized hex view too) to the instruction
    // pointer on a stop, so the jump waits: show_pending_bytes() runs after
    // IDA's own post-stop handling.
    static ea_t g_pendingBytes = BADADDR;

    static TWidget *open_hex_view()
    {
        for ( int i = 1; i <= 9; i++ )
        {
            qstring title;
            title.sprnt("Hex View-%d", i);
            TWidget *w = find_widget(title.c_str());
            if ( w != nullptr && get_widget_type(w) == BWN_HEXVIEW )
                return w;
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    static void show_bytes(TWidget *hex, ea_t ea)
    {
        activate_widget(hex, true);
        ea_viewer_history_push_and_jump(hex, ea, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    bool travel_and_show_bytes(TraceManager *mgr, Position p, ea_t ea)
    {
        g_pendingBytes = BADADDR;
        if ( mgr == nullptr || !mgr->is_active() )
            return false;
        TWidget *hex = ea != BADADDR ? open_hex_view() : nullptr;
        if ( !p.is_valid() || p == mgr->current_position() )
        {
            if ( hex != nullptr )
                show_bytes(hex, ea);
            return hex != nullptr;
        }
        if ( hex != nullptr )
            g_pendingBytes = ea;
        travel_to(mgr, p);
        return hex != nullptr;
    }

    void show_pending_bytes()
    {
        ea_t ea = g_pendingBytes;
        g_pendingBytes = BADADDR;
        if ( ea == BADADDR )
            return;
        TWidget *hex = open_hex_view();
        if ( hex != nullptr )
            show_bytes(hex, ea);
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_origin.cpp`:

```cpp
// Where a value came from: the graph of every chain back to its sources,
// and the action that asks.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"
#include "ui/clipboard.h"
#include "ui/graph_view.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // A graph's size limit: each value in it is a search of the recording.
    static const size_t kGraphNodes = 60;

    //=======================================================================
    // The action
    //=======================================================================
    // "rax", "xmm2", "0x1234" or "0x1234 8" (an address and a size).
    static bool parse_target(const char *text, OriginTarget *t)
    {
        uint32_t reg = 0;
        if ( parse_register(text, &reg) )
        {
            t->is_reg = true;
            t->reg    = reg;
            return true;
        }
        qstring s(text);
        s.trim2();
        if ( !s.empty() && s[0] == '[' )
            s.remove(0, 1);
        char *end = nullptr;
        uint64_t a = strtoull(s.c_str(), &end, 16);
        if ( end == s.c_str() )
            return false;
        while ( *end == ' ' || *end == ']' || *end == ',' )
            end++;
        uint64_t size = *end != '\0' ? strtoull(end, nullptr, 0) : 8;
        t->is_reg = false;
        t->addr   = (ea_t)a;
        t->size   = (uint32_t)std::min<uint64_t>(std::max<uint64_t>(size, 1), 64);
        return true;
    }

    // What the context names: a register in the registers window or under the
    // cursor, bytes selected in the hex view, data under the cursor.
    static bool target_from_context(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx, OriginTarget *t)
    {
        if ( ctx == nullptr || ctx->widget == nullptr )
            return false;
        const int wt = ctx->widget_type;
        uint32_t reg = 0;
        if ( wt == BWN_CPUREGS && ctx->regname != nullptr && parse_register(ctx->regname, &reg) )
        {
            t->is_reg = true;
            t->reg    = reg;
            return true;
        }
        if ( wt == BWN_HEXVIEW || wt == BWN_DISASM )
        {
            ea_t lo = BADADDR, hi = BADADDR;
            if ( ctx->has_flag(ACF_HAS_SELECTION) && read_range_selection(ctx->widget, &lo, &hi) && lo < hi )
            {
                t->is_reg = false;
                t->addr   = lo;
                t->size   = (uint32_t)std::min<ea_t>(hi - lo, 64);
                return true;
            }
        }
        if ( wt == BWN_DISASM )
        {
            qstring word;
            uint32 flags = 0;
            if ( get_highlight(&word, ctx->widget, &flags) && parse_register(word.c_str(), &reg) )
            {
                t->is_reg = true;
                t->reg    = reg;
                return true;
            }
            const ea_t ea = ctx->cur_ea;
            if ( ea != BADADDR && !is_code(get_flags(ea)) )
            {
                asize_t sz = get_item_size(ea);
                t->is_reg = false;
                t->addr   = get_item_head(ea);
                t->size   = (uint32_t)std::min<asize_t>(std::max<asize_t>(sz, 1), 16);
                return true;
            }
        }
        if ( wt == BWN_HEXVIEW && ctx->cur_ea != BADADDR )
        {
            t->is_reg = false;
            t->addr   = ctx->cur_ea;
            t->size   = 8;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // What to follow: from the context, else asked for. False when the user
    // cancelled or gave an unparsable answer (after a warning).
    static bool pick_target(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx, OriginTarget *out)
    {
        OriginTarget &t = *out;
        if ( !target_from_context(ctx, &t) )
        {
            static qstring last = "rax";
            qstring text = last;
            // Not HIST_IDENT: IDA refuses a register name as an identifier.
            if ( !ask_str(&text, HIST_SRCH,
                          "Where did this value come from? A register (rax, ecx, xmm0, ...), "
                          "or memory as an address and a size (0x1234 8)") )
                return false;
            if ( !parse_target(text.c_str(), &t) )
            {
                warning("'%s' is neither a register nor an address.", text.c_str());
                return false;
            }
            last = text;
        }
        return true;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // The graph
    //=======================================================================
    static const char OG_KIND[]  = "origin";
    static const char OG_TITLE[] = "TTD value origin graph";

    namespace
    {
        TraceManager *g_og_mgr = nullptr;
        OriginGraph   g_og;
    }

    static void og_action(int node, const qstring &action)
    {
        if ( node < 0 || node >= (int)g_og.nodes.size() )
            return;
        const OriginHop &h = g_og.nodes[node];
        if ( action == "written" )
        {
            travel_to(g_og_mgr, h.by_pos);
        }
        else if ( action == "seen" )
        {
            travel_to(g_og_mgr, h.at);
        }
        else if ( action == "show" )
        {
            if ( h.by_pc != BADADDR )
                jumpto(h.by_pc);
        }
        else if ( action == "copy" )
        {
            copy_to_clipboard(origin_value_text(h.value).c_str());
        }
    }

    static GraphNode og_node(TraceManager *mgr, const OriginHop &h, bool root)
    {
        GraphNode g;
        g.title.sprnt("%s = %s", origin_target_text(h.what).c_str(), origin_value_text(h.value).c_str());
        const bool written = h.by_pos.is_valid() && h.by_pc != BADADDR;
        if ( written )
        {
            g.code = h.insn;
            // A copy gets one line: chains of them (spills and reloads) are
            // long, and only where they lead matters.
            if ( h.kind == OriginKind::Copied )
            {
                g.lines.push_back(qstring().sprnt("%s, written at %s", describe_address(mgr, h.by_pc).c_str(),
                                                  format_position(h.by_pos).c_str()));
            }
            else
            {
                g.lines.push_back(describe_address(mgr, h.by_pc));
                g.lines.push_back(qstring().sprnt("written at %s, seen at %s",
                                                  format_position(h.by_pos).c_str(), format_position(h.at).c_str()));
            }
        }
        else
        {
            g.lines.push_back(qstring().sprnt("seen at %s", format_position(h.at).c_str()));
        }
        if ( !h.note.empty() && h.kind != OriginKind::Copied )
            g.lines.push_back(h.note);

        switch ( h.kind )
        {
            case OriginKind::Copied:    g.badge = "copy";      break;
            case OriginKind::Constant:  g.badge = "constant";  break;
            case OriginKind::System:    g.badge = "system";    break;
            case OriginKind::Unchanged: g.badge = "unchanged"; g.dashed = true; break;
            case OriginKind::Computed:  g.badge = h.combined ? "combined" : "computed"; break;
            default:                    g.badge = origin_kind_name(h.kind); break;
        }
        g.emphasis = root;
        g.tooltip  = h.note;
        if ( written )
        {
            g.menu.emplace_back("Go to where it was written", "written");
            g.menu.emplace_back("Go to where it was seen", "seen");
            g.menu.emplace_back("Show the instruction", "show");
        }
        else
        {
            g.menu.emplace_back("Go to where it was seen", "seen");
        }
        g.menu.emplace_back("", "");
        g.menu.emplace_back("Copy the value", "copy");
        return g;
    }

    // Build the graph of 'what' as of 'at' and show it.
    void show_origin_graph(TraceManager *mgr, const OriginTarget &what, Position at)
    {
        if ( !graph_window_available() )
        {
            warning("The value origin graph needs IDAPython.");
            return;
        }
        OriginGraph g;
        if ( !build_origin_graph(mgr, what, at, kGraphNodes, &g) || g.nodes.empty() )
            return;
        g_og_mgr = mgr;
        g_og     = std::move(g);

        GraphModel m;
        m.title     = OG_TITLE;
        m.arrows_up = true;
        int combined = 0;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < g_og.nodes.size(); i++ )
        {
            combined += g_og.nodes[i].combined ? 1 : 0;
            m.nodes.push_back(og_node(mgr, g_og.nodes[i], i == 0));
        }
        for ( const OriginGraph::Edge &e : g_og.edges )
        {
            GraphEdge x;
            x.src    = e.from;
            x.dst    = e.to;
            x.dashed = false;
            m.edges.push_back(x);
        }
        m.status.sprnt("Where %s at %s came from: %d value%s; every input of the %d instruction%s that "
                       "combined several was followed (registers that only formed an address, and rsp, "
                       "were not).%s%s Double-click a value to go to where it was written.",
                       origin_target_text(what).c_str(), format_position(at).c_str(),
                       (int)g_og.nodes.size(), g_og.nodes.size() == 1 ? "" : "s",
                       combined, combined == 1 ? "" : "s",
                       g_og.truncated ? " Cut short at the size limit." : "",
                       g_og.cancelled ? " Stopped before the end." : "");
        m.act = og_action;
        show_graph(OG_KIND, std::move(m));
    }

    void origin_session_ended()
    {
        forget_graph(OG_KIND);
        g_og     = OriginGraph();
        g_og_mgr = nullptr;
    }

    int idaapi OriginGraphHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("Finding where a value came from is only possible while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }
        OriginTarget t;
        if ( !pick_target(ctx, &t) )
            return 1;
        show_origin_graph(mgr(), t, mgr()->current_position());
        return 1;
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_scans.cpp`:

```cpp
// Strings and buffers recovered from the recording's writes: the listings and
// the actions that open them.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"

namespace idattd
{
    static bool backend_scans(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        return mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && mgr->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr->backend()->capabilities().replay_scans;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // StringsChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_rs_widths[] = { 16, 18, 4, 80 };
    static const char *g_rs_header[] = { "Appeared at", "Address", "Enc", "Text" };

    StringsChooser::StringsChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<StringHit> &&hits)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, 0, qnumber(g_rs_widths), g_rs_widths, g_rs_header, nullptr, std::move(hits))
    {
        set_unique_title(qstring().sprnt("TTD recovered strings [%d]", (int)m_rows.size()));
    }

    void idaapi StringsChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int *, chooser_item_attrs_t *, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const StringHit &h = *row(n);
        cols->at(0) = format_position(h.pos);
        cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)h.address);
        cols->at(2) = h.wide ? "W" : "A";
        // A recovered string may hold line breaks; a row is one line.
        qstring t = h.text;
        for ( size_t i = 0; i < t.length(); i++ )
            if ( t[i] == '\n' || t[i] == '\r' || t[i] == '\t' )
                t[i] = ' ';
        cols->at(3) = t;
    }

    ea_t idaapi StringsChooser::get_ea(size_t n) const
    {
        return n < m_rows.size() ? m_rows[n].address : BADADDR;
    }

    // To where it appeared, showing it in the hex view when one is open.
    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi StringsChooser::enter(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n < m_rows.size() )
            if ( listing_is_current(m_made) )
                travel_and_show_bytes(m_mgr, m_rows[n].pos, m_rows[n].address);
        return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // BuffersChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_rb_widths[] = { 18, 8, 16, 16, 16, 28, 8, 50 };
    static const char *g_rb_header[] = { "Address", "Size", "Kind", "First write", "Last write",
                                         "Written by", "Writes", "Preview" };

    BuffersChooser::BuffersChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<BufferHit> &&hits)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, 0, qnumber(g_rb_widths), g_rb_widths, g_rb_header, nullptr, std::move(hits))
    {
        set_unique_title(qstring().sprnt("TTD recovered buffers [%d]", (int)m_rows.size()));
    }

    void idaapi BuffersChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int *, chooser_item_attrs_t *, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const BufferHit &h = *row(n);
        cols->at(0).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)h.address);
        cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)h.size);
        cols->at(2) = h.kind;
        cols->at(3) = format_position(h.first_pos);
        cols->at(4) = format_position(h.last_pos);
        cols->at(5) = func_offset_name(h.writer_ip);
        cols->at(6).sprnt("%llu", (unsigned long long)h.writes);
        cols->at(7) = h.preview;
    }

    ea_t idaapi BuffersChooser::get_ea(size_t n) const
    {
        return n < m_rows.size() ? m_rows[n].address : BADADDR;
    }

    // To the last write, where the buffer is complete, showing it in the hex
    // view when one is open.
    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi BuffersChooser::enter(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n < m_rows.size() )
            if ( listing_is_current(m_made) )
                travel_and_show_bytes(m_mgr, m_rows[n].last_pos, m_rows[n].address);
        return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Actions
    //=======================================================================
    // Run a replay scan, asking for what it needs (host consent, the hives)
    // when it is refused for want of it. False, reported, when it did not run.
    static bool run_scan(TraceManager *mgr, const char *what, bool *cancelled,
                         const std::function<bool(const ReplaySettings &, qstring *)> &scan)
    {
        ReplaySettings rs = initial_replay_settings(mgr);
        qstring err;
        for ( ;; )
        {
            err.clear();
            if ( scan(rs, &err) )
            {
                // A replay that could not follow the whole recording still
                // returns what it found; say what it missed. The dialog shows
                // once per scan, recording and note, since the backend keeps
                // its answer and a repeat scan gives the same note.
                static std::set<std::string> told;
                qstring note = mgr->backend()->scan_notice();
                if ( !note.empty() )
                {
                    msg("[ida-ttd] %s: %s\n", what, note.c_str());
                    std::string key = std::string(what) + "|" + mgr->trace_path().c_str() + "|" + note.c_str();
                    if ( told.insert(key).second )
                        info("The results are incomplete: %s", note.c_str());
                }
                return true;
            }
            if ( *cancelled || !ask_replay_needs(mgr, &rs) )
                break;
        }
        if ( *cancelled )
            msg("[ida-ttd] %s cancelled.\n", what);
        else if ( mgr->backend() != nullptr && mgr->backend()->last_replay_block() != ReplayBlock::None )
            msg("[ida-ttd] %s not run: %s.\n", what, err.c_str());
        else
            warning("The replay failed: %s", err.empty() ? "no reason given" : err.c_str());
        return false;
    }

    int idaapi RecoverStringsHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( !backend_scans(mgr()) )
        {
            warning("This recording's backend cannot recover strings.");
            return 1;
        }
        static const char form[] =
            "Recover strings\n"
            "\n"
            "\n"
            "Every ASCII and UTF-16 string the program had in memory, and where it appeared.\n"
            "This reads the whole recording, seconds for a small one, minutes for a large one.\n"
            "\n"
            "<~M~inimum length:D::8::>\n"
            "\n";
        static sval_t min_len = 6;
        if ( ask_form(form, &min_len) <= 0 )
            return 1;

        std::vector<StringHit> hits;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !run_scan(mgr(), "string recovery", &cancelled, [&](const ReplaySettings &rs, qstring *err)
            {
                return recover_strings(mgr(), rs, (uint32_t)std::max<sval_t>(min_len, 2), &hits, &cancelled, err);
            }) )
            return 1;
        msg("[ida-ttd] %d string(s) recovered%s.\n", (int)hits.size(), cancelled ? " (cancelled)" : "");
        if ( hits.empty() )
        {
            if ( !cancelled )
                info("No strings of that length were found.");
            return 1;
        }
        StringsChooser *ch = new StringsChooser(mgr(), std::move(hits));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi RecoverStringsHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_scans(mgr()) ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }

    int idaapi RecoverBuffersHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( !backend_scans(mgr()) )
        {
            warning("This recording's backend cannot recover buffers.");
            return 1;
        }
        // No questions up front: every buffer, from a replay of the whole
        // recording behind a cancellable wait box.
        std::vector<BufferHit> hits;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !run_scan(mgr(), "buffer recovery", &cancelled, [&](const ReplaySettings &rs, qstring *err)
            {
                return recover_buffers(mgr(), rs, &hits, &cancelled, err);
            }) )
            return 1;
        msg("[ida-ttd] %d buffer(s) recovered%s.\n", (int)hits.size(), cancelled ? " (cancelled)" : "");
        if ( hits.empty() )
        {
            if ( !cancelled )
                info("No buffers were found.");
            return 1;
        }
        BuffersChooser *ch = new BuffersChooser(mgr(), std::move(hits));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi RecoverBuffersHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_scans(mgr()) ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }
}
```

```cpp
namespace idattd

    //=======================================================================

    SelfModChooser::SelfModChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SelfModHit> &&hits)

    void idaapi SelfModChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                        chooser_item_attrs_t * /*attrs*/, size_t n) const
    {

            return;
        const SelfModHit &h = *row(n);
        cols->at(0).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)h.address);

        cols->at(2) = format_position(h.write_pos);
        cols->at(3) = func_offset_name(h.write_ip);

    // in the stub that unpacked it (position_of).

    {
        return n < m_rows.size() ? m_rows[n].address : BADADDR;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Self-modifying code action
    //=======================================================================
    static bool backend_finds_selfmod(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        return mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && mgr->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr->backend()->capabilities().self_modifying;
    }

    int idaapi SelfModHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( !backend_finds_selfmod(mgr()) )
        {
            warning("This recording's backend cannot look for self-modifying code.");
            return 1;
        }
        std::vector<SelfModHit> hits;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( !find_self_modifying(mgr(), &hits, &cancelled) )
        {
            warning("The recording's backend could not look for self-modifying code.");
            return 1;
        }
        msg("[ida-ttd] %d instruction(s) the program wrote and then ran%s.\n", (int)hits.size(),
            cancelled ? " (stopped early)" : "");
        if ( hits.empty() )
        {
            info("The program ran no code it had written itself%s.",
                 cancelled ? " (as far as the search got)" : "");
            return 1;
        }
        SelfModChooser *ch = new SelfModChooser(mgr(), std::move(hits));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi SelfModHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_finds_selfmod(mgr()) ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_syscalls.cpp`:

```cpp
// The recording's syscalls: the listing and the action that opens it.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "debugger/apidecode.h"

namespace idattd
{
    //=======================================================================
    // SyscallChooser
    //=======================================================================
    static const int   g_sc_widths[] = { 16, 8, 30, 36, 100 };
    static const char *g_sc_header[] = { "Position", "Thread", "Syscall", "Result", "Arguments" };

    SyscallChooser::SyscallChooser(TraceManager *mgr, std::vector<SyscallEvent> &&calls,
                                   std::vector<qstring> &&decoded)
        : ListingChooser(mgr, CH_CAN_EDIT | CH_CAN_REFRESH, qnumber(g_sc_widths), g_sc_widths, g_sc_header,
                         nullptr, std::move(calls)),
          m_decoded(std::move(decoded))
    {
        popup_names[POPUP_EDIT]    = "Decode arguments";
        popup_names[POPUP_REFRESH] = "Rebuild from the recording";
        set_unique_title(qstring().sprnt("TTD syscalls [%d]", (int)m_rows.size()));
        reset_rows();
    }

    // A call without a decoding shows its registers instead. They are read
    // here, for every such call in one batch behind a wait box, and never
    // from get_row: IDA draws every row to sort or filter a list, and reading
    // the recording there froze the UI (a seek is ~17 ms on Microsoft TTD).
    void SyscallChooser::reset_rows()
    {
        m_decoded.resize(m_rows.size());
        if ( m_made.current() )
            undecoded_syscall_arguments(m_mgr, m_rows, m_decoded, &m_args);
        else
            m_args.assign(m_rows.size(), std::nullopt);
    }

    void idaapi SyscallChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                        chooser_item_attrs_t *attrs, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const SyscallEvent &c = *row(n);
        cols->at(0) = format_position(c.pos);
        if ( c.tid != 0 )
            cols->at(1).sprnt("0x%X", c.tid);
        if ( !c.name.empty() )
            cols->at(2) = c.name;
        else
            cols->at(2).sprnt("syscall 0x%X", c.number);

        // NTSTATUS (nearly all are Nt* calls); failures in the error color.
        uint32_t st = (uint32_t)c.result;
        const char *sn = c.result <= 0xFFFFFFFFull ? ntstatus_name(st) : nullptr;
        if ( sn != nullptr )
            cols->at(3).sprnt("0x%08X %s", st, sn);
        else
            cols->at(3).sprnt("0x%llX", (uint64_t)c.result);
        if ( c.result <= 0xFFFFFFFFull && (st & 0xC0000000u) == 0xC0000000u && attrs != nullptr )
            attrs->color = 0xC0C0FF;     // BGR: light red

        if ( !m_decoded[n].empty() )
        {
            cols->at(4) = m_decoded[n];
            return;
        }
        const std::optional<SyscallArgs> &a = m_args[n];
        if ( a.has_value() )
            cols->at(4).sprnt("r10=0x%llX, rdx=0x%llX, r8=0x%llX, r9=0x%llX",
                              (uint64_t)(*a)[0], (uint64_t)(*a)[1],
                              (uint64_t)(*a)[2], (uint64_t)(*a)[3]);
        else
            cols->at(4) = "(not read; Ctrl+E decodes it)";
    }

    // One call the full decoding did not reach (it was stopped).
    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi SyscallChooser::edit(size_t n)
    {
        if ( n >= m_rows.size() || m_mgr == nullptr || !m_mgr->is_active() )
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        if ( api_signature(m_rows[n].name.c_str()) == nullptr )
        {
            const qstring &why = api_metadata_error();
            info("There is no signature for %s%s%s.",
                 m_rows[n].name.empty() ? "this syscall" : m_rows[n].name.c_str(),
                 why.empty() ? "" : ": ", why.c_str());
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        }
        // Its registers are read at the row's position: only on its own
        // recording.
        if ( !listing_is_current(m_made) )
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> one{ m_rows[n] };
        std::vector<qstring> text;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( decode_syscalls(m_mgr, one, &text, &cancelled) && !cancelled && !text.empty() )
            m_decoded[n] = text[0];
        return cbret_t(n, ALL_CHANGED);
    }

    chooser_t::cbret_t idaapi SyscallChooser::refresh(ssize_t n)
    {
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> calls;
        std::vector<qstring> decoded;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( m_mgr == nullptr || !m_mgr->is_active()
          || !list_syscalls(m_mgr, &calls, &cancelled) || cancelled )
            return cbret_t(n, NOTHING_CHANGED);
        // Saved only when the decode ran to the end: a failed one leaves
        // every row blank, which would then be kept as the final answer.
        if ( decode_syscalls(m_mgr, calls, &decoded, &cancelled) && !cancelled )
            save_syscalls(calls, decoded);
        restamp(std::move(calls));
        m_decoded = std::move(decoded);
        reset_rows();
        return cbret_t(n, ALL_CHANGED);
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Syscalls action
    //=======================================================================
    static bool backend_lists_syscalls(TraceManager *mgr)
    {
        return mgr != nullptr && mgr->is_active() && mgr->backend() != nullptr
            && mgr->backend()->capabilities().syscalls;
    }

    // The list saved in the database, else listed and decoded now behind a
    // cancellable wait box, and saved if that ran to the end.
    int idaapi SyscallsHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( !backend_lists_syscalls(mgr()) )
        {
            warning("This recording's backend cannot list its syscalls.");
            return 1;
        }
        std::vector<SyscallEvent> calls;
        std::vector<qstring> decoded;
        bool cancelled = false;
        if ( load_syscalls(&calls, &decoded) )
        {
            msg("[ida-ttd] %d syscall(s), as saved in the database; Refresh (Ctrl+U) in the list "
                "rebuilds it.\n", (int)calls.size());
        }
        else
        {
            if ( !list_syscalls(mgr(), &calls, &cancelled) )
            {
                warning("The recording's backend could not list its syscalls.");
                return 1;
            }
            if ( cancelled )
            {
                msg("[ida-ttd] syscalls: stopped.\n");
                return 1;
            }
            const bool ran = decode_syscalls(mgr(), calls, &decoded, &cancelled);
            if ( cancelled || !ran )
                msg("[ida-ttd] %d syscall(s); decoding their arguments %s, so they are shown "
                    "undecoded and not saved (Ctrl+E decodes one).\n", (int)calls.size(),
                    cancelled ? "was stopped" : "failed");
            else
                save_syscalls(calls, decoded);
        }
        if ( calls.empty() )
        {
            info("The recording made no syscalls.");
            return 1;
        }
        SyscallChooser *ch = new SyscallChooser(mgr(), std::move(calls), std::move(decoded));
        ch->choose();
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi SyscallsHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *)
    {
        return backend_lists_syscalls(mgr()) ? AST_ENABLE : AST_DISABLE;
    }
}
```

`src/ui/ui_tracer.cpp`:

```cpp
// Function-call tracing: the recorded-call listing and the actions that
// drive a sweep.
#include "ui/ui.h"
#include "ui/names.h"
#include "debugger/apidecode.h"
#include "analysis/tracer.h"

namespace idattd
{
    // IDA's name for a traced function, else its export name: a module not
    // mapped at the current position has no names in the database, though
    // its exports matched the pattern.
    static qstring traced_name(TraceManager *mgr, ea_t ea)
    {
        qstring n = func_display_name(ea);
        if ( n.length() > 2 && n[0] == '0' && n[1] == 'x' && mgr != nullptr )
        {
            qstring e = mgr->modules().export_name_at(ea);
            if ( !e.empty() )
                return e;
        }
        return n;
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // TraceEventsChooser
    //=======================================================================
    EventColumns::EventColumns(FunctionTracer *tracer)
    {
        // One column per parameter only when a single function is traced
        // (all rows share its signature); else one "Arguments" column.
        ea_t single = (tracer != nullptr && tracer->count_traced() == 1)
                    ? tracer->traced_at(0) : BADADDR;

        // The same prototype the sweep decoded with (resolve_traced_proto),
        // so the headers name the values in the rows.
        std::vector<qstring> arg_names;
        if ( single != BADADDR )
        {
            per_arg = true;
            TraceManager *m = tracer->manager();
            arg_names = resolve_traced_proto(m != nullptr ? &m->modules() : nullptr, single).names;
            argc = (int)arg_names.size();
        }

        // Fixed leading columns (LEAD == 4): call/return positions, thread, name.
        header_strs.push_back("Start");     widths.push_back(16);
        header_strs.push_back("End");       widths.push_back(16);
        header_strs.push_back("Thread");    widths.push_back(8);
        header_strs.push_back("Function");  widths.push_back(22);
        if ( per_arg )
        {
            for ( const qstring &nm : arg_names )
            {
                header_strs.push_back(nm);
                widths.push_back(24);
            }
        }
        else
        {
            header_strs.push_back("Arguments");
            widths.push_back(72);
        }
        header_strs.push_back("Return");    widths.push_back(26);

        // Only after header_strs is final, so the c_str() pointers stay valid.
        for ( const qstring &s : header_strs )
            header_ptrs.push_back(s.c_str());

        // A unique title so several tabs can coexist (IDA keys widgets by
        // title and would re-focus the first).
        static int seq = 0;
        qstring fname = single != BADADDR ? func_display_name(single) : qstring("calls");
        title_str.sprnt("TTD calls: %s [%d]", fname.c_str(), ++seq);
    }

    TraceEventsChooser::TraceEventsChooser(TraceManager *mgr, FunctionTracer *tracer)
        : EventColumns(tracer),
          ListingChooser(mgr, CH_CAN_DEL,
                         EventColumns::n(), EventColumns::w(), EventColumns::h(), EventColumns::t(),
                         tracer != nullptr ? tracer->snapshot_events() : std::vector<FunctionInvocation>())
    {
        for ( const FunctionInvocation &ev : m_rows )
        {
            auto [it, added] = m_labels.try_emplace(ev.func_ea);
            if ( !added )
                continue;
            FuncLabel &l = it->second;
            l.name = traced_name(m_mgr, ev.func_ea);
            if ( per_arg )
                continue;
            // Functions share the Arguments column, so each value is labeled
            // with its parameter name, from the prototype the sweep used.
            // Untyped functions' values stay unlabeled.
            TracedProto proto = resolve_traced_proto(m_mgr != nullptr ? &m_mgr->modules() : nullptr, ev.func_ea);
            if ( proto.sig != nullptr || proto.have_type )
                l.params = std::move(proto.names);
        }
    }

    void idaapi TraceEventsChooser::get_row(qstrvec_t *cols, int * /*icon*/,
                                            chooser_item_attrs_t * /*attrs*/, size_t n) const
    {
        if ( row(n) == nullptr )
            return;
        const FunctionInvocation &ev = *row(n);

        cols->at(0) = format_position(ev.pos);
        // No return in the recording (thread exit, ExitProcess, an unwind).
        cols->at(1) = ev.has_ret ? format_position(ev.end_pos) : qstring("no return");
        cols->at(2).sprnt("%X", ev.tid);
        auto label = m_labels.find(ev.func_ea);
        if ( label == m_labels.end() )
            return;                     // the constructor labeled every row's function
        cols->at(3) = label->second.name;

        if ( per_arg )
        {
            for ( int i = 0; i < argc; i++ )
                cols->at(LEAD + i) = i < (int)ev.args.size() ? ev.args[i] : qstring();
            if ( ev.has_ret )
                cols->at(LEAD + argc) = ev.retval;
        }
        else
        {
            const std::vector<qstring> &params = label->second.params;
            qstring joined;
            for ( size_t i = 0; i < ev.args.size(); i++ )
            {
                if ( i != 0 )
                    joined.append(", ");
                if ( i < params.size() && !params[i].empty() )
                {
                    joined.append(params[i]);
                    joined.append("=");
                }
                joined.append(ev.args[i]);
            }
            cols->at(LEAD) = joined;
            if ( ev.has_ret )
                cols->at(LEAD + 1) = ev.retval;
        }
    }

    //=======================================================================
    // Tracer actions
    //=======================================================================
    // One click: trace the function under the cursor, sweep the whole trace,
    // and open the results.
    // Open the calls just traced, unless there are none: a sweep that failed
    // or was cancelled has said so already, and one that found nothing has
    // logged "recorded 0 call(s)", so an empty tab would only add clutter.
    static void show_trace_events(TraceManager *mgr, FunctionTracer *tracer)
    {
        TraceEventsChooser *ch = new TraceEventsChooser(mgr, tracer);
        if ( ch->get_count() == 0 )
        {
            delete ch;
            return;
        }
        ch->choose();
    }

    int idaapi TraceFuncHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        if ( tracer() == nullptr )
            return 1;
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("Tracing is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }
        ea_t ea = ctx != nullptr && ctx->cur_ea != BADADDR ? ctx->cur_ea : get_screen_ea();
        ea_t fstart = get_func_start(ea);
        ea_t target = fstart != BADADDR ? fstart : ea;

        // A focused "calls to this function" query: drop earlier picks.
        tracer()->reset();
        tracer()->add_func(target);
        qstring err;
        if ( !tracer()->run_sweep(&err) )
        {
            warning("%s", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        show_trace_events(mgr(), tracer());
        return 1;
    }

    action_state_t idaapi TraceFuncHandler::update(action_update_ctx_t *ctx)
    {
        // Enabled over any address; activate() warns when no trace is
        // replayed.
        if ( ctx != nullptr && ctx->cur_ea != BADADDR )
            return AST_ENABLE;
        return AST_DISABLE;
    }

    // Prompt for a "module!Glob*" pattern, trace every match in one sweep,
    // and open the results (one Arguments column for several matches).
    int idaapi TracePatternHandler::activate(action_activation_ctx_t *)
    {
        if ( tracer() == nullptr )
            return 1;
        if ( mgr() == nullptr || !mgr()->is_active() )
        {
            warning("Tracing is only available while replaying a trace.");
            return 1;
        }

        qstring pat;
        if ( !ask_str(&pat, 0, "Trace calls to functions matching (wildcards * ?, "
                               "optional module!, e.g. kernel32!Virtual*)")
          || pat.empty() )
            return 1;

        std::vector<ea_t> hits = mgr()->modules().resolve_function_pattern(pat.c_str());
        if ( hits.empty() )
        {
            info("No functions matched '%s'.\n\n"
                 "Patterns match symbol names (exports/PDB). Make sure the module "
                 "is loaded in the trace and try e.g. 'kernel32!Virtual*'.", pat.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        tracer()->reset();
        for ( ea_t ea : hits )
            tracer()->add_func(ea);
        qstring err;
        if ( !tracer()->run_sweep(&err) )
        {
            warning("%s", err.c_str());
            return 1;
        }

        show_trace_events(mgr(), tracer());
        return 1;
    }
}

```
